1h axe.description: +20% increased Critical Strike Chance against Injured enemies. Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes have up to a 55% chance to grant +12% increased Attack Speed for 2 seconds.
1h axe.name: 1h Axe

1h mace.description: x20% increased damage to Stunned enemies. Lucky Hit: Up to a 20% chance to gain Berserking for 3 seconds when you hit a Stunned enemy.
1h mace.name: 1h Mace

1h sword.description: Lucky Hit: Up to a 20% chance to gain 5 Fury when hitting a Crowd Controlled enemy. Killing a Crowd Controlled enemy grants +30% increased Attack Speed for 3 seconds.
1h sword.name: 1h Sword

2h axe.description: x10% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies. +5% increased Critical Strike Chance against Vulnerable enemies.
2h axe.name: 2h Axe

2h mace.description: Lucky Hit: Up to a 10% chance to gain 5 Fury when hitting an enemy. Double the amount of Fury gained while Berserking. You deal x15% increased Critical Strike damage while Berserking.
2h mace.name: 2h Mace

2h sword.description: +20% of direct damage you deal is inflicted as Bleeding damage over 5 seconds. You deal x30% increased Bleeding damage.
2h sword.name: 2h Sword

abyssal fragment.description: Hex stacks up to a maximum of 4. When a target gains 4 stacks, 25% of the Occult Abyss Skill damage dealt to the target echoes after 4 seconds and removes all stacks of Hex. Command Vollach also causes Occult Abyss Skills to apply 1 additional stack of Hex to enemies while you've siphoned its power.
abyssal fragment.name: Abyssal Fragment

advance.description: Advance forward with your weapon, dealing 105 damage.
advance.name: Advance

runes.Critical Strike Chance: Advance grants +5% Critical Strike Chance for 8 seconds.
runes.Flash of the Blade: Advance becomes a Disciple Skill and has a 10 second cooldown. Advance becomes a dash that cuts through enemies, applying Vulnerable and dealing 230 damage.
runes.Fortify: Grants 2% of Maximum Life as Fortify when Advance hits an enemy for the first time.
runes.Unhindered: Casting Advance grants you Unhindered for 2 seconds.
runes.Vanguard's Rush: Advance rushes into enemies, granting 1 Fervor on each strike and deals an additional x25% damage per stack of Fervor you have.
runes.Wave Dash: Advance becomes a Juggernaut Skill. Advance's impact waves out, dealing 136 damage and gains 1 Resolve for every 1 meter you dash.
runes.Weaken: Advance Weakens enemies for 8 seconds.

advantageous beast.description: Gain +15% Movement Speed and +15% Impairment Reduction.
advantageous beast.name: Advantageous Beast

aegis.description: Surround yourself with shields of the Light, Taunting Close enemies and gaining value1 Block Chance and 30% Armor for 4 seconds.
aegis.name: Aegis

runes.Block Damage Reduction: Casting Aegis increases your Block Damage Reduction by 15% while active.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Reduce Aegis's cooldown by 4 seconds.
runes.Faith Is My Shield: Aegis now applies Judgement instead of Taunting enemies. Blocking while Aegis is active applies Judgement to the attacker.
runes.Impunity: While Aegis is active, you gain 40% Thorns and Retribution Chance.
runes.Stay Resolute: Passive: Gaining or spending Resolve has a 4% chance to trigger a free Aegis. Casting Aegis grants 8 stacks of Resolve.
runes.Unstoppable: Casting Aegis grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.

altar of avarice.description: Horadric Altars are replaced with Goblin Altars that only summon Treasure Goblins.
altar of avarice.name: Altar of Avarice

ambusher.description: You gain x20% Lucky Hit Chance against enemies damaged by Subo's Salvo within the last 3 seconds.
ambusher.name: Ambusher

amplified suffering.description: Damaging a Soul Chained enemy detonates the chain early, dealing 50% Shadow damage around them.
amplified suffering.name: Amplified Suffering

ancient harpoons.description: Varyana launches three harpoons ahead of her, piercing enemies for 200% Physical damage. She then rips them back, Pulling In and Stunning enemies for 4 seconds.
ancient harpoons.name: Ancient Harpoons

annihilator.description: Varyana's Ancient Harpoons additionally Slow enemies by 40% for 5 seconds. During this time, you gain x30% Lucky Hit Chance against those targets.
annihilator.name: Annihilator

apocalypse.description: Create a massive sigil that detonates after 2 seconds dealing 666 damage to all enemies within. This ritual does not benefit from Cooldown Reduction.
apocalypse.name: Apocalypse

runes.Annihilation: Apocalypse launches a hellfire blast with at least 20 Stacks that deals 33 damage. Hellfire Skill hits generate up to 100 Stacks, each Stack increases the blast's explosion size and damage by x40%.
runes.Armageddon Ritual: You can now Channel Apocalypse for up to 6.66 seconds to build up the final explosion and rain down Brimstones which deal 666 damage. Each second increases the final damage, up to 666 bonus damage.
runes.Double Blast: Apocalypse's final hit has a 20% chance to hit twice. When Apocalypse is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%.
runes.Epicenter Damage: Apocalypse deals up to x25% increased damage the closer enemies are to its center.
runes.Minefield: Apocalypse becomes an Abyss Skill, creating a field of Abyssal Mines which arm after 0.8 seconds and each deal 666 damage when an enemy triggers them.
runes.Shared Damage: Apocalypse's final hit deals an additional 50% of its damage split amongst all enemies in the area.
runes.Survivor Damage: Enemies that survive Apocalypse take x15% increased damage from you for 3 seconds. This bonus lasts 200% longer against Hexed enemies.

arbiter of justice.description: Ascend to the heavens and crash upon the battlefield as an Arbiter for value1 seconds, dealing 600 damage upon landing.
arbiter of justice.name: Arbiter of Justice

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Reduce Arbiter of Justice's Cooldown by 20 seconds.
runes.Divine Intervention: Arbiter of Justice ascends for an additional 2 seconds and rains Blessed Spears on the battlefield. Upon landing, Arbiter of Justice bombards the battlefield with 10 additional Blessed Spears, applying Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Duration: Arbiter's duration is increased by 10 seconds.
runes.Movement Speed: Arbiter of Justice grants x30% Movement Speed while in Arbiter form.
runes.Reach of the Law: Arbiter's Wing Strikes now apply Judgement to enemies.
runes.Seraph's Wings:
Arbiter form gains the following benefits:
- Wing Strikes deal x200% increased damage
- Wing Strikes apply Vulnerable
runes.Wing Strike Recast: Arbiter form's Wing Strikes recast time is reduced by 0.5 seconds.

arc lash.description: Unleash arcing lightning, dealing 80 damage to enemies in front of you.
arc lash.name: Arc Lash

runes.Damage Bonus: Arc Lash deals x50% increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
runes.Ferocity: Arc Lash grants 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Full Lash: Arc Lash now casts from both sides in a larger arc, hitting enemies caught in the middle twice.
runes.Icy Thrash: Arc Lash becomes a Frost Skill, deals Cold damage, and Chills for 25%. Arc Lash has a larger range and deals up to x100% increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.
runes.Inescapable Reach: Arc Lash launches a swift projectile that unleashes arcing lightning at the first enemy hit, dealing up to x150% increased damage based on how far the projectile travels. Hitting an enemy with Arc Lash's projectile increases your Movement Speed by +4% for 5 seconds, stacking up to +20%.
runes.Resource Generation: Arc Lash generates 5 Mana when it hits the first enemy.
runes.Stun: Every 8 seconds your next Arc Lash will Stun all enemies hit for 2 seconds.

armored hide.description: Passive: Gain 1 Resolve every value1 seconds. Active: Encase yourself, gaining + value2 Block Chance for 3 seconds.
armored hide.name: Armored Hide

runes.Barrier: Armored Hide also grants a Barrier for 20% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds.
runes.Blocked Damage Reduction: While Armored Hide is active, gain +15% Blocked Damage Reduction.
runes.Duration: Armored Hide active duration is increased by 1 second.
runes.Ferocious Meal: Armored Hide becomes a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage. Passive: Each time you take damage, gain a stack of Ferocity. Active: Perform large slashes all around you, dealing 125 damage twice. Restore 2% of your Maximum Life each time this damages an enemy. Receive 25% increased Healing for 3 seconds.
runes.Force of Nature: Armored Hide restores 50 Vigor and makes you Unstoppable for the duration.
runes.Thorns: Armored Hide's Passive increases your Thorns by 20%.
runes.Trampled Under Foot: When you Evade through enemies with Armored Hide active, you deal value3 of your Thorns to them. Activating Armored Hide deals value4 of your Thorns to Close enemies.

army of the dead.description: Call forth the deep buried dead. Volatile Skeletons emerge over the next 7 seconds that explode when around enemies, dealing 120 damage and Stunning them for 2 seconds.
army of the dead.name: Army of the Dead

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Army of the Dead's Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds.
runes.Corpse Generation: Army of the Dead has a 50% chance to form a Corpse.
runes.Damage Bonus: Army of the Dead deals x2% increased damage for each minion you have.
runes.Dead Cold: Army of the Dead now deals 150 Cold damage and Freezes enemies instead of Stunning them.
runes.Passive Bonus: Army of the Dead passively summons a Volatile Skeleton every 4 seconds.
runes.Pile the Bodies: Army of the Dead will converge on your target. Each time a Volatile Skeleton explodes on an enemy, they take x10% increased damage from your Army of the Dead, up to x300%.
runes.Unyielding Commander: While Army of the Dead is active, your Minions take 90% reduced damage and you deal x50% increased Summon Damage.

ashes to ashes.description: On death, lose all your Aberrant Cinders. For every 100 Aberrant Cinders you pick up, you gain an additional 10.
ashes to ashes.name: Ashes to Ashes

ball lightning.description: Discharge a ball of lightning that slowly moves forward and continuously zaps enemies, dealing 120 damage per second.
ball lightning.name: Ball Lightning

runes.Attraction: Ball Lightning now deals 204 damage per second. The ball's speed is greatly increased while it is not near enemies.
runes.Crackling Energy: Ball Lightning forms 3 Crackling Energy when it dissipates.
runes.Damage Bonus: Ball Lightning deals x30% increased damage when it hits 3 or fewer enemies.
runes.Ferocity: Ball Lightning grants 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Implosion: Ball Lightning becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and has a 12 second Cooldown. Ball Lightning is now cast at the target location and continuously Pulls In enemies, dealing 480 damage over 2 seconds.
runes.Multiple Projectiles: Ball Lightning has a 20% chance to form a second Ball Lightning.
runes.Orbital: Ball Lightning orbits you and now deal 144 damage around you per second.

bargaining chips.description: Targets stuck with Explosive Charges take x5% increased Overpower Damage per Explosive Charge stuck. Each Explosive Charge can be detonated by an additional 2 Overpowers before expiring.
bargaining chips.name: Bargaining Chips

barrage.description: Unleash a barrage of 5 arrows that expands outwards, each dealing 100 damage and piercing up to 2 times. Arrows cannot hit the same target more than once.
barrage.name: Barrage

runes.Broadside: Barrage no longer pierces and fires 2 less arrows. Its arrows each drop 1 Stun Grenade that deals 25 damage.
runes.Energy Cost Reduction: Barrage's Energy Cost is reduced by 24.
runes.Multishot: Barrage deals 170 damage and fires 2 additional arrows and all of its arrows now travel faster and pierce through 2 additional enemies.
runes.Overpower: Casting Barrage consumes 1 stacks of Overpower to fire 2 additional arrows and all arrows to deal x20% increased damage.
runes.Succession: Barrage fires arrows into the air, dealing 20 damage upon landing. Each arrow causes the enemy it hits to take x15% increased damage from Barrage for the next 4 seconds, up to x75%. Barrage now also creates an Arrow Storm, dealing 20 damage.
runes.Vulnerable or Weakened: Barrage deals x20% increased damage against Vulnerable or Weakened enemies.

bash.description: Bash the enemy with your weapon, dealing 90 damage. Every 4th Bash will clobber, Stunning enemies for 1.5 seconds.
bash.name: Bash

runes.Atomic Blast: Clobbering an enemy with Bash causes a fiery explosion that deals 113 Fire damage.
runes.Fury Generation: Clobbering with Bash generates an additional 10 Fury.
runes.Heavy Knuckles: Clobbering an enemy with Bash has a 100% chance to Critical Strike, and Clobbered enemies become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Overpower: Clobbering with Bash grants 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Resolve: Clobbering with Bash grants 1 stack of Resolve.
runes.Violent Swings: Each Bash has a separate 25% chance to clobber.

bastion v2.description: Raheir takes a protective position for 5 seconds, redirecting 90% of the damage that would be dealt to surrounding allies to himself for 5 seconds. Bastion's initial cast also grants surrounding allies Unstoppable for 1 second.
bastion v2.name: Bastion-v2

bauble day.description: If you slay a Portal Prankster within the Undercity, the Cabochon Merchant will appear after killing the District Boss. The Cabochon Merchant will sell you Runes and Gems for Gold.
bauble day.name: Bauble Day

bedlam.description: When you enter a Chaos Wave, gain +50 Aether and all enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.
bedlam.name: Bedlam

blade shift.description: Quickly stab your victim for 45 and shift, making you Unhindered for 4 seconds. Moving through enemies refreshes the shift duration.
blade shift.name: Blade Shift

runes.Energy: When you move through an enemy, gain 4 Energy.
runes.Grenade Shift: Blade Shift now deals 56 damage and while Unhindered by Blade Shift, you drop 2 Stun Grenades that each deal 11 damage on the enemies you pass through.
runes.Impossible Escape: Blade Shift now deals 56 Shadow damage and moving through an enemy while Unhindered by Blade Shift automatically attacks that enemy with Blade Shift.
runes.Overpower: When you move through an enemy, gain 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Range of Motion: Blade Shift's shift now lasts for 4 additional seconds and while active, grants you x15% increased Movement Speed. When you move through an enemy, Blade Shift is empowered to deal x75% increased damage while active.
runes.Resistance: While Blade Shift is active, gain +10 and x20% Resistance to All Elements.
runes.Resolve: When you move through an enemy, gain 1 stack of Resolve.

blasphemous fate.description: Aldkin occasionally loses control of his curse, transforming into a ferocious demon for 22 seconds. This grants Aldkin powerful new abilities, but the unleashed evil curses you for its duration. Curse of Darkness: Nearby enemies become Vulnerable. Curse of Flames: Your direct damage Burns enemies for 30% damage over 3 seconds. Aldkin's curse and demon form are determined by his Mercenary Core Skill.
blasphemous fate.name: Blasphemous Fate

blasphemous fragment.description: Recast Skills Hex enemies on hit and increase the damage they take from your Abyss Demonology Skills by x20%.
blasphemous fragment.name: Blasphemous Fragment

blazing scream.description: Send forth a Demon Skull dealing 130 damage as it travels.
blazing scream.name: Blazing Scream

runes.Abyssal Oppression: Blazing Scream becomes an Abyss Recast Summon Skill, seeking your target location for 5 seconds and Knocking Down enemies the first time it hits them. Enemies near the skull take 227 damage and become Vulnerable. Channeling redirects the skull and refreshes the duration.
runes.Brimstone Hunger: Blazing Scream's primary skills instantly detonate Brimstone as they travel, increasing that skull's damage by 5% per Brimstone, up to 25%.
runes.Cost Reduction: Hitting any enemy with Blazing Scream reduces its cost by 25% for 2 seconds.
runes.Damage: Blazing Scream deals x3% increased damage based on how many different enemies it has hit, up to x30%.
runes.Impact Velocity: Blazing Scream gains up to x30% increased damage and speed based on your Movement Speed Bonus.
runes.Orbital Scream: Blazing Scream is now also a Summon Skill and orbits you for 10 seconds. The skull deals 384 damage and extends Demonform when it hits enemies. Channeling increases the orbit speed by 150% and refreshes the duration.
runes.Skull Splitter: Blazing Scream shoots out smaller Lesser Demon Skulls that seek enemies and deal 29 damage.

blessed hammer.description: Throw a Blessed Hammer that spirals out, dealing 115 damage.
blessed hammer.name: Blessed Hammer

runes.Cast Speed: Blessed Hammer gains +15% increased Cast Speed and its hammers travel +25% faster.
runes.Cost Reduction: Casting Blessed Hammer reduces its cost by 5% for 2 seconds, up to 5 times.
runes.Damage Bonus: Hitting enemies with Blessed Hammer increases its damage by x5% up to 5 times, for 3 seconds.
runes.Disciple's Halo: Blessed Hammer becomes a Disciple Skill. Blessed Hammer follows you and orbits around you, dealing 115 damage and attacking 20% faster.
runes.Mortar Combat: Blessed Hammer mortars 3 hammers to the ground, dealing 67 damage in an area.
runes.Shattering Blow: Blessed Hammer deals 115 damage and shatters into 3 small explosions on impact, dealing 46 damage each.
runes.Slow: Blessed Hammer now Slows enemies by 50% for 5 seconds.

blessed shield.description: Bless and hurl your shield with Holy energy, dealing 216 damage that ricochets up to 3 times.
blessed shield.name: Blessed Shield

runes.Armor and Block Chance Bonus: Blessed Shield increases your Armor by +2% and Block Chance by +2% for 6 seconds each time it hits an enemy.
runes.Cast Speed: Blessed Shield gains +20% increased Cast Speed.
runes.Damage Bonus: Blessed Shield deals 75% of your shield's Block Chance as additional damage.
runes.Faith Generation: When Blessed Shield hits a Crowd Controlled enemy, gain 5 Faith.
runes.Shield of Justice: Blessed Shield detonates Judgement and ricochets 5 additional times. Whenever Blessed Shield detonates Judgement, it empowers your next throw to deal x40% increased damage, up to a maximum of 5 times.
runes.Shield of Retribution: Blessed Shield becomes a Juggernaut Skill. Blessed Shield travels straight without returning, pulsing 70% your Thorns damage for 3 seconds before bursting for 378 damage.
runes.Shield of the Revenant: Blessed Shield now boomerangs and pierces instead of ricocheting, dealing 270 damage. Hitting enemies with Blessed Shield increases its damage by 5% for 6 seconds up to 5 times.

blight.description: Unleash concentrated blight that deals 40 damage and leaves behind a defiled area, dealing 210 Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.
blight.name: Blight

runes.Area Damage Bonus: Blight's defiled area deals x40% increased damage.
runes.Crowd Control Damage Bonus: Blight deals x30% increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
runes.Lucky Hit Chance: Blight has an additional 20% Lucky Hit Chance.
runes.Piercing Darkness: Blight pierces 1 time and can spawn an additional defiled area.
runes.Volatile Blood: Blight becomes a Blood skill that deals Physical damage. Blight's defilied area instantly bursts dealing 315 damage.
runes.Whirlpool: Blight deals Cold and Frostbite damage. Its defiled area Pulls In enemies and Chills for 15% every second.

blizzard.description: Call forth a frigid blizzard that deals 350 Frostbite damage and continually Chills enemies for 100% over 4 seconds.
blizzard.name: Blizzard

runes.Barrier: Blizzard grants you a Barrier that absorbs 0.5% of your Maximum Life for 4 seconds every second for each affected enemy.
runes.Damage Bonus: Blizzard deals x30% increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
runes.Exposure: Blizzard's duration is increased to 6 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.
runes.Hailstorm: Blizzard forms Ice Spikes that explode twice if they hit a Vulnerable enemy, dealing 49 damage.
runes.Resource Generation: Blizzard deals x3% increased damage and grants 2 Mana Regeneration for each active Blizzard, up to 10 Mana.
runes.Seek and Duration Bonus: Blizzard now seeks enemies and its duration is increased by 50%.
runes.Static Field: Blizzard becomes a Shock Skill, deals 525 Sparking damage over 1 seconds, and costs 15 Mana. Blizzard periodically Stuns enemies for 0.25 seconds.

blood howl.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and howl furiously, Healing you for value1 of your Maximum Life.
blood howl.name: Blood Howl

runes.Berserking Howl: Blood Howl grants Berserking to yourself and allies for 5 seconds and an additional x10% increased damage to other Players for the duration. In addition, you deal 80 Poisoning damage over 4 seconds while Blood Howl is active.
runes.Dodge Chance: Blood Howl increases your Dodge Chance by 20% for 5 seconds.
runes.Healing:
For 5 seconds after casting Blood Howl, heal for 1% of your Maximum Life each time you hit an enemy.

These bonuses are doubled on Critical Strikes.
runes.Hungering Howl: Blood Howl increases Healing Received from all sources by 50% for 5 seconds.
runes.Movement Speed: Blood Howl increases your Movement Speed by x15% for 5 seconds.
runes.Spirit Howl: Blood Howl instead restores 1 Spirit for every 1% of Life that would have been healed.
runes.Unstoppable: Blood Howl grants you Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

blood lance.description: Throw a blood lance, dealing 130 damage to an enemy that ricochets to another enemy. Enemies hit are lanced for 3 seconds. When Blood Lance hits an enemy, it deals damage to all other lanced enemies.
blood lance.name: Blood Lance

runes.Blood Seeker: Blood Lance deals x45% increased damage to its primary target per lanced enemy.
runes.Cost Reduction: Blood Lance's Essence cost is reduced by 3.
runes.Festering Wound: Blood Lance becomes a Darkness Skill and deals Shadow damage. Enemies hit are permanently lanced and the lance deals 80 Corrupting damage per second to them.
runes.Fortify: Blood Lance Fortifies you for 4% of your Maximum Life if it hits an enemy already lanced.
runes.Gore Quills: Every 3rd cast of Blood Lance forms a Blood Orb under the first enemy hit. Casting Blood Lance will pick up a Blood Orb around you and conjure an additional lance from it, dealing 125% of normal damage.
runes.Overpower: Blood Lance consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to throw an additional lance, dealing 50% of normal damage.
runes.Ricochet: Blood Lance ricochets to 1 additional enemy.

blood mist.description: Disperse into a bloody mist, becoming Immune for 3 seconds. You deal 420 damage to enemies and Heal for value1 of your Maximum Life over the duration.
blood mist.name: Blood Mist

runes.Blood Rush: Blood Mist additonally becomes a Mobility Skill and its Cooldown is reduced to 8 seconds. Instead of dispersing you into a bloody mist, Blood Mist consumes a nearby corpse to teleport you to the target location and grants Unstoppable for value2 seconds.
runes.Blood Transfusion: Blood Mist Fortifies you for 30% of your Maximum Life over its duration and forms a Blood Orb every second.
runes.Critical Strike: Blood Mist grants +5% Critical Strike Chance for 5 seconds after it ends.
runes.Devouring Mist: Blood Mist becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Blood Mist now deals 600 Shadow damage over its duration and applies Vampiric Curse to enemies.
runes.Movement Speed: Blood Mist increases your Movement Speed by x30% for 3 seconds.
runes.Overpower: Blood Mist grants 1 stack of Overpower every second.
runes.Vulnerable and Slow: Blood Mist makes enemies Vulnerable and Slows them by 70% for 4 seconds.

blood of bartuc.description: The Fell Council in the Infernal Hordes has +1 Monster Power. After defeating the Fell Council, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items associated with Bartuc.
blood of bartuc.name: Blood of Bartuc

blood surge.description: Draw blood from enemies, dealing 20 damage, then expel a blood nova, dealing 100 damage. Blood Surge's nova damage is increased by x5% per enemy drained, up to x50%.
blood surge.name: Blood Surge

runes.Bloodbath: Blood Surge's nova echoes again after a short delay, dealing 100 damage.
runes.Damage Bonus: Blood Surge deals x25% increased damage while you are Healthy.
runes.Fortify: Blood Surge Fortifies you for 2% of your Maximum Life for each enemy drawn from, up to 10%.
runes.Overpower: Blood Surge consumes 2 stacks of Overpower to gain 25% increased Size and x50% increased damage.
runes.Pins and Needles: Blood Surge becomes a Bone Skill and, instead of expelling a blood nova, expels 10 piercing bone shards dealing 60 damage each. Instead of dealing increased damage, Blood Surge expels 1 additional shard for each enemy drawn from, up to 5 additional shards.
runes.Weaken: Blood Surge Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.
runes.You And What Army?: Blood Surge expels smaller blood novas on your Minions, dealing 20 damage. Blood Surge's minion nova damage is increased by x5% for each enemy drawn from, up to x50%.

blood wave.description:
Conjure a tidal wave of blood that deals 500 damage and Knocks Back
enemies.
blood wave.name: Blood Wave

runes.Blood Orb: Blood Wave forms up to 2 Blood Orbs as it travels.
runes.Damage Bonus: Blood Wave deals x30% increased damage while you are Fortified.
runes.Damage Reduction: Casting Blood Wave grants 10% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.
runes.Hematolagnia: Blood Wave becomes a Core Skill, has no Cooldown, but costs 50 Essence. Blood Wave conjures a shorter wave that deals 300 damage and no longer Knocks Back enemies.
runes.Overpower: Casting Blood Wave overfills your Overpower by 2.
runes.Path to Darkness: Blood Wave becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Blood Wave leaves behind a trail of Desecrated Ground as it travels that deals 600 Corrupting damage.
runes.Tides of Blood: Blood Wave launches 1 additional wave, dealing 500 damage.

bloodlust.description: Varyana's Bloodthirst further increases your Attack Speed by +5%.
bloodlust.name: Bloodlust

bloodthirst.description: Varyana enters Bloodthirst, gaining +30% Attack Speed, +200% Movement Speed, and Unstoppable for 7 seconds. Varyana's Bloodthirst grants +10% Attack Speed to you for the same duration.
bloodthirst.name: Bloodthirst

bolster.description: Defensive Skills gain 40% increased Cooldown Reduction Rate while you are Fortified. This Rate is split amongst each equipped Defensive Skill.
bolster.name: Bolster

bombardment.description: Smash down 4 demons into the ground, each dealing 40 damage.
bombardment.name: Bombardment

runes.Brutality: Each cast of Bombardment within 3 seconds of the last calls down more demons, up to 4 additional.
runes.Damage: Each Cast of Bombardment deals 5% increased damage to each enemy per hit.
runes.Demon Mangler: Bombardment is also a Summon Skill and each impact has a 40% chance to leave behind mutilated demons for 8 seconds that attack surrounding enemies, dealing 20*2 damage.
runes.Endless Barrage: Bombardment becomes a Hellfire Skill and now only slams down demons randomly around yourself but demons continue to rain down around you for 10 seconds afterwards. This effect can stack up to 5 times.
runes.Focused Target: Bombardment's chaotic spread is reduced by 300% and it deals 30% increased damage when only hitting a single enemy.
runes.Telekinesis: Each time Bombardment throws a demon it has a 100% chance to also throw a surrounding Lesser Demon at your target location.

bone prison.description: Unearth a prison of bone with X Life that surrounds the target area for value1 seconds.
bone prison.name: Bone Prison

runes.Bramble: You gain X Thorns for each enemy trapped by Bone Prison. When a segment of Bone Prison is destroyed or expires, it deals 100% of your Thorns around itself.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Bone Prison reduces your active Cooldowns by 0.5 seconds for each enemy trapped, up to 5 seconds.
runes.Essence Generation: Casting Bone Prison generates 50 Essence. Trapping a Boss generates an additional 25 Essence.
runes.Life Imprisonment: Bone Prison becomes a Blood Skill, casting the prison around you. While standing within it your Essence Generation and Cast Speed are increased by value2 , but it drains 5% of your Maximum Life every second.
runes.Plunging Darkness: Bone Prison becomes a Darkness Skill. Bone Prison forms a Corpse every second and spawns a pool of Desecrated Ground, dealing 300 Corrupting damage.
runes.Resolve: Bone Prison grants 1 stack of Resolve for each enemy trapped.
runes.Vulnerable: Bone Prison makes enemies Vulnerable for 8 seconds.

bone spear.description: Conjure a bone spear from the ground that pierces enemies, dealing 130 damage.
bone spear.name: Bone Spear

runes.Blood Spear: Bone Spear becomes a Blood Skill that deals 130 damage. Casting Bone Spear consumes a nearby Corpse and conjures a second Bone Spear from it, dealing 100% of normal damage.
runes.Bone Spikes: Bone Spear breaks into 3 piercing bone shards when it is destroyed, dealing 43 damage each.
runes.Cost Reduction: Bone Spear's Essence cost is reduced by 5.
runes.First Hit Damage Bonus: Bone Spear deals x40% increased damage to the first enemy hit.
runes.Pierce Damage Bonus: Bone Spear deals x10% increased damage per enemy pierced, up to x50%.
runes.Resolve: Bone Spear deals x5% increased Critical Strike Damage per stack of Resolve, up to x40%.
runes.Shadow Splitter: Bone Spear becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 163 Shadow damage. Instead of piercing through, Bone Spear forks into 2 piercing spears each time it hits an enemy or wall, up to 2 times.

bone spirit.description: Conjure a spirit of bone that seeks enemies and explodes, dealing 150 damage.
bone spirit.name: Bone Spirit

runes.Astral Projection: Bone Spirit no longer seeks enemies and instead spirals around you, piercing through enemies and exploding for 100 damage when it hits them.
runes.Charges: Bone Spirit gains 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds.
runes.Core Skill: Bone Spirit becomes a Core Skill, costs 30 Essence, and no longer has a Cooldown. Bone Spirit will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast, dealing x3% increased damage for each point of Essence consumed.
runes.Damage Bonus: Every second, your next Bone Spirit deals x10% increased damage, up to x30%.
runes.Maximum Essence: Each enemy hit by Bone Spirit increases your Maximum Essence by 2 for 15 seconds, up to 20 Essence.
runes.Poltergeists: When Bone Spirit explodes, it spawns 3 smaller spirits that seek enemmies and explode for 30 damage each.
runes.Unfinished Business:
Bone Spirit becomes a Darkness Skill that deals
Shadow damage. Bone Spirit leaves behind a pool of Desecrated Ground when it explodes, dealing 250 Corrupting damage.

bone splinters.description: Fire 3 splinters of bone, dealing 30 damage each.
bone splinters.name: Bone Splinters

runes.Bloody Splinter: Bone Splinters becomes a Blood Skill that deals 30 damage and pierces 1 time. Each time a splinter hits an enemy you Heal for value1 of your Maximum Life.
runes.Bouncing Spines: Bone Splinters now deals 45 damage with each splinter, bounces off walls, and travels further.
runes.Resolve: Bone Splinters grants 1 stack of Resolve.
runes.Shadow Seekers: Bone Splinters becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 30 Shadow damage and seeks enemies When a splinter hits an enemy it causes a burst of shadow, dealing an additional 8 damage.
runes.Vulnerable: Bone Splinters makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

bone storm.description: A swirling storm of bones appears around you and your Golem, dealing 400 to surrounding enemies over 10 seconds.
bone storm.name: Bone Storm

runes.Barrier: Casting Bone Storm grants a Barrier for 50% of your Maximum Life for 10 seconds.
runes.Damage Reduction: Bone Storm increases your Damage Reduction by 10%.
runes.Duration Increase: Bone Storm consumes up to 4 corpses to increase its duration by 2 seconds per corpse.
runes.Hungry Cyclone: Bone Storm is cast at the target location and seeks enemies. Its Cooldown is reduced by value2 seconds.
runes.Roll the Bones: Bone Storm increases your Critical Strike Chance and Cast Speed by + value1 .
runes.Shadow and Bone: Bone Storm becomes a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Enemies damaged by it suffer an additional 40 Corrupting damage over 2 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Bone Storm makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

boulder.description: Unearth a large rolling boulder that repeatedly Knocks Back enemies, dealing 60 damage with each hit.
boulder.name: Boulder

runes.Additional Boulder: Boulder has a 20% chance to launch an additional Boulder for free.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Boulder gains +10% Critical Strike Chance. Additionally, Boulder gains an extra +1%increased Critical Strike Chance per stack of Resolve active.
runes.Crushing Impact: Boulder deals x300% increased damage to the first enemy hit. This bonus is reduced by x50% for each subsequent enemy hit afterward.
runes.Dolmen's Will:
Boulder becomes a Core Skill that costs 60 Spirit,
has no Cooldown, and may be cast while moving. Boulder now orbits you. You may have max 5 Boulders orbiting at once.
runes.Fortify: Boulder grants 20% of your Maximum Life as Fortify when it successfully hits a target.
runes.Landslip: Boulder can now be cast at the target location. Boulder deals 200% bonus damage to the enemy it lands on.
runes.Slow: Enemies hit by Boulder are Slowed by 70% for 3 seconds.

bound by blood.description: Bloodseekers are connected with flaming chains. When slain, Bloodseekers drop items that match the category of the last opened Tortured Gift.
bound by blood.name: Bound by Blood

branching pathways.description: When advancing to the next dungeon in a Nightmare Escalation, 2 additional Horadric Portals appear.
branching pathways.name: Branching Pathways

brandish.description: Brandish the Light, unleashing an arc that deals 75 damage.
brandish.name: Brandish

runes.Cross Strike: Brandish unleashes 2 additional arcs, dealing 120 damage.
runes.Returning Light: Brandish's light returns to you, dealing 52 damage on its return.
runes.Sword Mastery: While Healthy, Brandish deals 128 damage and travels 100% faster.
runes.Vulnerable: Brandish applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds.

burning chaos.description: Aldkin's Wave of Flame Cooldown resets when you cast an Ultimate Skill.
burning chaos.name: Burning Chaos

bursting brood.description: Maggots and Pangs of Duriel explode when killed and will often drop Boss Trophies.
bursting brood.name: Bursting Brood

calamity.description: Extend the duration of Ultimate Skills by 35%.
calamity.name: Calamity

call of the ancients.description: Summon 3 Ancients to aid you in battle for 10 seconds.
call of the ancients.name: Call of the Ancients

runes.Attack Speed and Damage Bonus: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain +5% Attack Speed and x5% increased damage for each Ancient Summoned for 6 seconds.
runes.Damage Bonus: You and each of your Ancients summoned from this Skill increase each other's damage by x7%.
runes.Damage Reduction: When you Cast Call of the Ancients, gain 5% Damage Reduction for each Ancient summoned while they are active.
runes.Empowered: Your Ancients are empowered: Korlic creates an Earthquake that deals 99 Physical damage over 4 seconds when he leaps. Talic leaves behind Dust Devils that deal 72 damage while he whirlwinds. Madawc ignites the earth, Burning enemies for an additional 45 damage over 4 seconds when he upheaves the ground.
runes.Highlander: Summon a single. permanent Ancient. Using this skill again replaces it with the next Ancient.
runes.The Chosen:
Depending on your last used weapon, you
summon 1 very strong Ancient for twice as long. Your Ancient gains an additional power: Korlic: You gain 10 Fury each time Korlic damages an enemy with his Frenzy. Talic: Enemies are Slowed by 50% for 1 second when damaged by his Whirlwind. Madawc: 30% chance to Stun enemies for 3 seconds when using his Upheaval.

calm before the storm.description: Lucky Hit: Nature Magic Skills have up to a 10% chance to reduce the Cooldown of your Ultimate Skill by 2 seconds.
calm before the storm.name: Calm Before the Storm

caltrops.description: Throw caltrops on the ground, dealing 60 damage. Affected enemies take 10 damage every second and are Slowed by value1 . Lasts 6 seconds.
caltrops.name: Caltrops

runes.Catch Cold: Caltrops now deals Cold damage and Chills enemies for value2 per second.
runes.Critical Strike: You now have +10% Critical Strike Chance against enemies inside your Caltrops. Double this amount against Vulnerable enemies.
runes.Duration: Caltrops' duration is increased by 2 seconds.
runes.Ferocity: Casting Caltrops grants 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Mired Sharpshooter: Caltrops no longer Slows enemies and instead is also a Marksman Skill that throws 24 piercing daggers over its duration, each dealing 6 Shadow damage. Enemies damaged by Caltrops become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Pernicious Poisons: Throw 3 smaller Caltrops that now deal Poison damage and 105 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Enemies affected by this Poisoning are Weakened

cataclysm.description: A massive storm follows you for 8 seconds. Twisters Knock Back enemies dealing 46 damage, and lightning strikes wildly dealing 115 damage.
cataclysm.name: Cataclysm

runes.Duration: Cataclysm's duration is increased by 4 seconds.
runes.Ferocity: Casting Cataclysm grants 4 stacks of Ferocity.
runes.Severe Storm: Cataclysm spawns double the Twister and Lightning Bolts. In addition, Lighting Bolt strikes have a 20% chance to spawn 2-4 Dancing Bolts that deal 40 damage.
runes.Slow:
Casting Cataclysm Slows surrounding enemies
by 70% for 8 seconds.
runes.Tectonic Spikes: Cataclysm is also an Earth Skill. Cataclysm additionally summons Tectonic Spikes around you for the duration dealing 165 Physical damage.
runes.Terrible Twisters: All Twisters now orbit you and deal x200% bonus damage.
runes.Vulnerable: Enemies hit by Cataclysm are Vulnerable.

centipede.description: Hitting an enemy with a Centipede Skill reduces their Damage by 4%, Slows them by 10%, and deals 350% Poisoning damage over 8 seconds, stacking up to a maximum of 8 times. All Skills are now also Centipede Skills.
centipede.name: Centipede

chain lightning.description: Unleash a bolt of lightning that chains up to 5 times, dealing 43 damage. If Chain Lightning fails to chain, x50% of the remaining chains damage is dealt as additional damage to the final target.
chain lightning.name: Chain Lightning

runes.Chain Whipping: Chain Lightning gains +20% Cast Speed and its number of chains is doubled.
runes.Chain of Cold: Chain Lightning becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Chain Lightning Chills by 25% and deals up to x100% increased damage based on how Chilled the enemy is, dealing the maximum damage if they are Frozen.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Chain Lightning forms a Crackling Energy whenever it Critically Strikes. Chain Lightning gains +5% Critical Strike Chance.
runes.Damage Bonus: Chain Lightning deals x100% increased damage to the first enemy hit.
runes.Power Flux: Chain Lightning alternates between chaining to an enemy and to you. When it chains to you, it gains x45% increased damage, up to x180%, and does not use a chain.
runes.Ramping Damage: Every Second, Chain Lightning gains x5% increased damage, up to x25%. This bonus is reset when you damage an enemy with a Skill Cast other than Chain Lightning.

chain of souls.description: Aldkin chains up to 10 enemies to himself, Tethering to them and dealing 84% Shadow damage over 3 seconds. When the chains expire, they deal 35% Shadow damage and Stun their victims for 2.5 seconds.
chain of souls.name: Chain of Souls

challenging shout.description: Taunt Nearby enemies and gain value1 Damage Reduction for 8 seconds.
challenging shout.name: Challenging Shout

runes.Bawl: Challenging Shout's grants an additional 20% Damage Reduction that decays over its duration.
runes.Damage Bonus: The first 5 enemies Taunted by Challenging Shout take x20% increased damage from you.
runes.Duration Bonus: Challenging Shout's duration is increased by 2 seconds.
runes.Fury Generation: Taking damage while Challenging Shout is active will generate 3 Fury.
runes.Raging: Challenging Shout causes enemies to burn with rage, dealing 600 Burning damage over 8 seconds. You no longer gain Damage Reduction from Challenging Shout but instead gain x20% increased damage against Burning enemies.
runes.Talic: Challenging Shout Summons Talic, who spins in a whirlwind rapidly attacking enemies for 80 damage.
runes.Weaken: Challenging Shout Weakens enemies.

chaotic echoes.description: Collapsed Chaos Rifts have a chance to reopen.
chaotic echoes.name: Chaotic Echoes

chaotic favor.description: Completing a Whisper has a small chance to award a Collection of Chaos.
chaotic favor.name: Chaotic Favor

charge.description: Rush forward and push enemies before swinging your weapon, dealing 180 damage and Knocking Back enemies.
charge.name: Charge

runes.Battering Ram: Charge now deals Fire damage. Instead of swinging your weapon, colliding with enemies deals 63 Fire damage and Stuns them for 3 seconds. Additionally, you leave a burning trail that inflicts 252 Burning damage over 3 seconds.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Charge's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second for each enemy hit, up to 3 seconds.
runes.Distance Damage Bonus: Charge deals up to x22% increased damage based on distance traveled.
runes.Enemy Damage Bonus: Charge deals x5% increased damage per enemy pushed, up to x20%.
runes.Merciless Assault: Charge gains 3 Charges, and all of its Charges are refreshed on Cooldown.
runes.Phalanx: Charge Summons 2 Ancients to Charge with you and swing for 67 damage.

charged bolts.description: Release 3 bolts of piercing lightning that course along the ground, dealing 60 damage each.
charged bolts.name: Charged Bolts

runes.Burn Through: Charged Bolts becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals Fire damage, and costs 30 Mana. Each bolt no longer pierces and instead releases 2 to 3 explosions on impact, dealing an additional 180 damage.
runes.Cast Speed: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains +5% Cast Speed, up to +15%. Moving removes this effect. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.
runes.Damage Bonus: Charged Bolts deals x15% increased damage to Close enemies. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.
runes.Movement Speed: Each time you cast Charged Bolts it gains x4% bolt speed and you gain 4% Movement Speed for 4 seconds, up to x20%. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.
runes.Overload: Casting Charged Bolts now also discharges Crackling Energy in an electric wave, dealing its damage to all enemies caught in it. Crackling Energy will no longer automatically pulse its last 3 charges.
runes.Surging Charge: Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt, plus 1 additional bolt per stack of Ferocity.
runes.Weaken: Charged Bolts Weakens enemies for 6 seconds. Charged Bolts releases 1 additional bolt.

children of zir.description: When exploring the Pit, Lord Zir's Bloodseekers can now ambush you. Killing them in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.
children of zir.name: Children of Zir

choron s blessing.description: Gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for completing The Pit.
choron s blessing.name: Choron's Blessing

choron s favor.description: Special events and encounters become more common in higher Difficulty Tiers of The Pit.
choron s favor.name: Choron's Favor

choron s flesh.description: Choron's Flesh now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone. Choron's Flesh will allow you to get valuable Equipment by consuming one of your Glyph Upgrade Chances.
choron s flesh.name: Choron's Flesh

choron s haste.description: The Pit gains the Haste Mastery objective. When you kill the Guardian gain +1 Glyph Upgrade Chance for every 5 minutes left on the Timer.
choron s haste.name: Choron's Haste

choron s shortcut.description: Choron's Portal randomly appears in The Pit which teleports you to an Elite, Shrine, or other Pit Object.
choron s shortcut.name: Choron's Shortcut

choron s soul.description: Choron's Soul now spawns with the Awakened Glyphstone. Choron's Soul will drop 1 Progress Orb per Glyph Upgrade Chance offered. All Progress Orbs in The Pit now grant Experience.
choron s soul.name: Choron's Soul

choron s wager.description: Choron's Wager can appear in The Pit. Activate it with Artificer's Stones to acquire a challenge, which grants a large amount of Artificer's Stones when completed.
choron s wager.name: Choron's Wager

cipher maps.description: Whenever you would reveal a Horadric Altar, you reveal 2 instead.
cipher maps.name: Cipher Maps

clash.description: Strike an enemy with your weapon and shield, dealing 115 damage. Striking enemies with Clash grants you Crusader's March, increasing your Block Chance by +30% for 6 seconds.
clash.name: Clash

runes.Crusader's March Effectiveness: Increase the effect of Crusader's March by x25%.
runes.Punishment:
You are emboldened during Crusader's March, granting:
- +30% Retribution Chance
- X Thorns
- x20% Thorns damage
runes.Resolve: Striking an enemy with Clash grants 2 stacks of Resolve.
runes.Seize Them: Your Resolve empowers Clash, dealing x8% increased damage per stack of Resolve, up to 16 stacks. Every 3rd strike, enemies are Pulled in.
runes.Skirmish: Clash becomes a Zealot Skill and cleaves in an area for 155 damage. Crusaders March no longer grants Block Chance or Resolve, instead granting +10% Critical Strike Chance up to +30%.

claw.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and claw at enemies dealing 80 Physical damage.
claw.name: Claw

runes.Cast Speed: Claw's Cast Speed is increased by 20%.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Claw's Critical Strike Chance is increased by +20%.
runes.Dash: Claw now dashes you towards your target and deals 60 damage.
runes.Ferocity: Gain 1 stack of Ferocity per cast when dealing damage.
runes.Lightning Claw: Claw is also a Storm Skill Claw deals 128 Lightning damage and enemies have a 20% chance to spawn 3 Dancing Bolts that deal 35 each.
runes.Viper Strikes: Claw attacks twice and deals 64 damage and an additional 28 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to enemies hit.

cleave.description: Varyana swings two axes in an arc in front of her, dealing 60% Physical damage and 24% Bleeding damage over 4 seconds. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.
cleave.name: Cleave

cold imbuement.description: Imbue your weapons with frigid energies for 6 seconds. While Imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Cold damage, Chill enemies for value1 per hit, and Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.
cold imbuement.name: Cold Imbuement

runes.Buffered Battery: Lucky Hit: Cold Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to encase you in a Barrier for value3 of your Maximum Life, up to value4 , for 6 seconds. This Barrier reduces your Energy costs by 20%.
runes.Cooldown: When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, Cold Imbuement's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Crystal Distillation: When Cold Imbuement is Cast it now also creates a frigid emanation around you for 6 seconds that deals 75 Cold damage and Chills any enemies within for 15% every 0.5 seconds.
runes.Energy: Cold Imbued Skills grant 4 Energy when hitting an enemy for the first time.
runes.Frozen Heart: Cold Imbued Skills cause enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds. Cold Imbuement's Duration is increased by x value2 .
runes.Overpower: When you Freeze an enemy while Cold Imbued, gain 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Resolve: When Cold Imbuement Chills an enemy, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Resolve.

colossal foe.description: Whisper Ambushes sometimes include Bosses. These Bosses will always burst out the contents of a Greater Collection of Chaos when slain.
colossal foe.name: Colossal Foe

combo points.description: Your Basic Skills now generate Combo Points. Core Skills consume Combo Points for additional effects.
combo points.name: Combo Points

command fallen.description: Summon a Fallen Lunatic that charges your target and explodes, dealing 80 damage.
command fallen.name: Command Fallen

runes.Damage Per Demon: Command Fallen deals x1% increased damage for every Demon you have active, up to x20%.
runes.Dominance: Every 15 times you hit enemies with Command Fallen you gain 1 Dominance.
runes.Fallen Rush: Command Fallen is also an Abyss Skill and now summons up to 3 Fallen Grunts for 30 seconds which deal 48 damage and generate 8 Wrath per hit. Recasting while all are active will direct them to move or target on your command.
runes.Lifetime Damage: Your Demons summoned by Command Fallen deal x8% increased damage for every second they are alive, up to x30%.
runes.Meat Shields: Command Fallen becomes a Hellfire Skill and passively summons a Lunatic every 5 seconds that follows you around and detonates when enemies get close, up to 5 Lunatics. Summon rate is based on your Attack Speed.
runes.Mega Lunatic: Command Fallen summons a Mega Lunatic which deals 136 damage and bursts into 3 Mini Lunatics which each deal 40 damage.
runes.Wrath: Command Fallen generates 1 additional Wrath for every Demon or Enemy you have killed in the last 2 seconds, up to 5 additional Wrath.

concealment.description: Vanish from sight, gaining an advanced form of Stealth for 5 seconds that will not be removed by taking damage. Concealment also makes you Unstoppable, grants + value1 Movement Speed, and Unhindered for its duration. Using an attack Skill during Concealment will break Concealment.
concealment.name: Concealment

runes.Calculation: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Overpower. After breaking Concealment, you gain + value2 increased Critical Strike Chance for the next 6 seconds.
runes.Concealing Fate: When you break Concealment, all Nearby enemies are covered in a shadowy mist for 4 seconds, causing them to become Vulnerable and explode for 150 Shadow damage when it expires.
runes.Ferocity: Gain 2 stacks of Ferocity after breaking Concealment when Cast.
runes.Recuperate: Entering Concealment Fortifies you for value3 of your Maximum Life over 5 seconds. Breaking Concealment Knocks Down Close enemies for 2 seconds.
runes.Resolve: Casting Concealment grants 4 stacks of Resolve.
runes.Unstoppable: Unstoppable persists for 4 seconds after breaking Concealment when Cast.

concussive stomp.description: Stomp in front of you, releasing a shockwave that deals 65 damage and Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.
concussive stomp.name: Concussive Stomp

runes.Additional Charge: Concussive Stomp gains an additional Charge.
runes.Barrier Generation: Concussive Stomp grants a Barrier equal to 10% of your Maximum Life per enemy hit for 3 seconds, up to 30%.
runes.Crackling Earth: Concussive Stomp becomes an Eagle Skill, deals Lightning damage, and has a 7 second Cooldown. Concussive Stomp electrifies the ground, Sparking enemies for 400 Damage over 2 seconds and causing them to drop a Storm Feather.
runes.Crushing Blow: Concussive Stomp hits in a circle around you and deals 500% increased damage to Unstoppable enemies and Bosses.
runes.Damage Bonus: Concussive Stomp deals 100% more damage.
runes.Debilitate: Concussive Stomp grants you 15% Damage Reduction for 4 seconds. When enemies recover from a Concussive Stomp, they have 30% reduced Attack Speed for 4 seconds.

condemn.description: Harness the Light and Pull enemies in after 1.5 seconds, briefly Stunning them and dealing 240 damage. While Casting Condemn, you become Unhindered for 1.5 seconds.
condemn.name: Condemn

runes.Atonement: Condemn Casts significantly faster instead of Pulling enemies in, dealing 420 damage.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Condemn reduces its cooldown by 1 second for each enemy hit, up to 4 seconds.
runes.Gather the Guilty: Condemn now has 1 additional Charge and applies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Movement Speed: Casting Condemn increases your Movement Speed by 30% for 3 seconds.
runes.Shepherd the Flock: Condemn's build up marks all enemies and drags them to your location after it Casts.
runes.Weaken: Condemn applies Weaken to enemies for 4 seconds.

condemned.description: You instantly kill Languishing enemies with less than 40% Life. Does not work on Elites.
condemned.name: Condemned

consecrated shield.description: Raheir's Shield Throw Consecrates enemies for 6 seconds. Directly damaging a Consecrated enemy Heals you for 6% of your Maximum Life, once per target.
consecrated shield.name: Consecrated Shield

consecration.description: Bathe in the Light for 6 seconds, Healing you and your allies for value1 Maximum Life per second and damaging enemies for 75 damage per second.
consecration.name: Consecration

runes.Bastion: Consecration Immobilizes enemies and can be cast anywhere.
runes.Duration: Increase the duration of Consecration by x35%.
runes.Fortify: Consecration's initial Cast Fortifies you for 0.5% of Maximum Life per enemy hit.
runes.Hallowed Ground: Consecration's size is increased by 56%. While inside Consecration, you and your allies deal x7% additional damage and consume x15% less resource.
runes.Resource Generation: Consecration increases Primary Resource Generation for you and your allies by +10%.
runes.Sanctify: Consecration lasts 3 seconds, increasing its damage and Healing by 20% each second. Consecration detonates when it expires, dealing 139 damage to all enemies and Healing you and your allies for 15% of their Maximum Life.
runes.Weaken: Consecration Weakens enemies within.

control impaired.description: Cast when the player is hit with a Control Impairing Effect.
control impaired.name: Control Impaired

corpse explosion.description: Detonate a Corpse, dealing 110 damage to enemies.
corpse explosion.name: Corpse Explosion

runes.Blood Orb: Corpse Explosion has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.
runes.Bloody Mess: Corpse Explosion's Size is increased by 50% and damage is increased by x75%.
runes.Corpse Efficiency: Corpses consumed by Corpse Explosion can be consumed 1 additional time.
runes.Miasma: Corpse Explosion is also a Darkness Skill and, instead of exploding, releases a vile miasma dealing 210 Corrupting damage over 6 seconds.
runes.Multiple Corpses: Corpse Explosion detonates up to 2 additional corpses.
runes.Shrapnel: Corpse Explosion is also a Bone Skill and, instead of exploding, fires 8 piercing bone shards dealing 110 damage each.

corpse tendrils.description: Burst veins out of a Corpse, Slowing enemies by 50% for 1.5 seconds before Pulling them in and dealing value1 damage.
corpse tendrils.name: Corpse Tendrils

runes.Bitter Harvest: Corpse Tendrils no longer consumes the Corpse. Enemies are Immobilized for 3 seconds after being Pulled in.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: You gain an additional +5% increased Critical Strike Chance for 6 seconds against enemies damaged by Corpse Tendrils.
runes.Get Over Here!: Corpse Tendrils is no longer cast on a Corpse and is cast on you instead. Corpse Tendrils Fortifies you for 5% of your Maximum Life for each enemy it damages.
runes.Jaws of Death: Corpse Tendrils now deals 100 damage and no longer has a delay before Pulling in enemies.
runes.Lucky Hit Chance: Corpse Tendrils gains an additional +40% Lucky Hit Chance.
runes.Vulnerable: Corpse Tendrils makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

corrupted roots.description: Whisper Caches sometimes contain Corrupted Roots. Plant Corrupted Roots to grow an Exposed Root. These will attract nearby enemies, and have a chance to grow larger and summon more fearsome enemies. The regions of Sanctuary each bear different fruit.
corrupted roots.name: Corrupted Roots

council coffers.description: The Chest of Talismans will appear after defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc.
council coffers.name: Council Coffers

counterattack.description: Passive: Gain value1 Dodge Chance and automatically retaliate against Close enemies for 80 damage when you Dodge their attacks. Active: Dodge all direct attacks for 3 seconds per cast, up to 6 seconds.
counterattack.name: Counterattack

runes.Asymmetrical Warfare: Counterattack's Passive now also retaliates against all Close enemies for 100 damage when you Dodge any attack.
runes.Controlled Reflection: When you Dodge a Control Impairing attack with Counterattack it will reflect that Crowd Control to all Close enemies for 2 seconds.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Counterattack's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds per stack of Ferocity you have.
runes.Counterattack of the Swarm: Counterattack becomes a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage. Passive: Your Pestilent Swarms Weaken enemies. Active: Send out 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 150 damage each second for 3 seconds.
runes.Damage Bonus: Counterattack deals x30% increased damage.
runes.Damage Over Time Reduction: Counterattack's Passive reduces Damage Over Time effects on you by 20%.
runes.Duration Increase: Counterattack's duration is increased by 1 second.

cover fire.description: Subo charges a countless volley of arrows, then unleashes it over your position for 140% Physical damage that Slows enemies by 50% for 4 seconds.
cover fire.name: Cover Fire

covered in ash.description: Hits of Aldkin's Flame Surge Slows enemies by 20% and deal an additional 60% Burning damage over 3 seconds.
covered in ash.name: Covered in Ash

crater.description: Raheir strikes the ground 3 times, each burst dealing 30% Physical damage and Pulling In enemies. The final burst additionally deals 40% more Physical damage and Stuns enemies for 2 seconds.
crater.name: Crater

crimson scent.description: Hellwyrms will always call forth Bloodseekers that gain +1 Monster Power. Greater Bloodseekers may also emerge, which have a high chance to drop Legendary items when slain.
crimson scent.name: Crimson Scent

crushing force.description: When Varyana deals damage to an enemy, she has a 30% chance to Knock them Down for 2 seconds.
crushing force.name: Crushing Force

crushing hand.description: Smash down next to you with devastating force, creating 2 shockwaves on either side that overlap and each deal 75 damage.
crushing hand.name: Crushing Hand

runes.100 Crushing Hands: Crushing Hand becomes a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage. Crushing Hand sends centipedes scuttling across the ground, Poisoning enemies for 300 damage over 6 seconds. Enemies Poisoned from Crushing Hand are Weakened.
runes.Barrier: Crushing Hand grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds, up to 30%.
runes.Block to Damage: Blocking increases the damage of Crushing Hand by x5% for 5 seconds, up to x25%.
runes.Heavy Hitter: Crushing Hand smashes a single time in a smaller area in front of you, dealing 300 damage and 150% of your Thorns.
runes.Increased Cost and Damage: Crushing Hand costs 100% more Vigor but deals x50% more damage.
runes.Resolve: Crushing Hand grants Resolve.
runes.Unrelenting Assault: Every 3rd Crushing Hand smashes 12 additional times dealing 30 damage each.

cult of annihilation.description: Doomsayers appear during the Infernal Hordes. Doomsayers are dangerous enemies but also drop Aether.
cult of annihilation.name: Cult of Annihilation

cursed merchant.description: The Cursed Merchant has a chance to appear when completing the Pit. The Cursed Merchant will sell Equipment for Artificers Stones.
cursed merchant.name: Cursed Merchant

cursed offerings.description: Cursed Machines have a chance to appear while exploring the Pit. Cursed Machines cost Artificers Stones to activate. Activating one will grant you valuable materials and attract vicious enemies. The more Cursed Machines you find in a single Pit run, the more lucrative the rewards will become.
cursed offerings.name: Cursed Offerings

cursed rituals.description: Different Ritual Sites now spawn in the Pit, and special Materials can spawn in different environments:
cursed rituals.name: Cursed Rituals

cyclone armor.description: Passive: Powerful winds surround you, granting a value1 bonus to All Resistances. Active: The winds rapidly expand, Knocking Back enemies and dealing value2 damage.
cyclone armor.name: Cyclone Armor

runes.Damage Bonus: Active: Cyclone Armor's damage is increased by 200%.
runes.Greater Cyclone Armor: All bonuses and damage from Cyclone Armor are increased by 100%.
runes.Increased Radius: Active: Cyclone Armor's radius is increased by 50%.
runes.Resistance: Passive: Gain an additional +20% bonus to All Resistances.
runes.Reversal: The active winds are reversed pulling enemies towards you instead. In addition, the area of effect is increased by x30%.
runes.Slipstream: Cyclone Armor Knocks Down enemies hit for 3 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Passive: Enemies who strike you become Vulnerable for 5 seconds.

damned thieves.description: Orb Thieves have a chance to spawn in The Pit. Orb Thieves drop an immense amount of Progress Orbs when killed, but leave a trail of Traps in their wake.
damned thieves.name: Damned Thieves

dance of knives.description: Channel to launch knives at surrounding enemies with each knife dealing 52 damage. Attack Speed increases damage done rather than number of knives thrown.
dance of knives.name: Dance of Knives

runes.Energy Cost Reduction: Dance of Knives' Energy Cost is reduced to 20.
runes.Fan of Knives: Dance of Knives now throws a fan of 5 knives that each deal 36 damage.
runes.Grenade Jumper: Dance of Knives now drops grenades instead of knives, each dealing 104 . Dance of Knives is also a Grenade Skill.
runes.Lucky Hit: Dance of Knives gains x20% increased Lucky Hit Chance.
runes.Pierce and Size: Dance of Knives' knives has a 33% chance to pierce and grenades' explosion area is increased by +25%.
runes.Slow and Movement Speed: Dance of Knives Slows enemies hit by 25% for 4 seconds and grants x12% Movement Speed while Channeling.
runes.Star Shards: Knives have a 50% chance to shatter into 6 shards of metal on hit, dealing 26 damage. Dance of Knives becomes a Marksman Skill.

dark prison.description: Create a shadowy totem for value1 seconds that chains enemies, Tethering them to the area and preventing them from escaping.
dark prison.name: Dark Prison

runes.Calamity: Dark Prison now lasts 50% longer but you can only have one at a time. When the prison ends all enemies within take 30 damage, increased by 100% per enemy within. Non-Elite enemies within the prison cannot die while it is active. Recast to collapse the prison early.
runes.Chain Aura: Dark Prison becomes a Hellfire Skill and now creates an aura of fire chains around you, reducing damage coming from outside by 45% and Slowing enemies within by 80%.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Enemies killed within Dark Prison reduce its cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Fortify: Hitting enemies within Dark Prison Fortifies you for 1% Maximum Life.
runes.Missile Slow: Small Missiles that enter Dark Prison are Slowed by 99%.
runes.Tripwire: Casting Dark Prison refreshes and creates a link to your last prison, enemies that cross the line will be Pulled into the new prison. Chain Prison gains an additional charge.
runes.Weaken: Enemies within Dark Prison are Weakened.

dark shroud.description: Surround yourself with up to 5 protective shadows. Gain + value1 Resistance to All per active shadow. If you have the maximum amount of shadows, direct damage is reduced by 20%. Each time you take direct damage, a shadow is consumed.
dark shroud.name: Dark Shroud

runes.Best Served Cold: When a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed, it explodes in a frigid nova that deals 60 Cold damage to surrounding enemies and Chills them for 30%.
runes.Consume Chance: Dark Shroud shadows have a 15% chance to not be consumed.
runes.Critical Strike: While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain +10% Critical Strike Chance.
runes.Healing: You Heal for 10% of your Maximum Life when a Dark Shroud shadow is consumed.
runes.Movement Speed: Each active Dark Shroud shadow grants you x5% Movement Speed.
runes.Overflow: Dark Shroud no longer grants Resistance to All Elements, but instead grants you x value3 increased Energy Regeneration per shadow.
runes.Shadow Dancer: Casting Dark Shroud increases your Dodge Chance by 50% for 2 seconds. While you have at least 1 active shadow from Dark Shroud, gain value2 Dodge Chance.

dash.description: Dash forward and slash enemies for 65 damage. Any enemies hit are Slowed by 30% for 4 seconds.
dash.name: Dash

runes.Charges and Cooldown Reduction: Dash has 1 additional Charge and its Charge Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Damaging enemies with Dash increases their chance to be Critically Struck by +5% for 8 seconds.
runes.Detonation: Dash is also a Grenade Skill. At the end of Dash, explode and Knock Down surrounding enemies for 2 seconds, dealing 228 damage to them.
runes.Primer: At the end of Dash, you enter Stealth for 4 seconds and gain 1 stack of Ferocity, increased by 1 per 5 Skill Ranks.
runes.Resolve: At the end of Dash, gain 2 stack of Resolve.
runes.Shadow Play: A Shade Dashes after you, dealing 130 damage. Dash's Cooldown is reduced by 1 second per enemy you hit, up to 5 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Enemies you Dash through become Weakened for 4 seconds.

death blow.description: Attempt a killing strike, dealing 300 damage to enemies in front of you. If this kills an enemy, its Cooldown is reset.
death blow.name: Death Blow

runes.Blast: Death Blow now deals Fire damage and deals an additional 225 Burning damage over 5 seconds. Enemies that die to Death Blow while Burning or to Death Blow's burn trigger a fiery explosion for 30 damage to surrounding enemies.
runes.Consecutive: Death Blow's cooldown is reduced to 3 seconds. Hitting enemies with Death Blow increases the damage of subsequent casts by x25% per hit enemy, up to x75%. Kills reset this bonus.
runes.Execute: Enemies you hit with Death Blow can be Executed by any of your attacks for the next 2 seconds, resetting Death Blow's cooldown on a successful Execution.
runes.Fury Generation: Killing an enemy with Death Blow restores 100% of your Fury.
runes.Overpower: Death Blow grants 1 stack of Overpower when it kills an enemy.
runes.Sonic Boom: Death Blow creates a shockwave that deals 525 damage.

death trap.description: Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates once an enemy is within range, dealing a total of 200 damage in the area.
death trap.name: Death Trap

runes.Cooldown: Killing an enemy or dealing damage to an Elite for the first time with Death Trap reduces its Cooldown by 1 second.
runes.Death Pit: Death Trap Pulls In enemies and makes them Vulnerable and Knocked Down for 4 seconds. Death Trap gains 1 additional charge and has its Cooldown reduced by 15 seconds.
runes.Dodge: Casting Death Trap grants you 50% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds.
runes.Explosive Trigger: Death Trap is also a Grenade Skill. Death Trap also releases 16 Stun Grenades that each explode for 20 damage.
runes.Resolve: Death Trap's damage is increased by x20% while you have Resolve.
runes.Sudden Death: Death Trap's arm time is reduced by 50%, and it deals a total of 280 damage in the area. Casting Death Trap consumes 4 stack of Overpower to reduce arm time by 100% and increase its damage by x50%.
runes.Weaken: Death Trap makes enemies Weakened for 6 seconds.

debilitating roar.description: Shapeshift into a Werebear and bellow a mighty roar reducing Nearby enemies' damage dealt by 25% for value1 seconds.
debilitating roar.name: Debilitating Roar

runes.Booming Roar: All Debilitating Roar's effects and durations are increased by 50%.
runes.Cooldown: Reduce the Cooldown of Debilitating Roar by 8 seconds.
runes.Increased Duration: Increase the duration of Debilitating Roar by 1 second or 3 seconds if you are Fortified.
runes.Maximum Life: Debilitating Roar grants you and your allies 20% bonus Maximum Life for the duration.
runes.Roar of Resolve: Debilitating Roar immediately grants 1 stack of Resolve and an additional 1 stack every second for the duration.
runes.Slow: Debilitating Roar Slows enemies by 40% for the duration.
runes.Survival Instincts: Debilitating Roar no longer has a Cooldown but costs 50 Spirit to cast instead.

decompose.description: Tear the flesh from an enemy, dealing 150 Corrupting damage per second and forming a usable Corpse with the flesh every 1 second.
decompose.name: Decompose

runes.Barrier: Decompose grants a Barrier every second for 10% of your Maximum Life that lasts 6 seconds.
runes.Damage Bonus: Decompose deals x50% increased damage
runes.Lucky Hit Chance: Decompose has an additional +30% Lucky Hit Chance.
runes.Putrid Burst: Decompose causes a burst around the target every second, dealing an additional 113 damage to them and nearby enemies.
runes.Rip and Tear: Decompose becomes a Bone Skill that deals Physical damage. Decompose now hits all other enemies in between you and the primary target.

decrepify.description: Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by Decrepify are Weakened and Slowed by value1 for 30 seconds.
decrepify.name: Decrepify

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 15% chance to reduce a random active Cooldown by 1 second.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: You have an additional +5% Critical Strike Chance against enemies afflicted with Decrepify.
runes.Dizzying Curse: The first time an enemy is afflicted with Decrepify they are Dazed for value2 seconds.
runes.Life Tap: Decrepify is also a Blood Skill, healing for value3 of your Maximum Life whenever you hit an enemy afflicted with it, up to once a second. Enemies that die while afflicted with Decrepify have a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.
runes.Movement Speed: Each enemy afflicted with Decrepify increases your Movement Speed by x2%.
runes.Resolve: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Decrepify have up to a 25% chance to grant 1 stack of Resolve.
runes.Unholy Frenzy: Instead of afflicting enemies Decrepify is now applied to your Minions, granting them x value4 increased Cast Speed and Movement Speed.

deep freeze.description: Encase yourself in ice and become Immune for 4 seconds, Chilling surrounding enemies for 13% and continuously dealing 52 damage to them. When Deep Freeze ends, you explode for an additional 180 damage. Casting Deep Freeze again ends the effect early.
deep freeze.name: Deep Freeze

runes.Bonechill: Deep Freeze's continuous and final explosion damage become Frostbite damage that deals 420 and 1440 damage over 4 seconds respectively. This Frostbite damage Chills for 100% over 4 seconds and will remove Unstoppable from enemies.
runes.Cooldown with Barrier: Cooldown speed is increased by 50% while you have a Barrier.
runes.Frigid Ward: Deep Freeze forms a Barrier that absorbs value1 of Maximum Life damage every second while active. This Barrier grants value2 Mana Regeneration.
runes.Glacier: Instead of encasing yourself and becoming Immune, Deep Freeze now forms at the target location dealing 63 damage continuously and 216 explosion damage. You remain free to act during the duration and Deep Freeze now has 3 Charges.
runes.Reduce Cooldown: Reduces your Cooldowns by 1 second and generate 8 Mana every second while active.
runes.Vulnerable and Weakened: Damage makes enemies Vulnerable and Weakened for 8 seconds.

defiance aura.description: Passive: Your presence reinforces you and your allies, granting value1 Armor and value1 bonus on All Resistances Active: You become Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
defiance aura.name: Defiance Aura

runes.Bonus Healing: Defiance Aura grants you and your allies 25% Healing received.
runes.Maximum Life: Defiance Aura's passive also grants you and your allies 15% Maximum Life.
runes.Potency: Defiance Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.
runes.Rite of Might: Defiance Aura's increases your damage by x value2 for 4 seconds whenever you gain Resolve.
runes.Rite of Prayer: Defiance Aura's passive also Heals you and your allies for value3 of your Maximum Life per second. Healing yourself and allies grants 2 stacks of Resolve every 1 second.
runes.Rite of Thorns: Defiance Aura's passive also grants X Thorns and increases you and your allies' Thorns by + value4 . Defiance Aura's active instead releases a nova dealing x500% of your Thorns damage.
runes.Unstoppable: Whenever you or an ally are Injured, they become Unstoppable for 2 seconds and gain 10 Resolve. This can only occur once every 5 seconds

devil s deal.description: At the start of the Infernal Hordes, gain an Infernal Challenge. Completing the Infernal Challenge will grant +200 Aether.
devil s deal.name: Devil's Deal

disciple.description: Casting a Disciple Skill with a cooldown grants Arbiter for 4.5 seconds. Wing Strikes gain Disciple Skill benefits. While in Arbiter form, your Disciple Skills deal x80% increased damage.
disciple.name: Disciple

dismembering.description: Enemies damaged by Varyana's Earth Breaker are left exposed, causing your next hit against them within 3 seconds to be a guaranteed Overpower. This may only occur on the same target once every 5 seconds.
dismembering.name: Dismembering

divine lance.description: Impale enemies with a heavenly lance, stabbing 2 times for 90 damage each.
divine lance.name: Divine Lance

runes.Cast Speed: Divine Lance gains +20% increased Cast Speed.
runes.Cost Reduction: Killing enemies with Divine Lance reduces the cost of your next Divine Lance by 10% up to 50%.
runes.Damage Bonus: Divine Lance deals x15% increased damage. Double this bonus against Vulnerable enemies.
runes.Divine Javelin: Throw Divine Lance, dealing 90 damage to the first enemy hit and bursting for an additional 450 damage. The first time an enemy is hit by a Divine Lance, they are impaled and dragged with it.
runes.Stacking Damage: Successive hits on the same target with Divine Lance deal 5% more damage up to 30%.
runes.Tip of the Spear: Divine Lance flurries, stabbing 2 additional times and deals 32 damage each. Killing Vulnerable enemies with Divine Lance increases its Attack Speed by 5% for 10 seconds, up to 30%.
runes.Zealous Joust: Divine Lance becomes a Zealot Skill. Divine Lance now stabs with 2 additional spears in a wider area, dealing 67 damage each and has x10% increased Critical Strike Damage.

dog of astaroth.description: When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Amalgam of Rage has a chance to appear and attack you. Killing the Amalgam of Rage in Nightmare Dungeons can drop Unique Items associated with Astaroth.
dog of astaroth.name: Dog of Astaroth

doom.description: Burst a sigil on your enemies, Hexing them and dealing 50 damage.
doom.name: Doom

runes.Assimilation: Casting Doom against a Vulnerable, Weakened, or Slowed enemy assimilates the effects, causing Doom to also apply those effects for 3 seconds.
runes.Contagion: Whenever you kill a Hexed enemy, Doom spreads the Hex to another enemy and deals 50 damage to them.
runes.Damage: Doom deals x1% increased damage to enemies for each second they have been Hexed.
runes.Doomfire Ritual: Doom becomes a Hellfire Skill and your Hex is applied with Maximum Stacks and lasts 15 seconds but you can only have one Hexed target at a time. When Hex expires or is removed, Doom deals 175 damage split amongst all enemies in the area.
runes.Echo: Casting Doom echoes 10% of its damage to all Nearby Hexed enemies.
runes.Jailer: Doom is cast at range on the ground, leaving behind a mark that Tethers your Primary Target and Hexes enemies within for 6 seconds.
runes.Wrath: Doom generates 1 Wrath every 2 seconds for each Hexed enemy.

double swing.description: Sweep your weapons from opposite directions, dealing 75 damage with each weapon. Enemies caught in the center are damaged by both.
double swing.name: Double Swing

runes.Damage Increase: Increases this Skill's damage by x2% per enemy hit for 2 seconds, all stacks expire simultaneously and the duration cannot be refreshed.
runes.Flurry: Each sweep also hits 1 additional time dealing 38 damage, and an extra 2 additional times while Berserking.
runes.Fortify: Fortified you for 1% of your Maximum Life for each enemy hit with both weapons.
runes.Fury Cost Reduction: Decreases the Fury Cost of your next Double Swing per hit by 2 once per weapon.
runes.Slice and Dice: Sweep Size increased by 200% but Cast Speed is slowed by 40%. Enemies caught at the outer edge of your sweeps and are hit an additional time for 90 damage. These additional hits grant this Skill 5% increased Cast Speed for 4 seconds, stacking upto 8 times.
runes.Twister: The intial sweep also creates 1 Dust Devil that deals 38 damage, the subsequent sweep creates 2.

draw fire.description: When you use a Healing Potion, Raheir Taunts enemies around him for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 20 seconds.
draw fire.name: Draw Fire

dread claws.description: Burst forth 4 shadowy claws, each dealing 50 damage.
dread claws.name: Dread Claws

runes.Ambush: Dread Claws deals x50% increased damage with its first claw strike against each enemy. When attacking from Stealth all claws gain this bonus.
runes.Cascading Dread: Dread Claws sends out 4 additional claws and each set deals x30% increased damage than the last.
runes.Cost Reduction: Killing enemies or demons with Dread Claws reduces the cost of your next Dread Claws by 10%, up to 50%.
runes.Damage: Every second, gain x20% increased damage for your next Dread Claws, up to x100%.
runes.Encircling Terror: Dread Claws are cast around you, each dealing 82 damage. You consume 1 stack of Shadowform to also conjure claws around your most recent Greater Demon Summon.
runes.Ravenous Jaws: Dread Claws becomes a Lesser Demon Skill and is cast in a frontal cone, dealing 63 damage and killing up to 5 Lesser Demons they strike. Each Lesser Demon killed grants Dread Claws a +2% chance for 10 seconds to Eviscerate enemies for 125 damage, up to +10%.
runes.Vulnerable: Dread Claws makes enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds if it strikes them at least 2 times.

dread revival.description: Bosses in Nightmare Dungeons have a chance to revive when slain.
dread revival.name: Dread Revival

duriel s invasion.description: When summoning the Blood Maiden in Helltides, there is a chance Duriel can be summoned instead. Killing Duriel in Helltides can now drop Unique Items from his Hoard Chest.
duriel s invasion.name: Duriel's Invasion

eagle.description: Casting an Eagle Skill or Evading shoots 6 Storm Feathers, each dealing 75% Lightning damage and applying Vulnerable for 5 seconds. Can only occur once every 0.5 seconds. The Storm Feathers Movement Speed bonus is doubled and always active. All Skills are now also Eagle Skills.
eagle.name: Eagle

earth breaker.description: Varyana crushes the ground with her mace, leaving a tremor that deals 180% Physical damage over 3 seconds and Knocks enemies Down repeatedly.
earth breaker.name: Earth Breaker

earth spike.description: Sunder the earth, impaling all enemies hit for 90 damage.
earth spike.name: Earth Spike

runes.Aftershock: A second Earth Spike will appear at the previously targeted location dealing 80% of normal damage. This effect expires in 5 seconds.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Increases Earth Spike's Critical Strike Chance by 15%.
runes.Fortify: Earth Spike grants Fortify for 5% of your Maximum Life when hitting the first enemy.
runes.Megalith Stone: Hitting the same enemy with Earth Spike within 20 seconds deals x25% increased damage and restores 1 additional Spirit. This effect stacks up to 3 times.
runes.Overpower: Earth Spike grants 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Seismic Shift: Earth Spike launches spikes in a line in front of you dealing 70% of normal damage. Additionally, Earth Spike Slows enemies hit by 70% for 3 seconds.
runes.Spirit: Increase Earth Spike's Spirit generation by 8.
