earthen bulwark.description: Rock's surround you for 6 seconds, granting a Barrier that absorbs value1 of your Maximum Life in damage.
earthen bulwark.name: Earthen Bulwark

runes.Barrier Duration and Bonus: Extends the Barrier duration to 12 seconds and increase the base absorption amount to 60% of your Maximum Life.
runes.Earthen Shrapnel: Rock shrapnel flies outward when Earthen Bulwark is destroyed or expires, dealing 275 to surrounding enemies. This damage is increased by Barrier bonuses.
runes.Fortify and Healing: You are Fortified for 7% per second while Earthen Bulwark is active. In addition, Heal for 15% of your Maximum Life if Earthen Bulwark is fully depleted from damage.
runes.Overpower: Casting Earthen Bulwark grants 2 stacks of Overpower.
runes.Reconstruction: Earthen Bulwark self-restores 15% of its own Barrier amount each second.
runes.Travertine Bulwark: Earthen Bulwark grants 3 stacks of Resolve. In addition, Earthen Bulwark summons Tectonic Spikes that deal 150 total damage to enemies around you.
runes.Unstoppable: Casting Earthen Bulwark makes you Unstoppable for 2 seconds.

ember s gift.description: You restore 33 of your Primary Resource per second while inside Aldkin's Fire Storm.
ember s gift.name: Ember's Gift

embers of anguish.description: When exploring the Pit, Embers of Anguish can appear. Activating one drops Progress Orbs, and causes Andariel to ambush you at the end of the Pit. Killing Andariel in the Pit can now drop Unique Items from her Hoard Chest.
embers of anguish.name: Embers of Anguish

endless swarm.description: Invasion Portals now appear in the Undercity. The enemies that emerge grant Attunement when slain.
endless swarm.name: Endless Swarm

energize.description: Lucky Hit: Dealing damage has a 15% chance to restore 15 Spirit.
energize.name: Energize

eradication.description: Enemies killed within Aldkin's Fire Storm explode for 120% Fire damage.
eradication.name: Eradication

evisceration fragment.description: While an enemy is Eviscerated, your Summoned Demons prioritize them and gain 50% increased Movement Speed. Lesser Demon Skills gain a 2% chance to Eviscerate enemies that are already Eviscerated.
evisceration fragment.name: Evisceration Fragment

exalted council.description: Bartuc and the Fell Council have +1 Monster Power and drop additional items when slain.
exalted council.name: Exalted Council

exhaustion.description: Aldkin's Shadow damage has a 10% chance to Daze enemies for 2 seconds.
exhaustion.name: Exhaustion

exotic armory.description: Hoard Chests drop one additional Unique Item, but it can be for any Class.
exotic armory.name: Exotic Armory

explosive charge.description: Subo fires 4 Explosive Charges that stick to enemies. Each explodes after 7 seconds, dealing 60% Physical damage. Explosive Charges detonate early if their target dies or takes Overpower damage.
explosive charge.name: Explosive Charge

fall of the fell.description: Harbingers will emerge from falling meteors twice as often, and drop twice as many Aberrant Cinders when slain. Harbingers in Helltide have +1 Monster Power.
fall of the fell.name: Fall of the Fell

falling star.description: Soar into the air with angel wings and dive down onto the battlefield, dealing 80 on takeoff and 240 damage on landing.
falling star.name: Falling Star

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Killing a Vulnerable enemy reduces the Cooldown of Falling Star by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Damage: Falling Star deals x20% increased damage if it is cast again within 15 seconds.
runes.Fanatic Descent: Falling Star becomes a Zealot skill, now dealing 560 damage on landing and Weakening enemies hit for 4 seconds.
runes.Faster Than Light: Falling Star cuts through the battlefield, Knocking Down enemies for 2 seconds when landing and creating a fissure along your path that deals 180 damage before erupting for 60 damage.
runes.Starfall: When landing, Falling Star deals 105 damage and erupts 3 additional times.
runes.Vulnerable: Falling Star applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds on landing.

familiar.description: Summon a Fire Familiar for 8 seconds. It seeks enemies and periodically explodes, dealing 70 damage. You may have up to 6 Familiars active at a time.
familiar.name: Familiar

runes.Bonus Effect:
Gain a bonus based on the Familiar type when the Familiar explodes: - Fire Familiar: Gain +5% Healing Received for 5 seconds.
- Cold Familiar: Gain a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 5 seconds, up to 30%.
- Lightning Familiar: Reduce a random active Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Duration Bonus: Familiar's duration is increased by 4 seconds.
runes.Fast As Lightning: Familiar becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage. Familiar increases your Minimum Ferocity by 1 and grants value2 Cooldown Reduction while active.
runes.Freezing Familiar: Familiar becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Familiar Chills for value3 and Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.
runes.Healing Flames: Familiar grants 1 stacks of Overpower when Casted and restores value1 of your Maximum Life per second while active.
runes.Prismatic Familiar: Familiar becomes a Pyromancy, Shock, and Frost Skill that summons a stationary Prismatic Familiar. Casting Skills will cause Prismatic Familiar to apply 105 Frostbite, Sparking, or Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies based on the Element Cast.
runes.Size Bonus: Familiar's explosion radius is increased by 50%.

fanaticism aura.description: Passive: Spending Faith emanates power from you, granting you and your allies + value1 Attack Speed and + value2 Critical Strike Chance for 3 seconds up to a maximum of 4 times. Active: Weaken all Nearby enemies for 4 seconds.
fanaticism aura.name: Fanaticism Aura

runes.Additional Maximum Resource:
Fanaticism Aura's passive also grants you
and your allies 15% Maximum Resource.
runes.Extra Passive Stack: Fanaticism Aura's passive stacks 1 additional time.
runes.Potency: Fanaticism Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.
runes.Resource Generation: Fanaticism Aura increases Resource Generation for you and your allies by 25%.
runes.Rite of Humility: Fanaticism Aura's active instead makes Nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds Damaging Vulnerable enemies will also trigger Fanaticism's Passive.
runes.Rite of Redemption: Weakened enemies who die within Fanaticism Aura's radius Heal you for 0.5% and Fortify for value4 of your Maximum Life.
runes.Rite of Vengeance: Fanaticism Aura Passive increases Critical Strike Damage by x value3 for you and your allies. Critical Strikes trigger Fanaticism's Passive.

fearless conviction.description: While in a Nightmare Dungeon, killing Elites and Champions grants you stacks of Conviction. Getting hit by an Elite or Champion causes you to lose a stack of Conviction. A Conviction Chest appears at the end of the dungeon that grants rewards for each remaining Conviction. This chest has a higher than normal chance to award Attuned Primordial Dust.
fearless conviction.name: Fearless Conviction

field of languish.description: Aldkin desiccates an area for 6 seconds, Slowing enemies within by 40% and reducing their damage dealt by 20%.
field of languish.name: Field of Languish

fiend of abaddon.description: Summon a massive fiend for 15 seconds that attacks enemies, dealing 280 damage per swipe.
fiend of abaddon.name: Fiend of Abaddon

runes.Abyssal Colossus: Fiend of Abaddon becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and now summons a demon for 30 seconds that attacks for 364 damage per swipe. Recast to command the demon to do a massive smash that Pulls in enemies and explodes for 560 damage.
runes.Crowd Damage: Fiend of Abaddon deals x2% increased damage for each Nearby enemy present when it is summoned, up to x40%.
runes.Dominance: Fiend of Abaddon now costs 30 Dominance and has no Cooldown.
runes.Elite Damage: Fiend of Abaddon deals x25% increased damage against Elite enemies and Bosses.
runes.Lesser Demon Bonus: Casting Fiend of Abaddon increases the damage of your Lesser Demon Skills by x20% for 15 seconds.
runes.Spiteful Enrage: If an enemy survives more than 5 hits from Fiend of Abaddon then each subsequent hit increases its damage versus that target by x5% and extends its lifetime by 2 seconds, up to 60 seconds.
runes.Vanguard of Flames: Fiend of Abaddon becomes a Hellfire Skill and now summons a demon for 20 seconds that moves with you and attacks for 504 damage per swipe.

finely tuned.description: Gain additional Tuning Prisms when completing the Undercity at maximum Attunement. All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.
finely tuned.name: Finely Tuned

fire bolt.description: Hurl a flaming bolt, dealing 18 damage and an additional 90 Burning damage over 6 seconds.
fire bolt.name: Fire Bolt

runes.Damage Bonus: Fire Bolt deals x50% increased Burning damage.
runes.Firefly: Fire Bolt shoots out a firefly that attaches itself to an enemy and explodes 3 times after a delay, dealing 25 damage with each explosion.
runes.Healing: Fire Bolt heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life when it hits the first enemy.
runes.Overpower: Fire Bolt grants 2 stacks of Overpower.
runes.Resource Generation: Fire Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the enemy is already Burning.
runes.Shiver: Fire Bolt becomes a Frost Skill, dealing 27 Cold damage and 180 Frostbite damage over 6 seconds. Fire Bolt pierces 1 time and makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Twin Flame: Fire Bolt launches an additional parallel bolt, dealing 18 Fire damage.

fireball.description: Hurl an exploding ball of fire, dealing 170 damage to enemies.
fireball.name: Fireball

runes.Critical Strike Damage: Fireball deals x30% increased Critical Strike Damage.
runes.Damage Bonus: Fireball deals x40% increased damage, but its Mana cost is increased by 15.
runes.Damage Over Time: Fireball's direct damage deals an additional 30% damage over 4 seconds.
runes.Frostball: Fireball becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. When Fireball hits a Frozen enemy it creates 5 Ice Spikes around them, dealing 85 damage each.
runes.Illumination: Fireball now bounces as it travels and explodes each time it hits the ground, dealing 75% of normal damage.
runes.Instantaneous Destruction: Fireball travels 200% faster and deals x75% increased damage.

firewall.description: Create a wall of fire, dealing 300 Burning damage over 3.5 seconds. Enemies continue Burning for 1.8 seconds after leaving the wall.
firewall.name: Firewall

runes.Cost Reduction: Every 100 Mana spent makes your next Firewall cost no Mana, stacking up to 300 total Mana.
runes.Damage Bonus: Firewall deals x75% increased damage, but its duration is reduced by 25%.
runes.Grounding:
Firewall becomes a Shock Skill, deals 150 Sparking damage over 3.5 seconds, and costs 30
Mana. Lucky Hit: Up to a 25% chance to deal 300 damage and form a Crackling Energy against enemies affected by Firewall.
runes.Healing: Firewall heals you for 0.3% of your Maximum Life every second per affected enemy. Every 8 Life healed by Firewall grants you 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Ring of Fire:
Firewall creates a ring of fire that deals 300 Fire damage over 3.5 seconds, but it now
has a 12 second Cooldown. Standing in this ring causes your Direct Damage to inflict this Burning damage to enemies.
runes.Weaken: Firewall Weakens enemies for 2 seconds.
runes.Wildfire: Firewall's Size is increased by 50% and duration increased to 7 seconds.

flame shield.description: Engulf yourself in flames for 1 seconds, becoming Immune and dealing 80 Burning damage over 4 seconds to surrounding enemies.
flame shield.name: Flame Shield

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Flame Shield's Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.
runes.Duration Bonus: Flame Shield's duration is increased to 1.5 seconds.
runes.Firebird: Flame Shield rains down 5 Meteorites per second that deal 9 damage.
runes.Flash: Flame Shield becomes a Shock Skill, deals Sparking damage, and triggers its Cooldown on Cast. Instead of becoming Immune you embody lightning, generating value1 Crackling Energy per second and gaining x value2 Movement Speed and value3 Dodge.
runes.Healing: While Flame Shield is active, you heal for 12% of your Maximum Life per second.
runes.Overpower: Flame Shield grants 3 stack of Overpower.
runes.Scorch: Flame Shield instantly scorches close enemies, dealing 14 damage and Immobilizing them for 3 seconds.

flame surge.description: Aldkin channels a cone of flame for 4 seconds, repeatedly dealing 80% Fire damage. Aldkin's Mercenary Core Skill alters his Fate and Basic Attack.
flame surge.name: Flame Surge

flawless find.description: Gem Fragments drop instead of Obducite in the Infernal Hordes.
flawless find.name: Flawless Find

flay.description: Flay the enemy, dealing 5 damage and inflicting 115 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
flay.name: Flay

runes.Anemia: Flay's Bleeding duration is reduced by 2 seconds and it makes enemies Vulnerable.
runes.Duration Bonus: Flay's Bleeding duration is increased by 5 seconds.
runes.Healing: Each Nearby enemy Bleeding from Flay Heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life per second, up to 5%.
runes.Hemorrhaging: Flay's Bleeding is extended by 2 seconds whenever the enemy moves too far from you.
runes.The Flayer: If Flay hits a Bleeding enemy it causes a blood explosion that inflicts 29 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Flay Weakens enemies.

flurry.description: Unleash a flurry of stabs and slashes, striking enemies in front of you 4 times and dealing a total of 196 damage to each.
flurry.name: Flurry

runes.Damage Increase: Casting Flurry increases its damage by x15%, up to x45%. This bonus resets after hitting the maximum.
runes.Encircling Blades: Flurry now damages enemies in a circle around you and deals 76 damage.
runes.Fortify: Fortify for 3% of your Maximum Life when Flurry hits an enemy for the first time.
runes.Resolve: Casting Flurry grants 10% Dodge Chance for 4 seconds while you have Resolve.
runes.Transporter: Flurry is also a Mobility Skill. Casting Flurry deals x75% increased damage, dashes you to the target, and grants x10% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds.
runes.Vehemence: Flurry's size is increased by x50% and its Energy Cost is reduced to 15. Flurry now also gains x3% increased damage each time it hits an enemy, up to x75%, for 4 seconds.

forceful arrow.description: Fire a powerful arrow at an enemy, dealing 50 damage and Propelling Close enemies, Knock Back the enemy. Propel can occur once every 2 seconds per enemy.
forceful arrow.name: Forceful Arrow

runes.Cloudburst: Forceful Arrow's Propel no longer Knocks Back Close enemies and instead creates an Arrow Storm every 3 arrows, dealing 113 damage and Slowing enemies hit by 50% for 2 seconds.
runes.Ender: Forceful Arrow pierces through the first enemy hit, deals 82 damage, and has a 30% chance to Execute enemies.
runes.Energy: Gain 3 Energy when Forceful Arrow damages an enemy and an additional 4 Energy after attempting to Propel an enemy.
runes.Ferocity: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stacks of Ferocity after attempting to Propel an enemy.
runes.Overpower: Forceful Arrow grants 1 stack of Overpower after attempting to Propel an enemy.
runes.Pin: Forceful Arrow now Immobilizes Knocked Back enemies for 1 second and deals 88 damage. Forceful Arrow's Knock Back range is increased by 50%.
runes.Vulnerable: Forceful Arrow causes enemies to become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

forged in flame.description: Obducite drops instead of Gem Fragments in the Infernal Hordes.
forged in flame.name: Forged in Flame

fortress.description: Make your stand, becoming Immune for 3 seconds and create a defensive area around you for value1 seconds Standing in your Fortress grants you and your allies 2 Resolve stacks every 0.5 seconds.
fortress.name: Fortress

runes.Barricade: Killing enemies inside of your Fortress extends its duration by 0.5 seconds up to 20 seconds. You may recast Fortress to move it to your current location.
runes.Entrench: While inside of Fortress your Life cannot be reduced below 1. Fortress duration is reduced by 50%.
runes.Free Cast: While inside of your Fortress your Skills are free to Cast.
runes.Rampart of Thorns: Enemies inside Fortress are Slowed by 50% and take 500% of your Thorns damage per second.
runes.Resolve Damage Bonus: While inside of your Fortress you gain x4% damage per stack of Resolve.
runes.Unstoppable: While inside of your Fortress you are Unstoppable.

fortune or famine.description: Whisper Caches from the Tree of Whispers are always at least of Greater Quality ... or Junk.
fortune or famine.name: Fortune or Famine

frenzy.description: Unleash a rapid flurry of blows, dealing 70 damage with each pair of hits. If Frenzy hits an enemy, its Cast Speed is increased by +10% for 3 seconds, up to +50%.
frenzy.name: Frenzy

runes.Barrage: Frenzy stacks up an additional 5 times and you gain Berserking for 5 seconds while at maximum stacks.
runes.Ferocity: Each stack of Frenzy gained also grants a stack of Ferocity.
runes.Raging: Frenzy now deals Fire damage. Lucky Hit: Frenzy has up to a 75% chance when attacking to cause a fiery explosion, dealing 175 Burning damage over 5 seconds.
runes.Throwing: Frenzy becomes a ranged attack that pierces enemies, dealing 123 damage. Frenzy has a 30% chance while at maximum Frenzy stacks to ricochet Iron Shrapnel, dealing 60 damage and inflicting 35 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
runes.Unhindered: While at maximum Frenzy stacks, you are Unhindered.

frost bolt.description: Throw a bolt of frost at an enemy, dealing 90 damage and Chilling them for 35%.
frost bolt.name: Frost Bolt

runes.Barrier: Frost Bolt grants a Barrier for 2% of your Maximum Life up to 6% for 6 seconds when it hits the first enemy.
runes.Relentless Bolt: Frost Bolt launches an additional projectile after the first. Each projectile deals 72 damage.
runes.Resource Generation: Frost Bolt generates 2 Mana when it hits the first enemy, or 4 Mana if the target is already Frozen.
runes.Shatter: Frost Bolt shatters when it hits a Frozen enemy, exploding for 270 damage and Chilling for 40%.

runes.Vulnerable: Frost Bolt makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

frost nova.description: Unleash a torrent of frost, Freezing enemies around you for value1 seconds.
frost nova.name: Frost Nova

runes.Charge: Frost Nova gains 1 additional Charge, but its Cooldown is increased by 6 seconds.

runes.Freezing Mist: Instead of Freezing, Frost Nova forms an aura of frigid mist around you that deals 175 Frostbite damage over 4 seconds.
runes.Resource Generation: Each enemy Frozen by Frost Nova generates 5 Mana.
runes.Shatter: Enemies that die while Frozen by Frost Nova have a 100% chance to unleash an additional Frost Nova.
runes.Size Bonus: Frost Nova's Size is increased by 50%.
runes.Vulnerable: Frost Nova makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

frozen orb.description: Unleash a whirling orb that deals 48 Frostbite damage over 3 seconds and Chills for 25%. After 1 second Frozen Orb will explode, dealing 112 damage.
frozen orb.name: Frozen Orb

runes.Barrier: Frozen Orb grants a Barrier for 5% of your Maximum Life for 3 seconds for each enemy hit by its explosion, up to 50%.
runes.Damage Over Time Bonus: Frozen Orb deals x100% increased Frostbite damage.
runes.Duration Bonus: Frozen Orb lasts 1 additional second before exploding.
runes.Explosion Damage Bonus: Frozen Orb deals x30% increased explosion damage.
runes.Great Orb of Fire: Frozen Orb becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 62 Burning damage over 2 seconds and explodes for 146 Fire damage. Frozen Orb will consume 1 stack of Overpower to explode 1 time along its path.
runes.Seeking Orb: When Frozen Orb first explodes it remains stationary for 0.5 seconds then seeks another target to explode again, dealing 90 damage.
runes.Shattered Path: Ice Spikes spawn around Frozen Orb, dealing 56 damage. Frozen Orb makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

gauntlet.description: While in a Nightmare Dungeon, slaying an enemy while empowered by a Shrine traps their soul within you. When the Shrine buff expires, all trapped souls escape and spawn around you as renewed enemies.
gauntlet.name: Gauntlet

gift of the stag.description: Gain +30 Maximum Spirit. You gain 5 Spirit every second.
gift of the stag.name: Gift of the Stag

goblinfall.description: Treasure Goblins have a small chance to drop a Nightmare Sigil with the Treasure Breach affix.
goblinfall.name: Goblinfall

golden hoard.description: All equipment that would drop from Hoard Chests are converted to Gold, except for Unique and Mythic items.
golden hoard.name: Golden Hoard

golem.description: Passive: Raise a Golem that attacks for 125 damage. When your Golem dies, it respawns after 10 seconds. Active: Command your Golem to leap to the target area. It becomes Unstoppable, Taunts Nearby enemies, and takes 30% reduced damage for the next 6 seconds. It gains 50% of its Armor as Thorns for the duration.
golem.name: Golem

runes.Damage Bonus: Golem deals x30% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.
runes.Fel Gluttony: Commanding your Golem causes it to erupt, dealing 300 damage to surrounding enemies. Your Golem passively consumes nearby Corpses every second to reduce its Cooldown by 2 seconds per Corpse consumed.
runes.Gargantua: Golem now raises a larger Golem that gains an aura of command, increasing the Cast Speed and Movement Speed of your other Minions by x value1 .
runes.Gravebloom: Golem now raises 3 smaller Golems that deal 60% of normal damage and gain +30% Attack Speed.
runes.Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity: Commanding your Golem grants 3 stacks of Resolve, Overpower, or Ferocity based on whether your Golem type is Bone, Blood, or Iron respectively.
runes.Unstoppable: Commanding your Golem also grants you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Golem Weakens enemies for 4 seconds whenever it attacks.

gorilla.description: Attacking with a Gorilla Skill deals 150% Thorns to enemies you hit and grants a Barrier for 2.5% of Maximum Life for 3 seconds. All Skills are now also Gorilla Skills.
gorilla.name: Gorilla

greater nemesis.description: After completing a Nemesis Lair, there is a chance that a portal will appear that will take you to a Greater Nemesis Lair. Within this heinous place lies two Greater Lair Bosses. Slaying both bosses will yield great rewards.
greater nemesis.name: Greater Nemesis

greed is good.description: Killing a Treasure Goblin in a Nightmare Dungeon has a small chance to spawn a portal that takes you to the Goblin's Retreat.
greed is good.name: Greed is Good

grigoire s gambit.description: After opening a Tortured Gift in Helltides, there is a chance Grigoire's knights will ambush you. When killed in Helltide, they may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.
grigoire s gambit.name: Grigoire's Gambit

grim mysteries.description: Collections of Chaos are replaced with Collections of Mysteries. These caches can drop anything.
grim mysteries.name: Grim Mysteries

runes.Immunity: Grizzly Rage grants 2 seconds of Immunity when cast.
runes.Unstoppable: Grizzly Rage makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

ground slam.description: Raheir brutalizes the ground, dealing 160% Physical damage and Slowing enemies by 30% for 6 seconds. Targets in the center of the slam are Slowed by 60% instead. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.

ground stomp.description: Smash the ground, dealing 50 damage and Stunning surrounding enemies for 3 seconds.
ground stomp.name: Ground Stomp

gutter filth.description: When you activate any Beacon within the Undercity, there is a small chance to summon a Portal Prankster. Invasion Portals will sometimes summon Rats of varying amounts.
gutter filth.name: Gutter Filth

hammer of the ancients.description: Slam your hammer down with the fury of the Ancients, dealing 175 damage to a concentrated area.
hammer of the ancients.name: Hammer of the Ancients

runes.Ancestral: Hammer of the Ancients now deals Fire damage. Casting Hammer of the Ancients Summons 2 Ancients to hammer the same area for 66 damage each. If Burning enemies are struck Hammer of the Ancients explodes, dealing 17 damage.

runes.Damage Bonus: Enemies hit by Heaven's Fury take 20% increased damage from Heaven's Fury forever.

hellion sting.description: Whip a demon tail forward, dealing 60 damage with a 5% chance to Eviscerate enemies for 600 damage.

runes.Eviscerate: Hellion Sting has x40% increased Eviscerate chance against your primary target.

hellmouth.name: Hellmouth

hemorrhage.description: Burst an enemy's blood, dealing 80 damage. Hemorrhage has a 20% chance to form a Blood Orb.
hemorrhage.name: Hemorrhage

runes.Blood Boil: Hemorrhage also deals 40 damage to enemies around your target.
runes.Blood Orb: Hemorrhage has an additional 30% chance to form a Blood Orb.

runes.Overpower: Hemorrhage grants 1 stack of Overpower.
runes.Soul Rip: Hemorrhage becomes a Darkness Skill that deals 80 Shadow damage. Instead of forming a Blood Orb, Hemorrhage Summons a Volatile Skeleton that deals 120 damage.
runes.Weaken: Hemorrhage Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

holy bolt.description: Throw a Holy hammer, dealing 90 damage.
holy bolt.name: Holy Bolt

runes.Cast Speed: Increases Holy Bolt Cast Speed by +10% when hitting an enemy for 4 seconds, up to +30%. Decrease Holy Bolt's Cooldown by 30%.
runes.Divine Bolt: Holy Bolt becomes a Disciple Skill. Holy Bolt pierces, deals 120 damage, and applies Vulnerable.

holy light aura.description: Passive: You and your allies emanate the Light, dealing 45 damage every 2 seconds to 3 random Nearby enemies. Attack Speed further increases this damage. Active: Unleash 2 pure bolts of light, dealing 320 Holy damage to the Closest enemy and chaining up to 4 additional enemies before returning to you. When your first bolt of light returns, Heal for 12% of your Maximum Life.
holy light aura.name: Holy Light Aura

runes.Additional Bounce: Holy Light Aura's active bounces 1 additional time.
runes.Additional Targets: Holy Light Aura's passive now targets 1 additional enemies.
runes.Judgement Damage Bonus: Holy Light Aura's deals x40% increased damage against enemies affected by Judgement.
runes.Potency: Holy Light Aura gains 15% more bonus from potency.
runes.Rite of Judgement: Holy Light's active also Judges enemies and its Cooldown is reduced per rank.
runes.Rite of Mercy: Holy Light's active chains 2 more times and Fortifies you and your allies for value1 of their Maximum Life.
runes.Rite of Submission: Holy Light's active now Stuns enemies for 3 seconds and deals 130 damage in an area if the enemy dies during this effect.

horadric hunter.description: Kill 30 Elites across Nightmare Dungeons to reveal a Horadric Altar. Activating it results in one of the following outcomes:
horadric hunter.name: Horadric Hunter

hurricane.description: Form a hurricane around you that deals 360 damage to surrounding enemies over 6 seconds.
hurricane.name: Hurricane

runes.Critical Strike Chance: Hurricane's Critical Strike Chance is increased by +5% and an additional 5% Critical Strike Chance for each stack of Ferocity active.

runes.Movement Speed: Movement Speed is increased by x10% while Hurricane is active.
runes.Rapid Intensification: Each second while active, Hurricane gains x30% bonus damage.

Hydra is bathed in flame, dealing 28 Burning damage per second to surrounding
enemies. Hydra's attacks now instead deal 70 Burning damage over 4 seconds.

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Hydra reduces the Cooldown of a random Skill by 0.3 seconds whenever it attacks.
runes.Frigid Hydra: Hydra becomes a Frost Skill that deals 44 Cold damage. Hydra's attacks pierce enemies and Chill for 15%.
runes.Healing: Hydra heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life each time it deals damage.
runes.Overpower: Hydra gains 1 head for every 3 Overpower you have on Cast.

hysteria.description: You gain +1% Attack Speed for 5 seconds whenever Varyana damages an enemy, up to +10%.
hysteria.name: Hysteria

ice armor.description: A Barrier of ice forms around you for 4 seconds, absorbing value1 of your Maximum Life in damage.
ice armor.name: Ice Armor

runes.Blast Chill: Ice Armor also applies to Nearby Allies and increases All Resistances by x value3 .
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Ice Armor's Cooldown is reduced to 16 seconds.
runes.Duration Bonus and Barrier: Ice Armor's duration is increased to 5 seconds and its Barrier amount is increased by x20%.
runes.Frozen and Chill: Close enemies that attack you while Ice Armor is active will be Frozen or Chilled for 10%.
runes.Permafrost: Ice Armor grants Unstoppable for 1 second and increases your Armor by value2 while active.
runes.Razor Ice: Ice Armor forms 2 Ice Spikes per second under Close enemies that deal 25 damage.
runes.Resource Regeneration: Ice Armor grants 5 Mana Regeneration while active.

ice blades.description: Conjure blades of ice for 6 seconds that rapidly slash enemies, dealing 77 damage and making them Vulnerable. You may have up to 3 Ice Blades active at a time.

runes.Blazing Blades: Ice Blades becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 115 Fire damage. Ice Blades gain 30% Cast Speed, but drain 5 Mana per attack.
runes.Cast Speed: Ice Blades gains +50% Cast Speed when attacking Frozen enemies.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Ice Blades' Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time it attacks an enemy.
runes.Duration Bonus: Ice Blades' duration is increased by 5 seconds.
runes.Frozen Tomb: Ice Blades is now cast at the target location and surrounds it with 3 Ice Blades. Ice Blades Chill enemies for value1 , but their Movement Speed is reduced by 50%.
runes.Ice Crack: Every 3rd slash from Ice Blades is an Ice Crack, dealing 230 damage in a large cone.

ice shards.description: Launch 5 icy shards, dealing 33 damage each and piercing 1 time. Ice Shards deals x50% increased damage to Frozen enemies.
ice shards.name: Ice Shards

runes.Barrier: Ice Shards launches 1 additional shard while you have a Barrier.
runes.Cost Reduction: Ice Shards' Mana cost is reduced by 3.

runes.Hit Damage Bonus: Ice Shards deals x10% increased damage to an enemy each time it hits them in the same cast.
runes.Pierce Damage Bonus: Ice Shards deals x20% increased damage after piercing once.
runes.Piercing Cold: Ice Shards will pierce 1 additional time. Ice Shards will additionally pierce up to 3 Vulnerable enemies.
runes.Thunderbolt: Ice Shards becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage. Ice Shards launches a large thunderbolt that explodes on impact into 5 smaller seeking thunderbolt shards, dealing 33 damage each.

incendiary bolt.description: If Subo's Snipe hits the target he originally aimed at, a Molotov explodes on them.
incendiary bolt.name: Incendiary Bolt

incinerate.description: Channel a beam of fire, dealing 14 damage and an additional 70 Burning damage over 4 seconds. Incinerate's damage increases by x50% every second you channel it, up to x100%.
incinerate.name: Incinerate

runes.Disintegration: Incinerate becomes a Shock Skill that deals Lightning damage. Incinerate's beam no longer penetrates enemies and it now deals 140 damage to the first enemy hit and an additional 140 damage distributed among up to 5 enemies around them.
runes.Flamethrower: Incinerate gains 2 additional beams and deals its Burning damage 50% faster, but its range is reduced.
runes.Focused Flame: Incinerate maximum damage bonus while channeling is increased to x200%. Incinerate's Size is increased by 200% when you reach the maximum damage bonus.
runes.Healing: Incinerate heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life per enemy hit.
runes.Healthy Damage Bonus: Incinerate deals x25% increased damage while you are Healthy.
runes.Overpower: Incinerate gains 20% chance to deal double damage while you have a stack of Overpower.

infernal breath.description: Summon a demonic head for 7 seconds that breathes fire on enemies dealing 20 damage per hit.
infernal breath.name: Infernal Breath

runes.Abyssal Torrent: Infernal Breath becomes an Abyss Recast Skill and summons a larger demon for 15 seconds that Executes Hexed enemies. Recast to aim and blast enemies 3 times for 150 damage.
runes.Demonic Breath: Infernal Breath becomes a Channeled fire breath attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 35 damage per hit. Infernal Breath's cost is reduced by 50% while you have Volatility.
runes.Expensive Damage: Infernal Breath deals x140% increased damage but costs 100% more Dominance.
runes.Explosive Death: At the end of Infernal Breath the demon explodes, dealing 100 damage. The explosion damage is increased by x10% for each time the demon's breath hit enemies.
runes.Heavy Impact Damage: Infernal Breath deals x2000% increased damage the first time it hits an enemy but no longer pierces.
runes.Lesser Demon Volatility: Casting Infernal Breath infuses your Lesser Demon Skills to grant 1 seconds of Volatility per hit for 5 seconds.
runes.Ramping Damage: Enemies permanently take x1% increased damage from Infernal Breath each time it hits them, up to x25%.

infernal deception.description: Belial can now ambush you after completing the Infernal Hordes.
infernal deception.name: Infernal Deception

infernal hoard.description: Defeating either the Fell Council or Bartuc reveals the Hoard of Greater Equipment, which contains a colossal deluge of equipment and other rewards.
infernal hoard.name: Infernal Hoard

infernal rite.description: Ambushes spawn up to four additional Hellborne. Hellborne have a higher chance to drop Unique items when slain.
infernal rite.name: Infernal Rite

inferno.description: Summon a fiery serpent that deals 21 damage and Burns enemies for 85 damage over 4 seconds, stacking up to 4 times.
inferno.name: Inferno

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Inferno's Cooldown is reduced to 12 seconds, but it now also costs 30 Mana.
runes.Direct Damage Bonus: Inferno's Burning damage is now converted to direct Fire damage, allowing it to Critically Strike. Inferno deals 20% increased Critical Strike Damage.
runes.Lifecoil: Inferno now forms around you and follows you, healing you for 50% of your Maximum Life per second.
runes.Living Bomb: Inferno's Burning duration is increased to 8 seconds. Enemies killed by Inferno explode, dealing 106 damage.
runes.Meteor Shower: Inferno triggers Meteorites that deal 149 to enemies and Immobilize them for 1 second.
runes.Overpower: Inferno overfills your Overpower by 2 stacks.
runes.Pull: Inferno continuously pulls enemies towards the center.

inferno fragment.description: While you are Volatile in Demonform, Hellfire Skill damage causes you to emanate fire for 2 seconds, dealing 30% of that damage to Close enemies periodically over 2 seconds.
inferno fragment.name: Inferno Fragment

initiative.description: When you find the District Boss you gain the Initiative buff, which has a duration equal to your remaining Time. Initiative is lost upon death. If you slay the District Boss with Initiative active, you receive Tribute rewards as if your Attunement was 2 higher (max 6). All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.
initiative.name: Initiative

injured.description: Cast when the player becomes Injured.
injured.name: Injured

inner sight.description: Attack enemies to fill your Inner Sight gauge. Marked enemies fill it faster. When full, restore 300 Energy, and gain 100% Energy Cost Reduction, +25% Critical Strike Chance, and x25% Critical Strike Damage for 4 seconds.
inner sight.name: Inner Sight

inspiration.description: Enemies affected by Raheir's Ground Slam take x15% increased damage. Allies affected by Raheir's Bastion deal x25% increased damage.
inspiration.name: Inspiration

intimidated.description: While Varyana has Bloodthirst, enemies around her deal 15% reduced damage.
intimidated.name: Intimidated

invigorating strike.description: Melee attack an enemy, dealing 65 damage and also gain 3 Energy once every 1 second for 4 seconds.
invigorating strike.name: Invigorating Strike

runes.Accumulating Strike: Invigorating Strike now deals 114 damage and every 3rd cast grants 1 stack of Resolve and 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Cast Speed: Increases Invigorating Strike Cast Speed by 5% when hitting an enemy for the first time, up to 20%, for 4 seconds.
runes.Energy: Gain 2 additional Energy once every 1 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike. If a Close enemy is Crowd Controlled, the additional Energy gain is increased to 4.
runes.Enervating Strike: Invigorating Strike now cleaves, dealing 85 Cold damage and Chilling enemies for 20% per attack.
runes.Healing: Heal for 2% of your Maximum Life once every 1 seconds for 4 seconds after hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike.
runes.Quick Strike: Invigorating Strike is also a Mobility Skill. Casting Invigorating Strike now dashes you to the target, dealing 114 damage and granting x10% increased Movement Speed for 3 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Hitting an enemy with Invigorating Strike makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

iron grip.description: Varyana's Ancient Harpoons travel 33% farther and reduce enemies' Impairment Resistance by 50% for 5 seconds.
iron grip.name: Iron Grip

iron maelstrom.description: Activate three times to attach chains to each of your weapons and perform an attack:
iron maelstrom.name: Iron Maelstrom

runes.Additional Effect:
Each attack gains an additional effect: Two Handed Bludgeoning deals x25%
increased Critical Strike Damage Two Handed Slashing deals x20% increased
damage to Vulnerable enemies. Dual Wield gains +20% Cast Speed.
runes.Armageddon: Each attack gains an additional effect: Two Handed Bludgeoning creates a Earthquake that deals 135 Physical damage over 4 seconds Two-Handed Slashing shoots Iron Shrapnel dealing 4 damage inflicting 216 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds Dual Wield forms Dust Devils that each deal 13 damage.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Weapon swaps reduce the Cooldown of Iron Maelstrom by 2 seconds.
runes.Global Cooldown Reduction: Activating Iron Maelstrom reduces all other active Cooldowns by 2 seconds.
runes.Hidden Technique: Iron Maelstrom now has 3 Charges and it always uses the same attack that matches your last used weapon at x75% increased damage.
runes.Mastered Weapon: Depending on your last used weapon, Iron Maelstrom is now also a single Weapon Mastery Skill, and its Cooldown is reduced to 11 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Enemies damaged by Iron Maelstrom are Weakened for 4 seconds.

iron maiden.description: Curse the target area. Enemies afflicted by Iron Maiden take 30 damage every 2 seconds and 30 damage each time they deal direct damage for 30 seconds.
iron maiden.name: Iron Maiden

runes.Blood Maiden: Iron Maiden is also a Blood Skill, causing enemies damaged by it to have a 5% chance to form a Blood Orb. Casting Iron Maiden picks up 4 Blood Orbs in the target area and causes them to burst for 150 damage.
runes.Essence Generation: Iron Maiden no longer has an Essence cost and instead generates 5 Essence for each enemy you curse that was not already afflicted with Iron Maiden.
runes.Execute and Fortify: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden will be Executed. You are Fortified for 5% of your Maximum Life when an enemy dies while afflicted with Iron Maiden.
runes.Ferocity and Overpower: Lucky Hit: Enemies hit while afflicted with Iron Maiden have up to a 15% chance to randomly grant 1 stack of Ferocity or Overpower.
runes.Schadenfreude: While at least 1 enemy is afflicted with Iron Maiden, you gain X Thorns. Iron Maiden's damage is increased by 100% of your Thorns.
runes.Torture Artist: Iron Maiden is also a Darkness Skill that deals Shadow damage. Enemies have 30% chance to be stunned for 2 seconds when they take damage from Iron Maiden.
runes.Vulnerable: Enemies afflicted with Iron Maiden are Vulnerable.

iron skin.description: Steel yourself for 3 seconds, increasing only your Maximum Life by 10% and gaining a Barrier that absorbs value1 of your Maximum Life in damage.
iron skin.name: Iron Skin

runes.Endure: Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier, but your Life cannot be reduced below 1 for the duration and you are healed to value2 Life when Iron Skin expires.
runes.Juggernaut: Iron Skin also grants Unstoppable and enemies that hit you are Knocked back.
runes.Maximum Life: Increase the Maximum Life granted from Iron Skin to 15%.
runes.Movement Speed: Iron Skin increases your Movement Speed by x15%.
runes.Resolve: Iron Skin grants 2 stacks of Resolve when cast.
runes.Retaliation: Iron Skin no longer grants a Barrier. Instead you reflect Iron Shrapnel when attacked, dealing 5 damage and inflicting 50 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds. Iron Skin's duration is tripled.
runes.Weaken: Enemies attacking you while Iron Skin is active become Weakened for 3 seconds.

iron wolf s arrival.description: When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he also casts Ground Slam and Shield Throw. Raheir's Valiance's Cooldown is reduced by 35%.
iron wolf s arrival.name: Iron Wolf's Arrival

iron wolf s call.description: When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, your next 4 Core Skills within 10 seconds deal x25% increased damage and cost no Resource. Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.
iron wolf s call.name: Iron Wolf's Call

iron wolf s virtue.description: When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Heals you for 25% of your Maximum Life. Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.
iron wolf s virtue.name: Iron Wolf's Virtue

iron wolf s ward.description: When Raheir's Valiance is triggered, he Knocks Back Close enemies and Taunts Distant enemies for 4 seconds. Raheir's Valiance Cooldown is reduced by 35%.
iron wolf s ward.name: Iron Wolf's Ward

jade epiphany.description: When you gain an Attunement level in the Undercity, Experience Orbs appear around you. All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.
jade epiphany.name: Jade Epiphany

jaguar.description: Every 15th time you deal direct damage with a Jaguar Skill, unleash a Beast Strike dealing 140% damage, increasing all damage you deal by x3% and doubling each subsequent Beast Strike's damage, stacking 5 times. You lose all stacks when you stop attacking for 1 second. All Skills are now also Jaguar Skills.
jaguar.name: Jaguar

judicator.description: Your Basic Skills now apply Judgement. Judgement can now be detonated early by your Core Judicator Skills, dealing 80% weapon damage in a small area and gaining Judicator Skill benefits. Judging an enemy, increases the damage they take from you by x80% until they die.
judicator.name: Judicator

juggernaut.description: Casting a Juggernaut Skill Consumes 8 stacks of Resolve, giving your Juggernaut Skills x80% increased damage and 20% increased size for 5 seconds. Your Minimum Resolve is increased by 1 and is no longer consumed when getting hit.
juggernaut.name: Juggernaut

kick.description: Throw a powerful kick that deals 100 damage and Knocks Back enemies in front of you. Enemies who are Knocked Back into terrain take an additional 50 damage and are Stunned for 3 seconds.
kick.name: Kick

runes.Collide: Kicked enemies deal 20% damage to enemies they collide with. Additionally, Kick destroys certain objects from Elite monster affixes.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Kicking an enemy reduces the Cooldowns of your Mobility Skills by 2 seconds.
runes.Crimson: Kick now deals 25 Fire damage and inflicts 25 Burning damage over 4 seconds. Burning enemies will explode on Death or if they hit a wall for 75 damage.
runes.Increase Damage: Moving increases Kick's damage by up to x20%.
runes.Madness: You dash towards your enemy and deliver a powerful kick that deals 175 and Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds. Kick is additionally a Mobility Skill.
runes.Power: Instead of Knocking Back enemies, Kick becomes a Core Skill which costs 30 Fury and deals 100 damage, increased by x0.5% per Maximum Fury you have, up to 150 Fury.
runes.Vulnerable: Kick makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

lacerate.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf, become Immune and quickly dash 10 times between enemies in the area dealing up to 600 total damage over 2 seconds.
lacerate.name: Lacerate

runes.Additional Strikes: Lacerate gains 5 additional strikes over 1 seconds.
runes.Damage Bonus to Multiple: Lacerate gains a x10% bonus damage bonus each time it strikes a different enemy up to a maximum of 200%.
runes.Damage Bonus to Target: When Lacerate directly strikes the same enemy, that enemy takes x5% stacking bonus damage from Lacerate.
runes.Ferocity: Lacerate grants 1 Stacks of Ferocity each second while active.
runes.Hunter Killer: Lacerate gains 7 additional strikes and deals its total damage 50% faster.
runes.Temperance Training: Lacerate grants a x30% Movement Speed bonus and Lesser Enemies are pulled along with you. Lacerate's damage is also increased by x50%.
runes.Toxin Outburst: Lacerate explodes when striking a Poisoned target, dealing 70% of the total Poisoning damage to all nearby enemies.

lair of plenty.description: Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power. Gain +1 Hoard Chest when you slay a Lair Boss.
lair of plenty.name: Lair of Plenty

lair of runes.description: Lair Bosses have +1 Monster Power. Lair Bosses have a higher chances of dropping specific Runes.
lair of runes.name: Lair of Runes

landslide.description: Crush enemies between 3 pillars of earth, each dealing 55 damage.
landslide.name: Landslide

runes.Continental Shift: Gain 2 additional pillars. In addition, Landslide's size is increased by 50% and damage is increased to 74 .
runes.Critical Strike Chance: Landslide's Critical Strike Chance is increased by 5% and up to an additional 15% based on how much of your Maximum Life is Fortified.
runes.Initial Damage Bonus: Landslide deals 100% bonus damage when hitting the first enemy.
runes.Land Mine: When cast, Landslide is dormant at the target location for 1 second. Afterwards, Landslide will automatically trigger when an enemy steps on it, dealing 500% bonus damage split between all enemies damaged. Max 5 Landslides can be active at a time and last 20 seconds. Landslide is also a Trap Skill.
runes.Resolve: Landslide grants 1 stack of Resolve when hitting the first enemy.
runes.Vengeance of Earth:
Landslide's pillars automatically crush individualtargets in the area. Landslide gains a 120% damage bonus for the first pillar, reducing by 30% for each subsequent
pillar.

last gasp.description: Time collected from slain enemies with 5 seconds or less remaining in the Undercity doubles the Time earned.
last gasp.name: Last Gasp

leap.description: Leap forward and then slam down, dealing 55 damage and Slowing surrounding enemies by 70% for 3 seconds.
leap.name: Leap

runes.Arsenal Bonus:
Leap grants a bonus based on its Arsenal
Selection Dual Wield: 2 seconds of Berserking Bludgeoning: 1 stack of Overpower Slashing: 1 stack of Ferocity
runes.Damage Bonus and Crowd Control: Leap deals x20% increased damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1 second.
runes.Death From Above: Leap's Size and damage are increased the further you Leap, up to 30% increased Size and 96 damage.
runes.Earthshatter: Leap now deals 19 damage and can be Cast again within 2 seconds before the Cooldown begins. Landing creates an Earthquake that deals 77 Physical damage over 4 seconds.
runes.Mosh: Leap Summons 3 Ancients that Leap at a random enemy and deal 14 damage.
runes.Pull: Leap now Pulls In enemies upon landing.

legion shard.description: Casting a Greater Demon Skill increases Lesser Demon Skill Cast Speed by +25% and Cooldown Rate by 20% for 10 seconds. When 200 of your Lesser Demons die, your next Greater Demon Skill Cast has no Dominance Cost.
legion shard.name: Legion Shard

lightning spear.description: Summon a spear of lightning that seeks out enemies for 6 seconds, dealing 120 damage per hit. You may have up to 12 Lightning Spears active at a time.
lightning spear.name: Lightning Spear

runes.Chain Reaction: Lightning Spear arcs to 2 additional surrounding targets dealing 48 damage. Critical Strikes greatly increase the range of the arcs.
runes.Critical Strike: Lightning Spear gains 10% increased Critical Strike Chance.
runes.Damage Bonus: Lightning Spear deals x100% increased damage. This bonus is reduced by x10% each time Lightning Spear deals damage to an enemy.
runes.Duration Bonus: When a Lightning Spear Critically Strikes, its duration is increased by 0.1 seconds.
runes.Flame Spear: Lightning Spear becomes a Pyromancy Skill, deals 198 Fire damage, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds. Burning enemies hit by Lightning Spear explode for 120 .
runes.Reverse Polarity: Lightning Spear fires 2 spears that deal 96 damage Stun enemies for value1 second. Enemies can only be Stunned this way once every 5 seconds.

lightning storm.description: Conjure a growing lightning storm that deals 65 damage per strike. The number of strikes increase the longer the storm is channeled up to a maximum of 10 strikes at once. Lighting Storm may grow up to 5 times. The size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for 4 seconds after channeling.
lightning storm.name: Lightning Storm

runes.Additional Strikes: Gain 1 additional Lightning Strike. Furthermore, each stack of Ferocity also grants 1 additional Lightning Strike, up to a maximum of 4 additional strikes.
runes.Damage Bonus: Lightning Storm's gains x10% bonus damage. This bonus is increased to x25% if the target is Vulnerable.
runes.Hero of the Storm: Lightning Storm can be toggled passively and travels with you. Lightning Storm deals 91 damage and will be maintained as long as you have enough Spirit. Cast Lightning Storm again to cancel this effect.
runes.Minimum Strikes: Lightning Storm always grows from a baseline of 2 strikes.
runes.Movement Speed: The size of your Lightning Storm is preserved for an additional 4 seconds after channeling. In addition, you gain a x10% Movement Speed bonus while Lightning Storm's size is preserved.
runes.Omnibolt: All of your Lightning Strikes are combined into one powerful attack at the targeted location. Size is increased by 15% and damage is increased by x50% per Lightning Strike.
runes.Supercell: Lightning Storm may grow 1 additional time and each periodic gains 3 additional strikes.

loaded munitions.description: Subo's Wire Traps and Trip Mines inflict Vulnerable on enemies for 5 seconds.
loaded munitions.name: Loaded Munitions

lunging strike.description: Lunge forward and strike an enemy, dealing 90 damage.
lunging strike.name: Lunging Strike

runes.Berserking: Lunging Strike grants Berserking for 3 seconds when it Critically Strikes. Lunging Strike gains +5% increased Critical Strike Chance.
runes.Fury Generation: Lunging Strike generates 1 Fury for each enemy you lunge through.
runes.Healing: Lunging Strike heals you for 2% of your Maximum Life the first time it hits an enemy.
runes.Impaling: Lunging Strike has increased range, damages all enemies in its path, and can lunge without a target. Lunging Strike now has a 2 second Cooldown.
runes.Range: Lunging Strike's range is increased by 2.
runes.Skewer: Lunging Strike deals x75% increased damage and an additional x5% increased damage for each target you lunge through, up to x100%.
runes.Whirling: Lunging Strike forms a Dust Devil that deals 22 damage.

malignant invasion.description: Varshan can now appear in a Whisper Ambushes. Slay Varshan to earn the contents of an Ancestral Collection of Chaos.
malignant invasion.name: Malignant Invasion

masochistic.description: Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes with Shapeshifting Skills have up to a 30% chance to grant Berserking for 4 seconds. Berserking increases the damage of Shapeshifting Skills by x10%.
masochistic.name: Masochistic

massacre.description: You and Varyana stack Massacre together on kills. Certain stack thresholds grant Movement Speed:
massacre.name: Massacre

mastermind.description: Subo's Wire Trap and Trip Mines gain 60% Size. You and Subo gain +25% Crowd Control Duration.
mastermind.name: Mastermind

mastermind shard.description: Recast Skills no longer break Shadowform Stealth at the cost of 2 stacks of Shadowform per Cast. While you have Shadowform, Abyss Skills deal x30% increased damage, and you gain +5% increased Movement Speed per stack.
mastermind shard.name: Mastermind Shard

material wealth.description: The Tree now only offers Material Collections.
material wealth.name: Material Wealth

maul.description: Shapeshift into a Werebear and maul enemies in front of you, dealing 80 damage.
maul.name: Maul

runes.Berserking: Maul has a 25% chance when first dealing damage to grant Berserking for 4 seconds.
runes.Overpower: Maul's grants 1 stack of Overpower per cast when dealing damage.
runes.Reckless Rage: Maul deals x250% increased damage but generates 10 less Spirit.
runes.Resolve: Maul's grants 1 stack of Resolve per cast when dealing damage.
runes.Stone Fists: Maul is also an Earth Skill. Maul turns your fists to stone allowing you to punch enemies with the might of the Earth dealing 160 damage.
runes.Wide Sweeps: Increases the range and radius of Maul by 50%. Maul's damage is increased to 120 .

meat brothers.description: Instead of Hellborne, two Butchers that are connected with flaming chains ambush you. These Butchers each have a high chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.
meat brothers.name: Meat Brothers

metamorphosis.description: Transform into a demon and gain:
metamorphosis.name: Metamorphosis

runes.Damage Scaling: Metamorphosis increases your Demonology Skill damage by x1% for each 1000 bonus Maximum Life you have.
runes.Destruction Demon: Metamorphosis does not replace any Skills and grants Volatility while active. Each Hellfire Skill cast increases your Hellfire damage by x value2 but Burns you for 8% Maximum Life over 3 seconds. Each Cast deals 5% increased Burning to you and Metamorphosis ends if you become Injured or cancel early.
runes.Dominance: Metamorphosis reduces your Dominance Costs by 20%.
runes.Sin Demon: Casting Archfiend Skills during Metamorphosis grants Sin, up to 20 stacks. When you leave Metamorphosis each Sin can be consumed by casting Non-Archfiend Skills to generate 3 Dominance and Wrath. This can exceed up to 50% of your Maximum Resource values.
runes.Stagger Bar: Metamorphosis makes you Unstoppable but each time you are hit with a Crowd Control you take 10 Stagger. When you reach 100 Stagger you are Stunned for 5 seconds.
runes.Terror Demon: Metamorphosis becomes an Abyss Skill that does not replace any Skills and lasts for value1 seconds. Metamorphosis grants 4 Shadowform stacks every second and Abyss Skills do not break its Stealth while active.

meteor.description: Call down a meteor that crashes into enemies, dealing 180 damage and an additional 60 Burning damage over 3 seconds.
meteor.name: Meteor

runes.Air Burst: Meteor rains down 6 Meteorites before the final impact that each deal 45 damage each, but Meteor no longer deals Burning damage.
runes.Comet: Meteor becomes a Frost Skill that deals Cold damage. Meteor calls down an icy Comet that deals 270 damage and creates an icy mist that inflicts 66 Frostbite and 50% Chill over 3 seconds.
runes.Damage and Size Bonus: Meteor deals x50% increased damage and has x50% increased Size, but now also has a 15 second Cooldown.
runes.Immobilize: Meteor Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds on impact.
runes.Overpower: Meteor's Impact damage now grants 1 stack of Overpower per enemy hit.
runes.Resource Damage Bonus: Meteor now consumes all your remaining Mana on Cast, dealing x2% increased damage for each point of extra Mana spent.
runes.Shooting Star: Removes the falling delay before Meteor crashes down. Meteor now deals 306 impact damage and 102 Burning damage over 3 seconds.

method and madness.description: Your Infernal Offerings are more likely to share a category with your previous choice.
method and madness.name: Method and Madness

mighty throw.description: Hurl your weapon, dealing 210 damage upon impact and sticking in the ground. While in the ground, your weapon pulses and deals 100 damage every second for 4 seconds.
mighty throw.name: Mighty Throw

runes.Barrier: Mighty Throw generates up to 15% of your Maximum Life as a Barrier for 6 seconds.
runes.Ferocity: Grants 3 stacks of Ferocity each time you use Mighty Throw.
runes.Mightiest: Mighty Throw is now an Ultimate Skill that drops a massive weapon for 542 damage with a 6 second cooldown. This cooldown cannot be reduced by Cooldown Reduction.
runes.Overpower: Mighty Throw now consumes one of your Overpower stacks to deal x20% increased damage.
runes.Rapid: Swapping weapons near any of Mighty Throw's thrown weapons creates an additional pulse for 50 damage.
runes.Size Bonus: Increase Mighty Throw's damage radius by 20%.
runes.Spares: Mighty Throw hurls another 2 weapons, dealing 137 damage upon impact, and pulses for 65 damage.

mocking lure.description: You deal x15% increased damage to enemies Taunted by Raheir.
mocking lure.name: Mocking Lure

molotov.description: Subo tosses an incendiary at an enemy, dealing 10% Physical damage and Stunning them for 1 second before exploding into flames. For the next 5 seconds, enemies within the area repeatedly take 36% Burning damage over 3 seconds. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.
molotov.name: Molotov

molten bomb.description: Lob volatile lava at an enemy, dealing 75 damage in a small area.
molten bomb.name: Molten Bomb

runes.Area Bonus: Molten Bomb's impact area is increased by 30% but does x30% increased damage to enemies at its center.
runes.Brimstone Bomb: Molten Bomb creates Brimstone at the impact location which deals 56 damage when it explodes.
runes.Cluster Bomb: Molten Bomb becomes an Abyss Skill and now lobs a cluster of 6 smaller shadow orbs which each deal 23 damage. Casting another Molten Bomb splits the previous cluster midflight.
runes.Demon Turret: Molten Bomb creates a turret demon on impact for 5 seconds that spits lava at surrounding enemies, each dealing 24 damage. You can have up to 6 turrets active at once.
runes.Knock Down: Molten Bomb has a 15% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds. When Molten Bomb is empowered by Volatility this chance is increased to 100%. Can occur once every 4 seconds per enemy.
runes.Ranged Damage: Molten Bomb deals up to x40% increased damage based on how far it travels.
runes.Wrath: Molten Bomb generates 1 additional Wrath on each impact.

nemesis.description: Activating a Shrine in a Nightmare Dungeon causes up to 7 Elites to ambush you.
nemesis.name: Nemesis

nemesis tides.description: Initiate Lair Bosses have a chance to appear instead of Helltide Commanders after Helltide Events. Killing Lair Bosses in Helltides while earning the Event Mastery grants many random Lair Boss materials. This only occurs in Torment+ difficulties.
nemesis tides.name: Nemesis Tides

nether step.description: Step through the shadows of Hell to emerge at the target location, gaining 4 stacks of Shadowform as well as x50% increased Movement Speed which decays over value1 seconds.
nether step.name: Nether Step

runes.Damage Reduction: Nether Step grants 60% Damage Reduction that decays alongside its Movement Speed Bonus.
runes.Extra Charge: Nether Step gains an additional Charge.
runes.Gloomwalker: Nether Step now lets you run through the abyss while Immune for up to 3 seconds. Cast again to exit early.
runes.Movement Speed: Nether Step's Movement Speed Bonus lasts 50% longer.
runes.Portals: Nether Step's portals remain for 10 seconds and can be re-entered to move back and forth.
runes.Recall Shadows: Nether Step brings all your Abyss Summons with you through the shadows and extends their durations by 3 seconds.
runes.Vacuum Swap: Nether Step sucks enemies into the exit portal and swap places with them.

night terrors.description: You have a chance to be ambushed by Hellborne in Nightmare Dungeons. Hellborne have a small chance to drop a Profane Mindcage when slain.
night terrors.name: Night Terrors

no escape.description: Varyana's Whirlwind Pulls In enemies every 1.5 seconds and gains 60% Size.
no escape.name: No Escape

obsidian slam.description: Casting an Earth Skill grants 1 stack of Resolve. Gaining or losing Resolve increases the damage Earth Skills deal by x20% for 4 seconds.
obsidian slam.name: Obsidian Slam

opening fire.description: You deal x25% increased Critical Strike Damage to enemies hit by Subo's Cover Fire for 4 seconds.
opening fire.name: Opening Fire

out of the cold.description: When fighting a Boss in a Nightmare Dungeon, the Beast in Ice has a chance to appear and attack you. When this occurs, killing the Nightmare Dungeon Boss has a chance to drop Unique Items from the Beast in Ice's Hoard Chest.
out of the cold.name: Out of the Cold

overload.description: Lucky Hit: Storm Skills have up to a 20% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity. Storm Skills gain +15% increased Cast Speed while you have Ferocity.
overload.name: Overload

packleader.description: Lucky Hit: Critical Strikes have up to a 15% chance to reset the Cooldowns of your Companion Skills.
packleader.name: Packleader

paranoia.description: Languishing enemies take x15% increased damage from you. Lucky Hit: Attacks against Languishing enemies have up to a 20% chance to Daze them for 1 second.
paranoia.name: Paranoia

pathfinder.description: When you reach maximum Attunement, a portal to the final floor of the Undercity appears. All enemies within the Undercity have +1 Monster Power.
pathfinder.name: Pathfinder

payback.description: Smash enemies in front of you, dealing 175 damage. When attacked, you have a 5% chance to reset Payback's Cooldown.
payback.name: Payback

runes.Area Increase: Payback echoes forward damaging a larger area.
runes.Block Chance: Payback grants +20% Block Chance for 5 seconds.
runes.Break Free: Becoming Control Impaired or Injured while Payback is on Cooldown makes it free to Cast and grants you Unstoppable and 40% Damage Reduction for 4 seconds. Can only occur once every 8 seconds.
runes.Damage Increase: Each time an enemy attacks you, the damage they take from Payback is increased by x10%, up to x50%.

penetrating shot.description: Fire an arrow that pierces through all enemies in a line, dealing 150 damage.
penetrating shot.name: Penetrating Shot

runes.Ballista: Penetrating Shot takes 100% longer to fire, but shoots a larger, more powerful arrow dealing 525 damage.

runes.Ferocity: Penetrating Shot deals x7% increased damage per stack of Ferocity.

runes.Slow: Penetrating Shot Slows enemies hit by 40% for 4 seconds.
runes.Trick Shot: Whenever Penetrating Shot damages an enemy, 2 additional arrows split off to either side. These side arrows deal x50% of Penetrating Shot's Base damage and do not split.
runes.Vulnerable: Penetrating Shot deals x20% increased damage to Vulnerable enemies.

petrify.description: Encase all Nearby enemies in stone, Stunning them for 3 seconds. Petrified enemies take + value1 bonus Critical Strike Damage from you.
petrify.name: Petrify

runes.Duration: Petrify's duration is increased by 1 second.

runes.Greater Petrify: Increase Petrify's duration by x50% and reduces the Cooldown by 15 seconds.

piercing arrows.description: Subo's Heavy Shot now pierces through enemies.
piercing arrows.name: Piercing Arrows

pin cushion.description: Subo's Cover Fire also Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds.
pin cushion.name: Pin Cushion

pit butcher.description: The Butcher has a chance to appear anywhere in The Pit. The Butcher is a Guardian and killing him will complete the run. However, you fail the run if he kills any player.
pit butcher.name: Pit Butcher

planar tremors.description: Hellwyrms will always open a Chaos Rift, and enemies that emerge from it gain +1 Monster Power. The first time a Chaos Rift opens, there is a chance that another will open.
planar tremors.name: Planar Tremors

poison creeper.description: Passive: Summon 1 poison creeper to periodically emerge from the ground every 7 seconds, applying 65 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to an enemy in the area. Active: Vines strangle all surrounding enemies, Immobilizing them for 2 seconds and Poisoning them for 180 damage over 2 seconds.
poison creeper.name: Poison Creeper

runes.Active Poisoning Duration: Active: Poison Creeper's active Poisoning duration is increased by 3 seconds.
runes.Carnivorous: Active: Poison Creeper immediately deals 144 direct damage.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Active: Reduces Poison Creeper's Cooldown by 8 seconds.
runes.Fortify: Passive: Poison Creeper grants 10% Fortify every 3 seconds.
runes.Germinate: Active: Enemies that die while afflicted with the active Poisoning damage have a 20% chance to trigger another active effect for free.
runes.Toxic Vegetation: Active: Poison Creeper's active effect becomes an aura around you for 4 seconds, dealing 324 total Poisoning damage and Slowing enemies by 80%. Poison Creeper no longer Immobilizes.

poison imbuement.description: Imbue your weapons with lethal poison for 6 seconds. While Imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Poison damage and apply value1 of their Base damage as additional Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.
poison imbuement.name: Poison Imbuement

runes.Cooldown: Lucky Hit: Poison Imbued Skills have up to a 30% chance to reduce the Cooldown of Poison Imbuement by 2 seconds.
runes.Corrosive Ring: Passive: Poison Imbuement corrodes enemies around you, dealing 25 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. While imbued, the size of the corrosion is increased by +100%. Each enemy affected by Poison Imbuement increases your Energy Regeneration by x10%, up to x100%.

runes.Sapper: Lucky Hit: Poison Imbued Skills have up to a 100% chance to Fortify you value2 of your Maximum Life. While imbued, your Fortify heals you 50% faster.
runes.Toxic Touch: Poison Imbuement gains x40% increased Potency. Each successive time an enemy is Poisoned by Poison Imbuement, the Potency of Poison Imbuement against the enemy is increased by x5%, up to x50%.

poison trap.description: Place a trap that arms after 1.25 seconds. It activates when an enemy moves within range, applying 540 Poisoning damage over 9 seconds to enemies in the area. You can have 4 armed traps out at once.
poison trap.name: Poison Trap

runes.Contamination: Poison Trap bursts for an additional 162 damage when it triggers. Enemies hit by this burst take x40% increased damage from Poison Trap.
runes.Frostbite Trap: Poison Trap no longer deals Poisoning damage and instead deals 945 Frostbite damage and Chills enemies for 20% per second.

polearm.description: x15% increased Lucky Hit Chance. You deal x15% increased damage while Healthy.
polearm.name: Polearm

preparation.description: Spend 75 Energy to reduce your Ultimate Skill's Cooldown by 5 seconds. Ultimate Skills grant 15% Damage Reduction for 10 seconds.
preparation.name: Preparation

prickleskin.description: Deal x15% increased damage to enemies for 5 seconds after they attack you.
prickleskin.name: Prickleskin

profane sentinel.description: Summon a demonic eye for 15 seconds that focuses upon enemies with a beam that makes them Vulnerable and periodically blasts them, dealing 180 damage. Recast to direct the eye's targeting.
profane sentinel.name: Profane Sentinel

runes.Demonic Glare: Profane Sentinel becomes a Hellfire eye blast attack that transforms you into Demonform, dealing 234 damage and Weakening enemies.
runes.Focused Glare: The longer Profane Sentinel is locked onto the same enemy the stronger it becomes, dealing 25% more damage every second.
runes.Lesser Demon Vulnerable: Casting Profane Sentinel induces your Lesser Demon Skills to make enemies Vulnerable for 5 seconds.
runes.Narrow Blast: Profane Sentinel deals x25% increased damage but its blast area is reduced by 50%.

runes.Single Target Damage: Profane Sentinel deals x30% when it only hits a single target.
runes.Wide Beam: Profane Sentinel's beam area is 125% larger.

provoke.description: Raheir Taunts enemies around you for 5 seconds. You gain 5% Damage Reduction for each target, up to 20%.
provoke.name: Provoke

pulse of aether.description: Suppressing a Chaos Wave grants +50 Aether. All enemies in the Infernal Hordes gain +1 Monster Power.
pulse of aether.name: Pulse of Aether

pulverize.description: Shapeshift into a Werebear and slam the ground, dealing 175 damage to surrounding enemies.
pulverize.name: Pulverize

runes.Cost Reduction: Reduces the Spirit cost of Pulverize by 7.

Pulverize deals x20% bonus damage to the first 5 enemies hit.

puncture.description: Throw blades a short distance, dealing 45 damage.

purify.description: Enshroud your enemies in the Light, Dazing them for value1 seconds.
purify.name: Purify

quill volley.description: Hurl 5 feathers that pierce through enemies, each dealing 20 damage.
quill volley.name: Quill Volley

rabies.description: Perform an infectious bite against enemies in front of you, dealing 28 damage and applying an additional 300 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Infected enemies spread Rabies to other surrounding targets.

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Rabies' Cooldown is reduced by 4 seconds.
runes.Healing: Enemies that die while affected by Rabies will heal you for 2% Maximum Life.
runes.Malaise: Rabies deals its full damage after 4 seconds as Direct Damage to the target. This Direct Damage gains +150% (+300% while Berserking) bonus Critical Strike Damage.
runes.Poisoning Speed: Rabies deals its total Poisoning damage 50% faster.

raging havoc.description: Enemies damaged by Aldkin's Wave of Flame take x15% increased Damage Over Time for 4 seconds.
raging havoc.name: Raging Havoc

raging violence.description: Allies gain +15% Critical Strike Chance against enemies affected by Flame Surge.
raging violence.name: Raging Violence

raheir s aegis.description: Raheir grants you 15% Resistance to All Elements.

rain of arrows.description: Arrows rain down over a large area dealing 450 damage and Immobilizing enemies hit for 3 seconds.
rain of arrows.name: Rain of Arrows

runes.Cast Speed and Lucky Hit: Rain of Arrows' Cast Speed is increased by +50% and Lucky Hit Chance is increased by x50%.

rampage v2.description: Summon a rampaging brute for 10 seconds that smashes wildly, dealing 64 damage with a 5% chance per hit to Eviscerate enemies for 1280 damage.
rampage v2.name: Rampage-v2

ravens.name: Ravens

runes.Active Damage Bonus: Active: Raven's active damage is increased by x300%.
runes.Migration: Active: The active area is 50% larger. If the target dies, the Raven Flock moves itself torwards a new target.

runes.Vulnerable: Passive: Raven attacks make enemies Vulnerable.
