runes.Evolving Claws: Using Rushing Claw’s last Charge will refill 4 Charges by consuming 4 stacks of Ferocity. Rushing Claw deals 30% increased damage and is empowered based on how many Charges it has when you Cast it: 1: Heals value1 of your Maximum Life. 2: Guaranteed to Critically Strike. 3: Gain 100% Dodge Chance for 1.5 seconds. 4+: Strikes an additional time.
runes.Incarnate Duration: Rushing Claw extends the duration of your active Incarnate Skills by 0.5 seconds up to 4 seconds.

sacrificial fragment.description: You are Unstoppable and your Demonology Skills deal x20% increased damage as long as you have active Lesser Demon Summons. When you would become Crowd Controlled, 1 of your Lesser Demon Summons is sacrificed.
sacrificial fragment.name: Sacrificial Fragment

scale of tathamet.description: Once per wave the Scale of Tathamet may appear, a primordial relic that kills all enemies within the Infernal Hordes.
scale of tathamet.name: Scale of Tathamet

scorched earth.description: Subo's initial Molotov explosions cause enemies to take x30% increased Damage Over Time from you for 3 seconds.
scorched earth.name: Scorched Earth

scorching fragment.description: Occult Hellfire Skills are always empowered and consume 4% of your Maximum Life. Volatility can now stack up to 3 times, increasing the damage of empowered Skills by x10% and the Life they consume by +1% per stack. Command Vollach also siphons its life to Fortify you for 8% of your Maximum Life and causes Vollach to pay 100% of Life Costs instead while you've siphoned its power.
scorching fragment.name: Scorching Fragment

scourge.description: Call forth a wave of insects that bite enemies, Fearing and Slowing them by 70% for 3 seconds while applying 100 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.
scourge.name: Scourge

runes.Healing: Lucky Hit: Hitting an enemy affected by Scourge has up to a 30% chance to Heal you for 5% of your Maximum Life.
runes.Hive Mind: Scourge grants you 15% Damage Reduction and continuously affects enemies around you for 4.5 seconds.
runes.Scourge Commander: Scourge now appears at your target location and deals an extra 80 damage. This amount is increased by 200% against Vulnerable enemies.
runes.The Beast Within: Scourge becomes a Gorilla Skill. Unleash the power of the Gorilla, gaining X Thorns for each surrounding enemy for 5 seconds and triggering a Thorns attack dealing value1 against them. Repeat this damage every 0.75 seconds for 1.5 seconds.
runes.Vigor Generation: Casting Scourge grants 50 Vigor over 6 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Enemies affected by Scourge are Vulnerable.
runes.Weaken: Scourge also Weakens enemies for 6 seconds.

scythe talons.description: Gain +10% increased Critical Strike Chance and x15% increased Lucky Hit Chance.
scythe talons.name: Scythe Talons

seeker.description: Passive: Subo reveals all enemies and materials in the area. Active: Subo calls out an enemy target, marking them for 10 seconds. Killing a marked enemy restores 50 of your Primary Resource and reduces Subo's Seeker Cooldown by 10 seconds.
seeker.name: Seeker

sever.description: A specter of you charges forward, dealing 60 damage, then attacks with its scythe, dealing 100 damage.
sever.name: Sever

runes.Cold Pursuit: Sever deals Cold damage, Chills for 15%, and seeks another enemy to attack again.
runes.Cost Reduction: Sever's Essence cost is reduced by 4.
runes.Crowd Control and Corpse Generation: Sever Slows enemies by 40% for 3 seconds and forms a Corpse.
runes.Damage Bonus: Sever deals x10% increased damage, and an additional x1% increased damage for each Minion you have.
runes.Ferocity: Sever deals x7% increased damage per stack of Ferocity.
runes.Inexorable Reaper: Sever is also a Mobility Skill that dashes you forward to attack instead.
runes.Reaping Lotus: Sever sends out 3 additional specters at its apex that expand out, dealing 40 damage each.

shadow clone.description: Your shadow mimicks your actions for 15 seconds. This Shadow Clone deals value1 of your damage.
shadow clone.name: Shadow Clone

runes.Awakening: Passive: After spending 100 Energy, your next Core Skill Cast becomes a Shade Skill and spawns a Shade that deals value2 of its damage. Shadow Clone is now also a Shade Skill and its duration is reduced by x50%.
runes.Cooldown: Shadow Clone's Cooldown is reduced by 10 seconds.
runes.Relentless: Minimum Ferocity is increased by 4 as long as Shadow Clone is present. Shadow Clone's duration is increased by 5 seconds and deals x25% increased damage.
runes.Resolve: Casting Shadow Clone grants 4 stacks of Resolve. While any Shadow Clone is active, you gain 1 Resolve per 1 second.
runes.Sentry: Shadow Clone becomes a Marksman Skill and now summons a stationary shadow that fires 3 piercing arrows every 1 seconds. Each arrow deals 20 damage. Shadow Clone gains 2 additional Charges, and its Cooldown is reduced by 20 seconds. You may have up to 3 Shadow Clones active at a time.
runes.Unstoppable: Casting Shadow Clone grants Unstoppable for 4 seconds.
runes.Weaken & Vulnerable: Casting Shadow Clone makes all Nearby enemies Weakened and Vulnerable for 6 seconds.

shadow imbuement.description: Imbue your weapons with festering shadows for 6 seconds. While imbued, your Imbueable Skills deal Shadow damage and infect enemies for 6 seconds. Infected enemies explode on death, dealing 40 damage to all surrounding enemies. If the infection expires before the enemy dies, it will deal 60 damage to only that enemy.
shadow imbuement.name: Shadow Imbuement

runes.Dark Dance: Evading through an enemy infected by Shadow Imbuement grants Stealth for 4 seconds and explodes the infection for x value1 increased damage.
runes.Duration: When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, Shadow Imbuement's duration is increased by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.
runes.Endemic: Passive: Shadow Imbuement's Cooldown is reduced by 0.5 seconds each time you kill an enemy. Any enemies you infect with Shadow Imbuement take 40 damage every second until the infection ceases.
runes.Ferocity: When Shadow Imbuement's infection expires, you have a 25% chance to gain 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Overpower: Casting Shadow Imbuement grants 2 stacks of Overpower.
runes.Shadow Play: Lucky Hit: Shadow Imbued Skills have up to a 50% chance to create a Shade that explodes after 1 second, dealing 120 damage. This can only happen once every 0.5 seconds, affected by Attack Speed.
runes.Vulnerable: Shadow Imbued Skills and Shadow Imbuement makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

shadow step.description: Quickly move through the shadows to stab your victim from behind for 80 damage and Execute them. Gain 15% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds afterwards.
shadow step.name: Shadow Step

runes.Artifice:
Shadow Step no longer requires a target, and it leaves a decoy at your starting location that Taunts Nearby enemies and explodes after 2 seconds, dealing 72 Shadow damage.

Shadow Step's Cooldown is increased to 12 seconds.
runes.Cleave: Shadow Step's stab now cleaves, dealing 10% of the original damage to the cleaved targets.
runes.Cooldown: Casting Shadow Step reduces its Cooldown by 3 seconds.
runes.Safe Arrival: Shadow Step Dazes its primary target for 3 seconds and leaves 4 Stun Grenades at its feet that each deal 10 damage.
runes.Sight Unseen: Shadow Step has an additional Charge and refunds a Charge when it kills an enemy. Casting Shadow Step increases its damage by x15% for 5 seconds, up to x75%.
runes.Unstoppable: Casting Shadow Step grants Unstoppable for 2 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Damaging an enemy with Shadow Step applies Vulnerable to them for 4 seconds.

share a drink.description: When one of Subo's Molotovs explodes, it has a 50% chance to drop a Healing Potion for you.
share a drink.name: Share a Drink

shared pain.description: Aldkin's Chain of Souls Cooldown is reduced by 2 seconds when a chained target dies.
shared pain.name: Shared Pain

shield bash.description: Charge at an enemy and bash in front of you, dealing 205 damage.
shield bash.name: Shield Bash

runes.Breach: Hits with Shield Bash grant you +10% Retribution Chance for 5 seconds, stacking up to 5 times.
runes.Damage Bonus: Shield Bash deals x100% more damage to its primary target.
runes.Hits Are Blocks: Shield Bash's hits counts as Blocks. This effect can trigger once per Cast.
runes.Lay Siege: Whenever you have Resolve, Shield Bash increases impact size by x50% and deals 246 damage. Gain 1 Resolve per enemy hit.
runes.Smite: Shield Bash smites the first enemy it hits, dealing 287 damage, Stunning for 1 second, and Knocking Back enemies behind for 102 damage.

shield charge.description: Raheir rushes forward aggressively, dealing 110% Physical damage and Taunting nearby enemies for 4 seconds. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.
shield charge.name: Shield Charge

shield charge v2.description: Charge with your shield and push enemies Back, granting + value1 Armor and dealing 180 damage while Channeling.
shield charge v2.name: Shield Charge-v2

runes.Damage Bonus: Shield Charge's damage increases by x10% when it hits an enemy for 6 seconds, up to x30% .
runes.Hit Count As Blocking: Shield Charge's hits count as Blocks.
runes.Phalanx Charge: Shield Charge surges forward in a wave of energy and Knocks enemies Back, dealing 315 damage.
runes.Relentless Charge: Shield Charge becomes a Core Skill that deals 216 damage. Shield Charge now costs 20 Faith to Cast and an additional 1 Faith per second.
runes.Resolve: Shield Charge grants 1 Resolve whenever it hits an enemy.
runes.Retribution: Shield Charge grants +10% Retribution chance while charging when you hit an enemy up to +30% .
runes.Virtuous Charge: Shield Charge becomes a Judicator Skill and consumes Judgement on impact, increasing the ending nova damage by +20% for each Judgement consumed up to 100%. When Shield Charge ends you release a Holy nova, dealing 180 damage and Stunning enemies for 3 seconds.

shield throw.description: Raheir throws his shield, dealing 450% Physical damage and Taunting enemies for 5 seconds. The shield bounces up to 9 times and cannot bounce to the same target twice.
shield throw.name: Shield Throw

shockwave.description: Varyana slams the ground for a brutal shockwave in front of her, dealing 80% Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies for 2 seconds. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.
shockwave.name: Shockwave

shred.description: Shapeshift into a Werewolf and perform a trio of combo attacks:
shred.name: Shred

runes.Berserking: Shred grants Berserking for 1 seconds. Subsequent casts extend this duration up to a maximum of 4 seconds.
runes.Cast Speed: Shred's Cast Speed is increased by 20%.
runes.Critical Shred: Shred's first attack gains a +100% Critical Strike Chance and +50% Critical Strike Damage bonus.
runes.Healing: Shred Heals for 3% of your Maximum Life if an enemy is struck. Healing is increased to 6% of your Maximum Life when striking a Poisoned enemy.
runes.Roundhouse: Shred's third combo attack becomes a powerful 360 degree swipe that deals 720 damage.
runes.Spirit:
Critical Strikes with Shred restore 1 Spirit.

Striking a Poisoned enemy instead grants 2 Spirit.
runes.Storm Shred: Your Claws are electrically charged allowing Shred to deal x80% bonus damage as Lightning. Shred becomes a Storm Skill.

sigil of chaos.description: Create a destructive ritual for 10 seconds that grants you Volatility while within. Killing enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual's chaotic hellfire, increasing the chance for each enemy to explode for 30 damage on death.
sigil of chaos.name: Sigil of Chaos

runes.Blood Ritual: Sacrifice 4% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Chaos' kill costs, up to 48% total.
runes.Chain Reaction: Hitting an enemy with Sigil of Chaos has a 20% chance to trigger the effect on them again.
runes.Diabolic Rebuke: While you are within Sigil of Chaos, you and your Summons deal 120 damage to enemies when attacked.
runes.Hellfire Aura: Sigil of Chaos is now cast around yourself for 15 seconds and instantly explodes your Lesser Demons within for 24 damage. Cooldown is increased to 25 seconds.
runes.Sigil of Smoke: Sigil of Chaos becomes an Abyss Skill and kills within now send out 2 tendrils of abyssal smoke that deal 36 damage and pierce through Hexed enemies.
runes.Volatility Casts: Volatility empowered casts within Sigil of Chaos count as triggering 3 kills.
runes.Volatility Duration: Volatility from Sigil of Chaos now lasts for 10 seconds after you leave the area.

sigil of subversion.description: Create a subversive ritual for 10 seconds that Hexes enemies. Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to send forth shadow trails for value1 seconds that periodically grant you 1 stack of Shadowform every second while in them. You can have up to 3 trails active at once.
sigil of subversion.name: Sigil of Subversion

runes.Blood Ritual: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly trigger each of Sigil of Subversion's kill costs, up to 48% total.
runes.Cast Range: Sigil of Subversion can now be placed at long range.
runes.Infiltration Trails: Sigil of Subversion trails now last 50% longer and extend away when you near their ends. While within a trail your Shadowform loses no stacks while moving.
runes.Movement Speed: Sigil of Subversion trails grant you x20% increased Movement Speed while on them.
runes.Seekers: Sigil of Subversion trails teleport Non-Boss enemies back to the ritual area the first time they come in contact.
runes.Sigil of Lava: Sigil of Subversion becomes a Hellfire Skill and now creates lava trails that periodically deal 350 damage. Enemies that die within the trails have a 25% chance to be charred into Brimstones which deal 200 damage when they explode.
runes.Slow: Sigil of Subversion trails Slow enemies by 75%.

sigil of summons.description: Create a binding ritual for 10 seconds that extends the duration of your Summons. Killing 8 enemies or Demons within fuels the ritual to summon a demon for 20 seconds which attacks nearby enemies, dealing 60 damage per hit. You can have up to 3 demons active at once.
sigil of summons.name: Sigil of Summons

runes.Blood Ritual: Sacrifice 2% of your Maximum Life to instantly pay each of Sigil of Summons' kill costs, up to 48% total.
runes.Cooldown: Sigil of Summons' active Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds when your Greater Demons die.
runes.Damage: Enemies within Sigil of Summons take x25% increased damage from your Lesser Demon Skills.
runes.Feeding Frenzy: Sigil of Summons now summons up to 2 additional demons. When Sigil of Summons' demons kill enemies they all gain 3% increased Cast Speed, up to 30%.
runes.Stronger Summons: Sigil of Summons deals x25% increased damage but requires 25% more kills per summon.
runes.Summon Hellwyrm: Sigil of Summons now requires 16 kills to summon a Hellwyrm Greater Demon that mimics your Lesser Demon casts by regurgitating related Demons.
runes.Summon Succubus: Sigil of Summons becomes an Abyss Skill and now requires 12 kills to summon up to 2 dark Succubi which fire Abyssal Bloodstars, dealing 72 damage and causing enemies to take an additional 180 damage when they try to attack.

simple gifts.description: The Tree only offers one Whisper Cache choice that will always be a Material Collection or a Collection of Chaos.
simple gifts.name: Simple Gifts

skeleton mage.description: Raise a skeletal mage, up to a maximum of 3 mages. Skeletal mages deal 80 damage with each attack.
skeleton mage.name: Skeleton Mage

runes.Coven: Skeleton Mage's maximum number of mages is increased by 2.
runes.Critical Strike Chance: You gain an additional +5% Critical Strike Chance against enemies damaged by Skeleton Mages.
runes.Crowd Control Damage Bonus: Skeleton Mages deal x30% increased damage to Crowd Controlled enemies.
runes.Duration Damage Bonus: Skeleton Mages deal x15% increased damage. This bonus increases by 1% every second that the skeletal mage is alive, up to x25%.
runes.Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower: Skeleton Mages have a 5% chance to grant 1 stack of Ferocity, Resolve, or Overpower whenever they attack based on whether your Skeleton Mage type is Shadow, Cold, or Bone respectively.
runes.Gift of Death: Skeleton Mage is also a Corpse Skill and requires a Corpse to be raised. Each active skeletal mage increases your Essence Regeneration by x value1 .
runes.Singularity: Skeleton Mage will consume all of your remaining Essence on cast to raise a more powerful but temporary mage. The skeletal mage deals x3% increased damage and lasts for 0.1 seconds for each point of Essence consumed.

skeleton warrior.description: Passive: Raise a skeletal warrior from a nearby Corpse every 2 seconds, up to a maximum of 4 warriors. Skeletal warriors deal 65 with each attack. Active: Command your skeletal warriors to leap at an enemy and attack.
skeleton warrior.name: Skeleton Warrior

runes.Damage Bonus: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors causes them to deal x25% increased damage for 10 seconds.
runes.Healing: Skeletal Warriors heal you for 2% of your Maximum Life whenever they attack.
runes.Litany of Death: If all of your skeletal warriors have been Summoned, Skeleton Warrior briefly Summons a Skeleton Priest instead. Skeleton Priest empowers your Minions for 8 seconds, increasing their Critical Strike Chance by + value1 and healing them for 100% of their Maximum Life over the duration.
runes.Master of Puppets: Skeleton Warrior's maximum number of warriors is increased to 3.
runes.Resolve: Commanding your Skeleton Warriors grants 3 stacks of Ferocity.
runes.Service and Sacrifice: Skeleton Warriors lose 25% of their Maximum Life per second while in combat and explode on death, dealing 150 damage. Skeleton Warriors are now raised from a nearby Corpse every 0.5 seconds.
runes.Vulnerable: Skeleton Warriors have a 30% chance to make enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

skill cast.description: Cast when the player casts any skill in combat.
skill cast.name: Skill Cast

smoke grenade.description: Throw a smoky concoction at enemies that deals 90 damage and Dazes them for 4 seconds.
smoke grenade.name: Smoke Grenade

runes.Charge or Energy Cost Reduction: Smoke Grenade gains 1 Charge or costs 10 less Energy.
runes.Increased Duration and Damage: Smoke Grenade gains +30% increased Duration and deals x25% increased damage.
runes.Poison Grenade: Smoke Grenade now deals Poison damage and applies another 90 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds.
runes.Shade Grenade: Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes and deals 90 Shadow damage. When your Smoke Grenade detonates, it also creates a Shade that leaves behind 1 grenade, dealing 67 damage. Smoke Grenade is now also a Core Skill that no longer has a Cooldown and costs 40 Energy.
runes.Silhouette: Smoke Grenade no longer Dazes enemies and instead creates a cloud of shadows at your feet. While within the cloud, you gain + value1 Critical Strike Chance and Stealth once every 1 second.
runes.Size: Smoke Grenade's size is increased by 25%.
runes.Vulnerable: Enemies hit by Smoke Grenade become Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

snipe.description: Subo charges a massive piercing bolt, then unleashes it forwards for 450% Physical damage that Knocks Back enemies.
snipe.name: Snipe

soar.description: Fly into the air, creating a cloud which makes enemies at your target location Vulnerable for 4 seconds before you crash down upon them dealing 50 damage.
soar.name: Soar

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Soar's Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds.
runes.Eye of the Storm: Soar's cloud deals 100 Sparking damage each second and remains around you for 3 seconds after landing. Soar conjures 3 Spirit Storms around its impact area that Spark enemies for 150 damage.
runes.Free Bird: Soar makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.
runes.Jaguar's Execution: Soar becomes a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage. Soar lunges into the air and directly back down, dealing 100 damage twice. This ability can Execute enemies.
runes.Movement Speed: Soar gives you 10% Movement Speed increase for 3 seconds. If Soar hits no enemies, gain 25% instead.

soulrift.description: Consume surrounding enemies, dealing 300 Corrupting damage over 8 seconds. Every 0.25 seconds you absorb the souls of 3 enemies, gaining 2 Essence per enemy. You absorb 3 souls at a time from Bosses.
soulrift.name: Soulrift

runes.Barrier: Every soul absorbed by Soulrift grants a Barrier for 0.5% of your Maximum Life. This Barrier persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.
runes.Damage Bonus: Every soul absorbed by Soulrift increases its damage by x0.3%, up to x45%.
runes.Distilled Anima: While Soulrift is active you are Unhindered and gain +1% increased Movement Speed for every soul absorbed, up to +40%. This bonus persists for 5 seconds after Soulrift ends.
runes.Ferocity: Every 30 souls absorbed by Soulrift grants 1 stack of Ferocity.
runes.Frozen Wasteland: Soulrift deals Frostbite damage and Chills for 30% every second. If Soulrift absorbs the soul of a Frozen enemy, they shatter and explode for 75 damage.
runes.Soul Vortex: Soulrift is cast at the target location. Absorbing an enemy's soul deals 25 damage and Pulls them in.
runes.Vulnerable and Crowd Control: When Soulrift absorbs an enemy's soul it makes them Vulnerable for 4 seconds. After Soulrift ends, all surrounding enemies are Feared and Slowed by 85% for 5 seconds.

spark.description: Launch a bolt of lightning that shocks an enemy 3 times, dealing 25 damage with each shock.
spark.name: Spark

runes.Crackling Energy: Spark forms a Crackling Energy each time it damages a new target.
runes.Electric Blast: Spark combines all shocks into one blast in an area, dealing x50% increased damage and gaining 25% increased Size per shock.
runes.Firework: Spark becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals Fire damage. Spark shocks now explode, dealing 45 damage that gain x25% increased Critical Strike Damage.
runes.Overcharged: Spark shocks 4 additional times. Each time a shock does not Critically Strike it gains +10% Critical Strike Chance.

spawn fragment.description: Ae'grom now passively spawns a Vile Child Lesser Demon every 0.5 second and deals x90% increased damage. Command Ae'grom no longer spews Vile Children and instead causes all of your Lesser Demons to explode, dealing 150% damage.
spawn fragment.name: Spawn Fragment

spear of the heavens.description: Rain down 4 heavenly spears from the sky, dealing 160 damage and Knocking Down enemies for 1.5 seconds. After 1.5 seconds, the spears burst, dealing 120 damage.
spear of the heavens.name: Spear of the Heavens

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Consuming Judgement reduces Spear of the Heavens active cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Fist of the Heavens: Spear of the Heavens becomes a Core Skill and is now pure Holy energy that crashes down from the sky. On impact it deals 386 damage and breaks into 5 projectiles, dealing 386 additional damage to enemies in their path.
runes.Judgement Damage Bonus: Spear of the Heavens deals x40% increased damage against enemies affected by Judgement.
runes.Part the Heavens: Spear of the Heavens now drops 8 spears along the path toward your target.
runes.Projectiles: Spear of the Heavens releases 3 additional projectiles after its 1st impact.
runes.Pronouncement of Heaven: Spear of the Heavens gains 3 initial spears that deal 120 damage per second for 12 seconds. These spears can be marked with Judgement.
runes.Vulnerable: Spear of the Heavens applies Vulnerable to enemies for 4 seconds.

steel grasp.description: Thow out a trio of chains that deal 100 damage and Pull In enemies.
steel grasp.name: Steel Grasp

runes.Berserking: Steel Grasp grants Berserking for 2 seconds on Hit.
runes.Chain Whip: Steel Grasp is also a Brawling Skill that launches 2 additional chains for 65 damage.
runes.Devil's Chain: Steel Grasp gains 2 additional Charges and forms 3 Dust Devils dealing 25 damage.
runes.Solo Chain: Steel Grasp becomes a Basic Skill that has no Cooldown, generates up to 15 Fury based on Charges, but only throws a single chain.
runes.Vulnerable: Steel Grasp makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Steel Grasp Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.

stinger.description: Strike a small area, dealing 115 damage to enemies within as well as all surrounding Poisoned enemies.
stinger.name: Stinger

runes.Damage Bonus: Stinger's initial impact deals 30% increased damage.
runes.Healing and Vulnerable: If Stinger strikes a Vulnerable enemy it Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life. If you are Healthy it makes enemies Vulnerable for 3 seconds.
runes.Nimbostratal Strike: Stinger becomes an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage. Stinger strikes a small area, dealing 150 damage and creating a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 150 damage. Your other Spirit Storms also deal 150 damage.
runes.Potent Sting: Stinger now always deals its damage to surrounding enemies, even if they are not Poisoned. If they were Poisoned, it deals x50% increased damage.
runes.Unleash the Swarm: Stinger spawns 3 Pestilent Swarms that deal 100 damage.
runes.Weakened Damage Bonus: Stinger deals 25% more damage to Weakened enemies.

stone burst.description: Gather stones beneath your enemies then detonate them dealing 130 damage. Channeling deals 20% damage and increases the size of the affected area, up to a 200% radius increase over 1 seconds.
stone burst.name: Stone Burst

runes.Armor: Gain 30% Armor while Stone Burst is channeling.
runes.Epicenter: Stone Burst Slows enemies within the area by 80%. Additionally, each time Stone Burst grows larger, it marks the enemies in the area for 40% bonus damage from Stone Burst's final explosion, this bonus can stack on enemies and all stacks are consumed at final explosion.
runes.Fortify: When Stone Burst reaches its maximum size, gain Fortify for 35% of your Maximum Life.
runes.Growth Speed: Increase Stone Burst's growth speed by 30%.
runes.Living Stones: Stone Burst is cast at the targeted location and grows by itself, detonating after 3 seconds. Only 1 Stone Burst may be active at a time.
runes.Rumbling Stones: Stone Burst can be channeled infinitely. After reaching the maximum size, continually channeling Stone Burst will periodically detonate, dealing the final explosion damage and consuming 10 Spirit.
runes.Spirit Cost Reduction: Reduce the Spirit cost for casting Stone Burst by 6.

storm of fire.description: Aldkin rains a Fire Storm down from the sky that deals 300% Fire damage on impact and remains on the ground for 10 seconds. Every second, the Fire Storm Burns enemies within for 55% damage over 3 seconds. Enemies hit by Fire Storm's impact or aftershocks have a 30% chance to be Stunned for 1 second.
storm of fire.name: Storm of Fire

storm strike.description: Electricity gathers around your weapon, dealing 60 damage to your target and chaining up to 2 times to targets nearby.
storm strike.name: Storm Strike

runes.Additional Chain: Storm Strike may chain 1 additional time.
runes.Armor: You gain 15% Armor for 4 seconds when dealing damage.
runes.Chain Reaction: Storm Strike chains 3 additional times. Storm Strike's chain damage increases by 20% each time it chains.
runes.Ferocity: Storm Strike grants 1 stack of Ferocity when first dealing damage.
runes.Focused Strike: Storm Strike chaining will always prioritize the same target until that target dies. Chaining to the same target deals x150% increased damage.
runes.Spirit: Storm Strike grants 25 Spirit when a single enemy is hit at least 3 times per cast.
runes.Storm Hammer: Storm Strike deals 96 Lightning damage and can be cast from range becoming a swift projectile. Additionally, Storm Strike Immobilizes enemies for 3 seconds. May occur once every 8 seconds per enemy.

subjugation fragment.description: Summoning a non-Soul Shard, Abyss Greater Demon consumes all Dominance, increasing its damage by x1.75% per Dominance consumed. Maintaining Shadowform grants you 2 Dominance every 1 second.
subjugation fragment.name: Subjugation Fragment

summon abodian.description: Passive: Abodian bites and claws, dealing 395 damage. Active: Command Abodian to enter Demonform for 6 seconds and mount Abodian, gaining x60% increased Movement Speed for 4 seconds. While mounted, chain enemies and Pull them behind you, dealing 64 damage every 0.5 seconds. After you dismount, Abodian slams the ground, dealing 638 damage. Cast again while active to cancel.
summon abodian.name: Summon Abodian

summon ae grom.description: Passive: Ae'grom cleaves with its arms, dealing 191 damage. Active: Command Ae'grom to spew 5 Vile Child Lesser Demons, dealing 166 damage when they land. Vile Children claw enemies, dealing 38 , and last for 10 seconds.
summon ae grom.name: Summon Ae'grom

summon laalish.description: Passive: Laalish seeks enemies and applies Vulnerable and a 30% Slow to Close enemies that lingers for 4 seconds. When you attack enemies, it moves through the abyss to bite them, dealing 765 damage. Active: Command Laalish to create a Terror Realm for 6 seconds, applying Vulnerable and a 60% Slow to enemies within. Laalish devours enemies within Terror Realm, dealing 255 damage every 1 second. While you are within Terror Realm, gain 1 stacks of Shadowform every 0.25 seconds.
summon laalish.name: Summon Laalish

summon vollach.description: Passive: Valloch increases your Maximum Overpower by 2 and Maximum Wrath by 40. Active: Command Valloch to siphon its power to overfill your Overpower by 1 and increase Wrath Regeneration by + 255 for 10 seconds.
summon vollach.name: Summon Vollach

sundering shield.description: Raheir's final Crater burst inflicts Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.
sundering shield.name: Sundering Shield

tainted shrines.description: While empowered by a Shrine in Helltide, slain enemies grant double the progress to your Threat Level.
tainted shrines.name: Tainted Shrines

taste of flesh.description: When you or Varyana deal direct damage to an enemy inflicted with any of her Bleeding effects, you Heal for 1% of your Maximum Life.
taste of flesh.name: Taste of Flesh

teleport.description: Transform into lightning and surge to the target location, dealing 35 damage around you upon arrival.
teleport.name: Teleport

runes.Blaze: Teleport becomes a Pyromancy Skill that deals 60 Fire damage. Teleport now only dashes you forward a short distance and will consume 1 stack of Overpower to refund its Cooldown.
runes.Crackling Energy: Teleport forms 2 Crackling Energy at the ending location.
runes.Electrobolt: Teleport pulls in all Close Crackling Energy and reduces the Cooldown of the next Teleport by value1 seconds per Crackling Energy gained this way.
runes.Ferocity: Teleport grants 2 stack of Ferocity if it hits an enemy.
runes.Movement Speed: Teleport increases your Movement Speed by +10% for 4 seconds.
runes.Weaken: Teleport Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.
runes.Wormhole: Teleport Stuns enemies hit for 0.50 seconds, and there is a 2 second window where you can cast Teleport again.

terrify.description: Hits of Aldkin's Haunt have a 30% chance to inflict Vulnerable on enemies for 4 seconds.
terrify.name: Terrify

terror swarm.description: Summon a terror from the depths that deals 500 damage and spews a voracious swarm that deals 100 damage per bite for 15 seconds.
terror swarm.name: Terror Swarm

runes.Devouring Swarm: Terror Swarm starts smaller and weaker but grows up to 3 times as it feeds on enemies. Upon reaching maximum size, swarms split off another smaller swarm. Can have up to 3 active swarms.
runes.Extra Bites: Terror Swarm now bites up to 2 additional times per second.
runes.Lesser Demons: Terror Swarm spawns and instantly kills 3 Lesser Demons every second.
runes.Nightmare: Terror Swarm is now additionally a Recast Skill and stays in place, dealing 200 damage per hit. Recast while active to command the swarm to move to your target.
runes.Pull: Terror Swarm periodically Pulls enemies into the center of the swarm.
runes.Searing Infestation: Terror Swarm becomes a Hellfire Skill and stays around you, dealing 170 damage per hit.
runes.Vulnerable: Terror Swarm makes enemies Vulnerable and causes them to take 20% increased damage from your Archfiend Skills.

the black pact.description: An ominous altar appears between waves in the Infernal Hordes. It can be invoked only once, and provides an Infernal Offering that shares a category with your previous choice.
the black pact.name: The Black Pact

the devourer.description: The Centipede Spirit emerges, blasting enemies in a line for 200 damage and spitting at others for 95 damage. Lasts for 15 seconds.
the devourer.name: The Devourer

runes.Blast of Bile: The Devourer now only blasts enemies in a line once, dealing 800 damage, before leaving. The Devourer is now also a Potency Skill and has a 18 second cooldown.
runes.Healing: The Devourer Heals you for 5% of your Maximum Life per second.
runes.Instant Kill: While The Devourer is active, if a Non-Boss enemy's remaining Life becomes Poisoned, they die instantly.
runes.Poisoning Duration: While The Devourer is active, your Poisoning effects have 20% increased duration.
runes.Sky and Soil: The Devourer is also an Eagle Skill. The Eagle Spirit aids The Devourer, creating a Lightning Storm that Sparks enemies for 80 damage each second and makes enemies Vulnerable. Gain value1 Movement Speed while The Devourer is active.
runes.Spew Putrefaction: As it emerges, The Devourer launches 10 toxic globs that apply 35 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds wherever they land. Enemies affected by toxic globs also take x50% increased Poison Damage.
runes.Thorns: The Devourer grants you 50% increased Thorns for 15 seconds.

the hunter.description: Bound across the battlefield with the Jaguar Spirit, dealing 50 damage upon landing and the rapidily slashing enemies in the area for 200 total damage over 7 strikes.
the hunter.name: The Hunter

runes.Execute: The Hunter's landing damage will Execute enemies.
runes.Healing: The Hunter restores 3% of your Maximum Health per strike.
runes.Push and Pounce: The Hunter is also a Gorilla Skill. The Gorilla Spirit knocks enemies towards The Hunter's landing spot, dealing 150 Physical damage and Knocking Down enemies on landing for 2 seconds. Each enemy you damage with The Hunter grants Resolve, which can overfill your Resolve by 4 stacks.
runes.Relentless Pursuit: The Hunter overfills your Ferocity by 2 stacks. Killing enemies while with it active has a 40% chance to instantly reset its Cooldown. This chance is halved after each consecutive reset.
runes.Shredder: The Hunter strikes an additional 5 times and consumes all of your Ferocity to deal x20% increased damage per Ferocity.
runes.Size Bonus: The Hunter strikes a 50% larger area.

the protector.description: The Gorilla Spirit protects an area for 6 seconds, continuously smashing surrounding enemies for 140 damage and granting you Barrier for 10% of your Maximum Life every 1.5 seconds.
the protector.name: The Protector

runes.Barrier: The Protector grants an additional 10% of your Maximum Life in Barrier.
runes.Brutal Barrage: The Protector also deals 175 damage to enemies around you with each smash. Spend up to 3 stacks of Resolve to increase The Protector's damage by 100% for each stack spent.
runes.Canopy Shelter: The Protector's area persists for an additional 6 seconds and Slows enemies and Small Missiles by 80%. While inside, you are Unstoppable.
runes.Resolve Generation: The Protector grants 2 Resolve when it smashes.
runes.The Infected Forest: The Protector is also a Centipede Skill. The Centipede Spirit aids The Protector, poisoning enemies for 100 damage each second, Weakening them, and spawning Pestilent Swarms that deal 100 damage.
runes.Thorns Damage: The Protector's area deals x350% of your Thorns damage to enemies within every 1.5 seconds.

the seeker.description: The Eagle Spirit swoops down and deals 52 damage. After a short delay it blasts off dealing 450 damage.
the seeker.name: The Seeker

runes.Charge Refund: Elites hit twice by The Seeker have a 25% chance to refund a Charge, doubled against Bosses.
runes.Lone Seeker: The Seeker now only has 1 Charge, its area is increased by 50%, and it deals 250% increased damage.
runes.Storm Feathers: The Seeker drops 5 Storm Feathers when it swoops down.
runes.Stormbringer: The Seeker's first hit Knocks Down enemies for 4 seconds and leaves behind a Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 240 damage.
runes.Tag Team: The Seeker is also a Jaguar Skill. The Jaguar Spirit aids The Seeker, granting you 4 Ferocity and slashing 3 times dealing 75 Fire Damage. The Seeker gains 2 additional Charges.
runes.Vulnerable: The Seeker constantly makes all enemies in its area Vulnerable.

thrash.description: Dive at an enemy and slash into it dealing 40 damage. Your 3rd attack unleashes a rapid series of slashes around your target, dealing a total of 70 damage.
thrash.name: Thrash

runes.Cooldown Reduction: Each hit of Thrash has a 10% chance to reduce an active Cooldown by 1.5 seconds.
runes.Crashing and Thrashing: Thrash's 3rd attack deals x50% increased damage. Thrash continues to unleash its 3rd attack if Cast again within 2.5 seconds.
runes.Ferocity: Thrash's 3rd attack grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.
runes.Ramping Damage: Each hit of Thrash increases the damage that enemy takes from Thrash by x2%, stacking up to x30%.
runes.Storm Conjurer: Thrash becomes an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage. Thrash's 3rd attack deals 100 damage and creates a moving Spirit Storm that Sparks enemies for 150 damage.
runes.Vigor Generation: Killing an enemy empowers your next Thrash to generate 10 additional Vigor. This stacks up to the next 10 Casts of Thrash.
runes.Wanton Rampage: Thrash's 1st and 2nd attacks have a 30% chance to also unleash its 3rd attack that is 100% larger and deals x2% increased damage.

thrillseeker.description: Your active Cooldowns are reduced by 0.5 seconds when an Explosive Charge explodes. Explosive Charges now detonate after only 1.5 seconds.
thrillseeker.name: Thrillseeker

thunderspike.description: Quickly jab forward with a piercing strike dealing 45 damage. Your 3rd attack pierces further, dealing 65 damage.
thunderspike.name: Thunderspike

runes.Critical Strike Chance: After you Critically Strike 15 times, Thunderspike's next use will be its 3rd attack and always Critically Strike.
runes.Damage to Sparking: Thunderspike deals 50% increased damage to Sparking enemies.
runes.Infected Ground: Thunderspike becomes a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage. Thunderspike leaves a trail of poison that deals 40 damage over 6 seconds.
runes.Lightning Dancer: When you Evade, you attack with Thunderspike along the way for 100% of normal damage.
runes.Lightning's Grip: Thunderspike's 3rd attack strikes back again for 65 damage, Pulling in and applying Vulnerable to enemies.
runes.Movement Speed: Thunderspike's increases your Movement Speed by x15% for 5 seconds.
runes.Vigor Generation: Thunderspike generates 7 additional Vigor if you have moved in the last 2 seconds.

tornado.description: Conjure a swirling tornado for 4 seconds that deals 35 damage to enemies.
tornado.name: Tornado

runes.Additional Tornado: Each time you cast Tornado, there is a 20% chance to spawn an additional Tornado.
runes.Cast Speed: Tornado's Cast Speed is increased by x20%.
runes.Explosive Tornado: After colliding with the target, Tornado explodes into 4 Mini-Tornadoes that seek enemies dealing 14 damage. Mini-Tornadoes have half the normal duration.
runes.Greater Tornado: Two Tornadoes can merge into a Greater Tornado. Greater Tornadoes are 50% larger and deal +100% bonus damage.
runes.Increased Duration: Extend the duration of Tornado by 1 second. Additionally, hitting a Vulnerable enemy extends the duration further by 0.5 seconds, up to a maximum of 2 seconds.
runes.Slow: Tornado Slows enemies hit by 70% for 2 seconds.
runes.Swelling Storm: Tornadoes gain a stacking x35% damage bonus each second while active. After 3 seconds, Tornadoes gain a 50% Critical Strike Chance.

tortured wretch.description: Summon a tortured demon on your enemies, dealing 60 damage and Taunting them to attack it for 5 seconds.
tortured wretch.name: Tortured Wretch

runes.Cost Reduction: Tortured Wretch cost is reduced by 30%.
runes.Death Saws: Saws grind up enemies around the Tortured Wretch, periodically dealing 20 damage with a 5% chance to Eviscerate enemies for 600 damage.
runes.Domination: Tortured Wretch becomes an Abyss Occult Skill and now directly dominates a target's mind for up to 15 seconds, forcing it to Taunt your enemies and take 50 damage when hit by them. Recast to command the target around the battlefield.
runes.Duration: Enemies and Demons killed Close to the Tortured Wretch extend its duration by 0.5 seconds, up to 5 seconds.
runes.Enrage: When enemies attack the Tortured Wretch they are enraged for 2 seconds, gaining +100% increased Attack Speed but taking 25 damage when they hit targets.
runes.Punching Bag: Tortured Wretch no longer Taunts but now lasts for 12 seconds and you redirect all damage to it so long as you stay in the area. It can absorb up to 30% of your Maximum Life before it is killed. When the demon dies it explodes, dealing up to 500 damage and Fortifying you for up to 25% based on the damage it absorbed.
runes.Unstoppable: Casting Tortured Wretch makes you Unstoppable for 3 seconds.

total chaos.description: Chaos Waves appear more frequently. However, one less Infernal Offering appears each wave.
total chaos.name: Total Chaos

touch of death.description: Strike an enemy and infect them, dealing 5 damage and applying 300 Poisoning damage over 9 seconds. When the infection expires or the host dies, a swarm hatches and seeks enemies for 9 seconds, dealing 10 damage per hit. You can have up to 3 swarms active at once.
touch of death.name: Touch of Death

runes.Additional Charge: Touch of Death gains an additional charge.
runes.Erupting Swarm: Touch of Death's swarm bursts every second, applying 90 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds to surrounding enemies.
runes.Healing: Touch of Death's infection Heals you for 1% of your Maximum Life per second for a total of 9% Maximum Life. You Heal any remaining when the swarm hatches.
runes.Swarm of Swarms: Touch of Death is also a Core Skill which costs 70 Vigor and has no Cooldown. When a swarm is replaced early, it bursts for 150% of the damage it would have done.
runes.Touch of Lightning: Touch of Death becomes an Eagle Skill that deals Lightning damage. Touch of Death strikes an enemy, dealing 150 damage and conjuring a Spirit Storm which Sparks enemies for 375 damage. If the enemy dies before the Spirit Storm dissipates, conjure a second moving Spirit Storm. When you conjure a Spirit Storm, reduce Touch of Death's Cooldown by 1 second.
runes.Vulnerable: Touch of Death makes enemies Vulnerable.
runes.Weakened Damage: If Touch of Death's strike hits a Weakened enemy, Touch of Death deals x20% increased damage.

toxic skin.description: Passive: Enemies that attack you are Poisoned for 72 damage over 6 seconds. Active: Your toxins overflow, applying the Poisoning in a trail and making you Unhindered for 5 seconds.
toxic skin.name: Toxic Skin

runes.Duration Increase: Toxic Skin's duration is increased by 2 seconds
runes.Erupting Skin: While Toxic Skin is active, you launch toxic globs that apply 250 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds
runes.Fiery Soul: Toxic Skin becomes a Jaguar Skill that deals Fire damage. Passive: Whenever you receive Healing, gain +25% Critical Strike Damage until your next Critical Strike, up to +200%. Active: Jaguar energy flows through you, automatically slashing Close enemies for 60 damage every 0.5 seconds for 5 seconds.
runes.Healing: While Toxic Skin is active, Heal for 3% of your Maximum Life per second.
runes.Skuttle Bug: Toxic Skin's Cooldown is reduced by 3 seconds and its damage Weakens enemies. While its active, you gain value1 Armor.
runes.Thorns: Toxic Skin passively increases your Thorns by x20%.
runes.Vigor Generation: Toxic Skin generates 5 Vigor per second while active.

trample.description: Shapeshift and charge forward, dealing 75 damage and Knocking Back enemies.
trample.name: Trample

runes.Brunt Force: Trample deals 500% bonus damage to the first target. Each subsequent target hit reduces this bonus by 50%.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Reduce Trample's cooldown by 6 seconds.
runes.Exsanguination: Trampling may Execute enemies in an explosion of blood dealing 150 damage to other nearby enemies and healing you for 10% of your Maximum Life.
runes.Stun: Trample Stuns enemies for 3 seconds instead of Knocking Back.
runes.Trampled Earth: Trample sunders the earth forming rock pillars along the 120 damage. Trample is now an Earth Skill.
runes.Unstoppable: Trample makes you Unstoppable for the duration.

tree of plenty.description: The Tree offers a fourth Whisper Cache choice.
tree of plenty.name: Tree of Plenty

trials and tributes.description: For each Portal Prankster you slay within the Undercity, a Tribute Chest appears after killing the District Boss. Tribute Chests are unlocked by offering a Tribute.
trials and tributes.name: Trials and Tributes

trip mines.description: Subo scatters 3 explosive traps that each arm after 1 second. When an enemy moves within range of one, it explodes for 300% Physical damage and Knocks Down enemies for 1.5 seconds.
trip mines.name: Trip Mines

twisted fragment.description: Occult Hellfire Skills consume 1 stack of Hex on targets hit to increase its damage against the target by x25%. Occult Abyss Skills can be empowered by Volatility to cause explosions when hitting an enemy for the first time, dealing 50% damage, increased by that Skill's Rank. Every 50 Wrath spent grants 1 Overpower.
twisted fragment.name: Twisted Fragment

twisting blades.description: Impale an enemy with your blades, dealing 42 damage. After 1.5 seconds the blades return to you, piercing enemies for 98 damage.
twisting blades.name: Twisting Blades

runes.Bladedancer: Twisting Blades now cleaves and spirals outward around you for a short time after they return, dealing 39 damage per hit.
runes.Crowd Controlled or Weakened: Twisting Blades deals x20% increased damage to Crowd Controlled or Weakened enemies.
runes.Damage Increase and Execute: Twisting Blades' initial impale Executes enemies. Twisting Blades' return damage is also increased by x20%.
runes.Energy Cost Reduction: Twisting Blades' Energy Cost is reduced to 24.
runes.Resolve: When you impale an enemy with Twisting Blades, gain 1 stack of Resolve.
runes.Sleight of Hand: Enemies impaled by Twisting Blades are Dazed. When your Twisting Blades return, your active Cooldowns are reduced by value1 seconds per enemy they passed through, up to 2 seconds. Twisting Blades damage is increased by x75%.
runes.Twisted Twin: Impaling an enemy with Twisting Blades also summons 1 Shade to strike a nearby target, dealing 31 damage on impale and 73 damage on returning.

two by two.description: After opening a Hoard Chest, there is a low chance a Portal will open that will take you to the Nemesis Lair, where you will fight two Initiate Lair Bosses at the same time. Slaying both will yield great rewards.
two by two.name: Two by Two

tyrant s grasp.description: Summon a demon hand that Pulls enemies away from you, dealing 100 damage.
tyrant s grasp.name: Tyrant's Grasp

runes.Abyssal Pit: Tyrant's Grasp becomes an Abyss Recast Summon Skill and summons an Abyssal Pit for 10 seconds that consumes Non-Elite enemies, dealing 350 damage, Knocking them down, and hiding them in Stealth. Recast to Pull additional targets into the Pit. Tyrant's Grasp now costs 20 dominance.
runes.Demonic Grasp: Tyrant's Grasp is now a direct grasp attack that transforms you into Demonform and Pulls enemies inward.
runes.Grasp Area: Tyrant's Grasp's area is increased by 100% and Pulls in Brimstone.
runes.Inescapable Grapple: Tyrant's Grasp repeatedly reaches for you and Pulls away enemies for 5 seconds.
runes.Knock Down: Tyrant's Grasp Knocks Down enemies for 3 seconds.
runes.Lesser Demon Slow: Casting Tyrant's Grasp commands your Lesser Demon Skills to Slow enemies by 60% for 5 seconds.
runes.Unstoppable Damage: Tyrant's Grasp deals x100% increased damage against Unstoppable enemies.

ultimate nemesis.description: After defeating all Bosses within the Greater Nemesis Lair, the Call Of Evil will appear. This altar will accept 5 Betrayer's Husk and open a Portal that takes you to the Ultimate Nemesis Lair. Inside the Ultimate Nemesis Lair, all enemies gain +5 Monster Power. Defeating the Boss Encounter will award you with 10 Hoard Chests worth of Items.
ultimate nemesis.name: Ultimate Nemesis

umbral chains.description: Send forth a shadowy chain, dealing 80 damage along the way and linking up to 2 enemies for 5 seconds. Enemies caught in the chain are Slowed by 30% and take 25 damage per second.
umbral chains.name: Umbral Chains

runes.Capture Damage: Umbral Chains deals x20% increased damage when an unchained enemy is first caught by the chain. Hexed enemies always take increased damage.
runes.Chain Burst: Umbral Chains explodes for 94 damage when stretched to its maximum or when it expires. If this happens early then any damage the chain would have done is added.
runes.Chain Whips: Umbral Chains becomes a Hellfire Skill and whips around your target, dealing 44 damage per second to surrounding enemies and striking a 25% larger area when empowered by Volatility.
runes.Epicenter: Umbral Chains now always creates a chain link back to you. Additionally, whenever you summon a Greater Demon a chain is created between you for up to 30 seconds.
runes.Heavy Harpoon: Umbral Chains Knocks Back your primary target and deals x50% increased damage to them.
runes.Long Range Slow: Umbral Chains flies 50% farther and its Slow is increased to 60%.
runes.Wrath Refund: When Umbral Chains ends it refunds 1 Wrath for every enemy hit over its duration.

undying embers.description: You lose no Aberrant Cinders on death.
undying embers.name: Undying Embers

unfathomable fragment.description: Laalish also Weakens enemies. Laalish deals x100% increased damage and Executes enemies. When Laalish kills an enemy or when an enemy is Executed, the Cooldown of Command Laalish is reduced by 0.2 seconds.
unfathomable fragment.name: Unfathomable Fragment

unfortunate souls.description: Invasion Portals can now summon Wisps that attach to you and vanish if you die. Each Wisp you save will reward you with Forgotten Souls and other Crafting Materials at the end of the run.
unfortunate souls.name: Unfortunate Souls

unstable currents.description: Lightning surges within you for value1 seconds. Whenever you Cast, trigger a random Skill:
unstable currents.name: Unstable Currents

runes.Boundless:
While Unstable Currents is active, gain the following bonuses:
- Lucky Hit: Up to a value4 chance to form a Crackling Energy
- Increases Crackling Energy damage by x value5 and reduces Unstable Currents' Cooldown by value6 seconds when absorbing Crackling Energy when you are not at Maximum stacks.
- Automatically absorb Nearby Crackling Energy.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Unstable Currents' Cooldown is reduced to 100 seconds.
runes.Cost Reduction: Unstable Currents reduces your Mana costs by 5.
runes.Damage Bonus: Unstable Currents increases your Shock Skill damage by x20%.
runes.Ferocity: Unstable Currents increases your Minimum and Maximum Ferocity by 2.
runes.Ramping Currents: Unstable Currents now has a value2 chance to trigger twice.
runes.Thunder God: Unstable Currents now triggers equipped Shock Skills that deal x value3 increased damage, but the same Skill cannot be triggered more than once every 1 second.

upheaval.description: Tear into the ground with your weapon and fling debris forward, dealing 200 damage.
upheaval.name: Upheaval

runes.Damage Increase: Upheaval deals x30% increased damage to the first 5 enemies hit.
runes.Free Cast: Every 100 Fury spent makes your next Upheaval free to cast. This stacks up to 300 total Fury.
runes.Fury Cost Reduction: Upheaval's Fury cost is reduced to 28 Fury.
runes.Iron Burst: Upheaval flings Iron Shrapnel dealing 38 damage, and inflicting 150 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
runes.Overpower: Upheaval consumes 1 Overpower stack to increase Upheaval's Size by +20% and damage by x20%.
runes.Suppress: Upheaval deals x75% increased damage. Depending on the cast range, this area increases but the damage bonus decreases.
runes.Trailblazing: Upheaval ignites the ground Burning enemies for an additional 150 damage over 4 seconds. Upheaval now deals Fire damage.

valiance.description: When you would be damaged for at least 15% of your current Life at once, Raheir comes to your aid to negate the damage, Knock Down Close enemies for 2 seconds, and grant you Unstoppable for 0.5 seconds.
valiance.name: Valiance

vanguard shard.description: While in Demonform, Casting Archfiend Skills additionally Summons the Archfiend Demon: Rampage summons a brute for 10 seconds that follows you and swipes at enemies, dealing 13% damage. Infernal Breath summons a demonic head for 10 seconds that orbits you and spews flames, dealing 8% damage. Tyrant's Grasp summons 2 additional demon hands that each deal 100% damage. Profane Sentinel summons an additional eye for 10 seconds that follows you and blasts enemies, dealing 36% damage.
vanguard shard.name: Vanguard Shard

varshan s vengeance.description: Varshan and his minions can now appear in a Chaos Wave within the Infernal Hordes. After killing Varshan in the Infernal Hordes, the Spoils of Greater Equipment may drop Unique Items available from his Hoard Chest.
varshan s vengeance.name: Varshan's Vengeance

vortex.description: Creates a cyclone that Pulls enemies inward followed by a crushing downdraft that deals 35 damage to them.
vortex.name: Vortex

runes.1000 Year Storm: Vortex deals x200% increased damage, affects a 50% larger area, and grants 20% Damage Reduction for 5 seconds, but its Cooldown is increased by 5 seconds.
runes.Cooldown Reduction: Critical Strikes with Vortex reduce its Cooldown by 0.5 seconds.
runes.Insect Swarm: Vortex becomes a Centipede Skill that deals Poison damage. Vortex creates a wave of insects that swarm around you, dealing 20 damage and Slowing enemies by 90% for 5 seconds. They create a Poison nova, damaging enemies for 175 damage over 5 seconds.
runes.Knock Down: Vortex Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds.
runes.Overcharged: Vortex makes enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds and Sparks enemies for 200 damage over 2 seconds.

waking spoils.description: After completing a Nightmare Dungeon, a War's Bounty Chest will spawn that grants additional rewards.
waking spoils.name: Waking Spoils

wall of agony.description: Summon and fuse 5 frenzied demons into a line for 8 seconds. The demons block enemies and flail wildly, dealing 30 damage per hit to those in front of them.
wall of agony.name: Wall of Agony

runes.Cost Reduction: Wall of Agony's cost is reduced by 50% but increased by 10% for every Demon you have active.
runes.Damage: Wall of Agony deals x2% increased damage for every point of Max Dominance you have.
runes.Encircle: Wall of Agony is summoned in an encircling formation that Knocks enemies Back. Each active Wall of Agony demon grants you 6% Damage Reduction, up to 30%. Wall of Agony now has a 20 second Cooldown but costs no Dominance.
runes.Fallen Army: When Wall of Agony expires, demon brutes remain for 8 seconds and attack Nearby enemies. If Wall of Agony is killed early then the demon brutes gain its remaining duration.
runes.Knock Down: Each hit from Wall of Agony has a 20% chance to Knock Down enemies for 2 seconds.
runes.Small Walls: Wall of Agony now only spawns 3 demons but its cost is reduced by 50%.
runes.Waller: Wall of Agony summons 10 demons in a cage formation that Pulls enemies inward.

war cry.description: Bellow a mighty war cry, increasing your damage dealt by x value1 for 4 seconds. Nearby allies gain half of War Cry's effects.
war cry.name: War Cry

runes.Duration Increase: War Cry's duration is increased to 6 seconds.
runes.Ferocity: War Cry grants 2 stacks of Ferocity.
runes.Korlic: War Cry Summonbs Korlic who leaps at enemies, dealing 110 damage.
runes.Mighty Roar: War Cry's damage bonus is increased by 10% and allies now receive its full effect. You also gain Berserking for 4 seconds.
runes.Slow: War Cry Slows nearby enemies by 20% for 4 seconds.
runes.The Scream: War Cry terrifies your enemies, causing them to cower in Fear. You gain x value2 increased damage for each enemy Feared, up to x value3 .
runes.Vulnerable: War Cry makes nearby enemies Vulnerable for 4 seconds.

warden fragment.description: Demonform increases the damage of Hellfire Demonology Skills by x30% and gains 0.4 Dominance per second per Close Hellfire Demonology Summon to extend their durations.
warden fragment.name: Warden Fragment

wave of flame.description: Aldkin conjures a mass of flames forward, repeatedly dealing 550% Fire damage, Knocking Back enemies, and destroying small missiles.
wave of flame.name: Wave of Flame

whirlwind.description: Rapidly attack surrounding enemies for 71 damage.
whirlwind.name: Whirlwind

runes.Bursting: Whirlwind also explodes, dealing 18 Fire damage and inflicting 50 Burning damage over 5 seconds. Whirlwind now deals Fire damage.
runes.Channel Damage Bonus: Channeling Whirlwind causes it to deal x1% increased damage each time it hits an enemy, stacking up to 25 times.
runes.Cost Damage Bonus: Whirlwind deals x40% increased damage and costs 10 additional Fury.
runes.Movement Speed: Gain x12% increased Movement Speed during Whirlwind.
runes.Tornado: Whirlwind also creates 2 Dust Devils that each deal 62 damage.
runes.Weaken: Critical Strikes from Whirlwind Weaken enemies for 4 seconds.
runes.Winding: Attacking with another Skill grants 4 stacks of charge up to 20 that decays over time. Your Whirlwind deals x1% increased damage and gains x1% Movement Speed per stack. While Whilrwind has charges it launches Iron Shrapnel at Nearby enemies, each dealing 17 damage and inflicting 14 Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.

whirlwind v2.description: Varyana spins violently in a line, repeatedly dealing 85% Physical damage and 30% Bleeding damage over 5 seconds.
whirlwind v2.name: Whirlwind-v2

wind shear.description: Conjure a piercing blade of wind, dealing 60 damage to enemies hit.
wind shear.name: Wind Shear

runes.Barrier: Wind Shear grants a Barrier for 2% of your Maximum Life for each enemy hit up to a maximum of 60%.
runes.Boomerang: Wind Shear returns to you and deals 150% bonus damage to enemies already hit by this Wind Shear.
runes.Cast Speed: Increase Wind Shear's Cast Speed by 20%.
runes.Solar Wind: Wind Shear automatically seeks enemies and spawns a Dancing Bolt when it hits an enemy dealing 39 . Wind Shear may only hit 4 targets and may hit the same target.
runes.Spirit: Wind Shear restores 1 Spirit each time it hits an enemy.
runes.Vulnerable: Enemies hit by Wind Shear are Vulnerable for 4 seconds.
runes.Wind Swept: Launch 2 additional projectiles that deal 24 damage. Additionally, you gain a +15% Movement Speed bonus for 3 seconds after casting.

wire trap.description: Subo places a concussive trap that arms after 0.8 seconds. When an enemy moves within range, it explodes for 80% Physical damage and Stuns enemies for 2 seconds. Selecting a Mercenary Core Skill alters their wielded Weapon and Basic Attack.
wire trap.name: Wire Trap

wisdom of whispers.description: Gain 50% more Experience Orbs in Whisper Caches.
wisdom of whispers.name: Wisdom of Whispers

withering fist.description: Dart at and jab an enemy several times, dealing a total of 5 damage and applying 65 Poisoning damage over 6 seconds. Your 3rd attack bursts on your target, damaging surrounding enemies and Slowing them by 40% for 3 seconds.
withering fist.name: Withering Fist

runes.Fist of the Forest: Withering Fist becomes a Gorilla Skill that deals Physical damage. Withering Fist's 3rd attack releases a shockwave that deals 50 damage. It grants Barrier equal to 5% of your Maximum Health for 6 seconds per enemy hit, up to 60%.
runes.Healing: Withering Fist Heals you for 10% of your Maximum Life.
runes.Poisoning Duration: Withering Fist's Poisoning duration is increased by 2 seconds.
runes.Precision Strike: Withering Fist's 3rd attack's burst is 30% smaller, but deals 600% increased Poisoning damage and applies Vulnerable.
runes.Shared Suffering: Withering Fist's 3rd attack spreads its Poisoning to 5 Nearby enemies and Slows them for 40% more.
runes.Vigor Generation: You gain 5 Vigor per second for every Nearby enemy Poisoned by Withering Fist, up to 10.
runes.Weakened: Enemies Poisoned by Withering Fist are Weakened.

wolves.description: Passive: Summon 2 wolf companions that bite enemies for 14 damage. Active: Command your wolves to use their Feral Dash ability, instantly lunging at the target dealing 200 damage and becoming Unstoppable.
wolves.name: Wolves

runes.Attack Speed: When your Wolves Critically Strike, you gain 20% Attack Speed for 5 seconds.
runes.Berserking: Commanding your Wolves grants you Berserking for 4 seconds.
runes.Damage Bonus: Wolves' instantly break out of any Crowd Control effects, becoming enraged and gaining x100% bonus damage for 15 seconds afterward.
runes.Stun: Enemies hit by Feral Dash are Stunned for 1.5 seconds.
runes.Thrill of the Hunt: All Wolves' upgraded are increased by 100%.
runes.Werewolf Pack: Wolves is also a Werewolf Skill. Your Wolf Companions are now Werewolf Companions and deal x50% bonus damage. Werewolf Companions will use Feral Dash on their own against Distant enemies but does not make them Unstoppable.

wrath of the berserker.description: Explode into rage, Knocking Back surrounding enemies while gaining x30% damage, Berserking, and Unstoppable for value1 seconds.
wrath of the berserker.name: Wrath of the Berserker

runes.Berserking: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, your Berserking damage bonus is increased by x100%.
runes.Deep Impact: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, all attacks causes a fiery explosion for 75 damage.
runes.Duration Bonus: The duration of Wrath of the Berserker is increased by 12 seconds.
runes.Full Throttle: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, you gain a Fire aura that deals 100 damage and Burns for 10 damage over 5 seconds. You gain +50% All Resistance.
runes.Fury Generation: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, gain +20% Attack Speed and increase Fury Generation by x30%.
runes.Maximum Carnage: While Wrath of the Berserker is active, value2 Fury spent increases its duration by 1 second, up to 5 seconds.
runes.Overpower: Wrath of the Berserker grants 1 stack of Overpower per second.

wretched vermin.description: Demonic Rats will frequently attack you in Helltide.
wretched vermin.name: Wretched Vermin

writhe and rot.description: Hellwyrms will always spew Maggots that gain +1 Monster Power. Sometimes, a Pang of Duriel will also crawl forth. Lair Keys often burst out of Pangs of Duriel.
writhe and rot.name: Writhe and Rot

zeal.description: Strike enemies with blinding speed, dealing 80 damage followed immediately by 3 additional strikes dealing 20 damage each.
zeal.name: Zeal

runes.Critical Strike Chance: Zeal has an additional +6% Critical Strike Chance. Double this bonus against Weakened enemies.
runes.Cull the Wicked: Zeal's cleave is larger, gains 2 additional strikes, and deals x25% increased damage to Weakened enemies.
runes.Death or Glory: Zeal costs x10% Maximum Life instead of Faith and strikes around you in a circle. Whenever you lose Life, Zeal's damage increases by 60% and Critical Strike Chance by 20% for 6 seconds.
runes.Fortify: Critically Striking enemies with Zeal has a 25% chance to grant 1% of Maximum Life as Fortify.
runes.Weaken: Zeal Weakens enemies for 4 seconds.
runes.Zealot's Legacy: Zeal extends its assault, randomly seeking surrounding enemies and striking 4 additional times.

zealot.description: Casting Zealot Skills grants Fervor for 2 seconds. Critically Striking with these Skills echoes the attack for an additional 25% of the damage, repeating for each stack of Fervor. While at maximum Fervor, additionally Fortify for 1% of your Maximum Life.
zealot.name: Zealot

zenith.description: Summon a divine sword that cleaves the battlefield for 550 damage Casting Zenith again cuts through the battlefield for 500 damage and Knocks Down enemies for 2 seconds.
zenith.name: Zenith

runes.Critical Strike Chance: Casting Zenith increases your +5% Critical Strike Chance for 8 seconds.
runes.Empyrean Edge:
Zenith is now also a Mobility Skill that:
- Dashes to enemies
- Gains x25% Critical Strike Damage
runes.Sermon of Steel: Zenith unleashes your wrath, dealing 193 damage and can be cast indefinitely for 4 seconds before starting its Cooldown. Instead of Knocking Down enemies, Zenith's 2nd strike extends this duration by 1 second.
runes.Sunder: Zenith sunders a rift in the ground with a single strike, Knocking Down enemies and dealing 900% damage. After 1 second, the rift detonates for 675% damage.
runes.Unstoppable: While Zenith is active, you are Unstoppable.
runes.Weaken: Killing Weakened enemies with Zenith reduces its cooldown by 2 seconds.
